izzyondroid:me.tangobee.weathernaut.summary: Weathernaut: Accurate Weather, Music, and More!
izzyondroid:me.tangobee.weathernaut.description:
Weathernaut is your go-to weather application for all your weather needs. Whether you want to check the current conditions, get hourly forecasts for today and tomorrow, or plan your week with a 7-day forecast, Weathernaut has you covered. With a beautifully designed and responsive UI, the app ensures a seamless experience on any device.

 You’re in control with customizable settings. Adjust temperature units, wind speeds, and pressure units to suit your preferences. With an intuitive search feature, you can easily find weather data for your city or any location you desire.
 Key Features: 
 Current weather data

 7-day weather forecast
 Weather icons for easy visualization
 Background music that matches the weather
 Customizable settings for temperature, wind, and pressure units

fdroid:com.aradia.audiobook.summary: Find, stream, and download free public-domain audiobooks.
fdroid:com.aradia.audiobook.description:
Aradia is a free, ad-free audiobook player for public-domain books from LibriVox.
Search by title, author, or subject, then stream a book immediately or download it for offline listening. Keep track of your progress, adjust playback speed, skip silence, and set a sleep timer.
You can also add local audiobook files to your library. Aradia groups local files into books, reads their metadata, lets you edit a book's title, author, and cover, and remembers where you stopped listening.

Aradia contains no advertising and does not require an account.

fdroid:com.craxiom.networksurvey.name: Network Survey
fdroid:com.craxiom.networksurvey.summary: Survey cellular, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and GNSS, then log, stream or upload the data
fdroid:com.craxiom.networksurvey.description:
Network Survey turns an Android phone into a wireless survey tool. Pick what to survey, pick where the data goes, and press Start survey. One survey, one Start and one Stop.
 What it records 
 Cellular: serving and neighbor cells for GSM, CDMA, UMTS, LTE and 5G NR, including carrier aggregation
 Phone state: what the radio is doing
 Wi-Fi: access points, with channel, security and 802.11 standard
 Bluetooth: Classic and BLE devices, with company names and Find My trackers
 GNSS: GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, BeiDou, QZSS, IRNSS and SBAS satellites
 Call records: calls, texts (SMS and MMS) and cell tower changes, saved to log files
 Where the data goes 
 Turn on one destination or several at once:
 Log files: CSV files on the phone
 NS Analytics: uploads to your team's workspace
 MQTT stream: JSON records to your own broker (for example Mosquitto ), with TLS and QR code setup
 gRPC stream: records to your own gRPC server
 Community databases: OpenCelliD and BeaconDB
 Message formats: messaging.networksurvey.app 
 NS Analytics 
 NS Analytics is the web analytics companion for Network Survey data. Connected phones upload their records to your workspace, so nobody copies files off phones. See your surveys on one map, open an analysis page for each record type, and export the raw records. Connect a phone by scanning the QR code on your workspace's Devices page. It is a separate web service: networksurvey.app/analytics 
 And more 
 Signals: live Cellular, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and GNSS views, including AGC and C/N0 trends
 Map: towers from OpenCelliD and BTSearch, and the points your NS Analytics and Community database surveys covered, colored by signal strength
 Watchlist alerts when a saved Wi-Fi network is seen
 Cellular tools, PLMN lookup, OUI lookup and Wi-Fi spectrum
 Saved setups, light and dark themes, and nine accent colors
 Managed configuration (MDM) per record type and destination, and an Intent API
 Permissions and privacy 
 Location is needed because every record needs a position, and Android requires it to scan Wi-Fi and Bluetooth. Background location is requested only if you turn on Start survey automatically. This build has no Firebase, analytics or crash reporting. Privacy policy 
 Some anti-malware apps flag Network Survey because it can read SMS. It never sends texts and installs nothing. The SMS and call log permissions are used only for Call records (text events and the other party's number) and are asked for only when you turn Call records on, or set a survey that records them to start automatically. Both are optional: without them Call records still logs calls and tower changes. More on GitHub 
 Open source (Apache 2.0): github.com/christianrowlands/android-network-survey . Manual: networksurvey.app/manual . Requires Android 8.0 or later.

fdroid:com.galagidae.broadboard.summary: Large, high-contrast on-screen keyboard designed for low vision users
fdroid:com.galagidae.broadboard.description:
BroadBoard is an on-screen keyboard (IME) designed for people with low vision. Instead of shrinking keys to fit everything on the screen at once, BroadBoard keeps every key big and readable — you simply pan around the keyboard to reach the keys you need, so no key ever has to be small.
Features:
* Large, scrollable keyboard with oversized, high-contrast keys
* Multiple color themes, including extra dark and high-visibility options
* Adjustable keyboard sizes, up to extra large
* Optional haptic feedback
* Screen reader friendly
* Multiple locales and layouts supported
Privacy:
BroadBoard collects no data. It has no internet permission, no analytics, no ads, and no third-party components. Nothing you type ever leaves your device.
After installing, BroadBoard must be enabled and selected as your input method:
1. Go to **Settings → System → Languages & input → On-screen keyboard → Manage keyboards**
2. Enable **BroadBoard**
3. Switch to it via the keyboard picker (tap the keyboard icon in the navigation bar, or long-press the spacebar in most apps).
Alternatively, launching BroadBoard from the app tray provides guided links to the correct settings screen and keyboard picker

fdroid:com.noirdraco.pixelcomfort.name: PixelComfort
fdroid:com.noirdraco.pixelcomfort.summary: Comfort View off in the camera, private DNS by Wi‑Fi, AOD rules and more
fdroid:com.noirdraco.pixelcomfort.description:
The comfort filter on Google Pixel ("Comfort View", Settings → Display & touch → Comfort filters) gives the display a warmer, pastel look. That is easy on the eyes but bad for taking photos: the viewfinder and the Photos preview get a colour cast. Unlike Night Light, Google offers no schedule and no API for it.
PixelComfort turns Comfort View off as soon as you open the camera or Google Photos and restores exactly the previous state when you leave. If the filter was off before, it stays off. Other settings (dynamic, intensity) are never touched.
Around that, PixelComfort bundles a few more small automations for your Pixel. Each one has its own card on the home screen and can be switched on separately.
 Features 
 Comfort View: pauses it in the apps you pick and restores it afterwards; main switch and Quick Settings tile to switch it by hand
 Private DNS by Wi‑Fi: off on your home Wi‑Fi (so e.g. AdGuard Home filters), on everywhere else
 Hide the mobile signal icon while Wi‑Fi is connected
 Auto-rotate only in the apps you choose, with a Quick Settings tile
 Always-on display by Bluetooth device or Wi‑Fi, e.g. off in the car
 Quick Settings tile for NFC
 Sliders for display size and font size, with plus/minus for fine steps and a Default button each
 App picker with icons and search
 History of what was paused, restored or switched, and what went wrong
 Notification when Shizuku isn't running
 Material You, light and dark, English and German
 Requirements 
 Android 13 or newer. Comfort View needs a Google Pixel with the comfort filter (Android 17, Pixel Drop March 2026 or later). Tested on a Pixel 10 Pro with Android 17.
 Shizuku installed and running – the Comfort View setting is locked for normal apps. Display size also uses Shizuku; most other features only need permissions that the app grants itself once via Shizuku.
 The app's accessibility service turned on. It only listens for which app is in the foreground and does not read screen content.
The location permission is only needed for Wi‑Fi rules (private DNS, always-on display), because Android reveals the Wi‑Fi name only to apps with location access. The Bluetooth permission is only used to notice which device connects; the app never scans. No data leaves the device; the app has no internet permission.
Use at your own risk: the app changes system settings. Not an official Google product. "Pixel" is a trademark of Google LLC.

fdroid:com.wattwurm.toodoo.name: toodoo
fdroid:com.wattwurm.toodoo.summary: toodoo - a minimalistc task manager, just tasks, categories, filtering, sorting
fdroid:com.wattwurm.toodoo.description:
Features of toodoo
 Tasks: 
You can create, change and delete tasks.
Each task has a name, a category, a priority (HIGH, MEDIUM, or LOW), and a completion-status (i.e. it is either OPEN or DONE).
Optionally, each task can also have a description (arbitrary text), a due_date and a due_time.
In order to avoid unintentional deletion, a task can only be deleted if it is DONE.
 Categories: 
You can create as many categories as you need.
The category a task belongs to can be changed.
A category can be renamed. This will affect all tasks that belong to that category.
Unused categories can be deleted. I.e. deletion is only possible if the category has no tasks, and if it is not used in the current filter.
 Filtering tasks: 
It is possible to restrict the tasks displayed in the list, e.g. completed tasks only, or tasks with low priority only, etc.
In general, the tasks to be displayed in the list can be filtered by
* completion_status
* due_date/due_time
* priority
* category
or any combination of these.
For due_date there are several predefined filter options, e.g. TODAY, CURRENT_WEEK, OVERDUE, TASKS_WITHOUT_DATE, etc.
For priority and category, it is possible to filter with more than one option. E.g. you can choose to show tasks with priorities HIGH or MEDIUM. Or you can display all tasks that have either category "Family" or "Friends".
 Sorting tasks: 
The task list can be sorted by:
* completion_status
* due_date/due_time
* priority
* category
* name
Any sort order is possible. E.g. first by due_date/time, then by completion status, category, priority and name. Or any other order you prefer.
 Searching tasks: 
Tasks can be searched by text. The search text you enter can be applied to the task name, the task description, or both.
Case-sensitive search is possible.
In the list of search results, when displaying details of a task, the search string is highlighted in the task name and / or description.
 Convenience: 
There are shortcuts for often used actions. E.g.
* From the context menu of a category you can jump to a list of all tasks for that category.
* From the context menu of a task you can change its completion_status, set it to DONE (or OPEN respectively), or set its due date to today or tomorrow.
* When the task list is filtered by "tasks due TODAY", you can easily move to the previous / next day by swiping right / left.
* Similarly, by swiping you can easily move to the previous / next week (when the task list is filtered by "tasks due CURRENT_WEEK"), or to the previous / next category (when all tasks for a category are displayed).
 Display: 
Tasks due in the past, today, or in the future have different background colors, so they are easily discernible.
The color scheme adapts to the display mode of the underlying android. I.e. if dark mode is selected (provided your android does support dark mode), a dark color scheme is used also for toodoo.
 Import / Export: 
All user data (i.e. tasks, categories, filters and sort criteria) can be exported to an external file (xml-format).
Vice versa, data can be imported from an external file.
 Technical: 
Your data is stored locally on your device.
No connection to the internet needed.
No ads. No tracking.
 Restrictions 
toodoo is minimalistic. It focuses on managing, categorizing, filtering, and sorting tasks (however, more features may be added in future releases.)
Thus, there are some restriction, i.e.:
* The user interface is in English only.
* Name of folder and file for export data are fixed (i.e. /Download/toodoo/toodooData-yyyy-mm-dd-hh-mm-ss)
* Settings are currently fixed, e.g.
- date format is yyyy-mm-dd, time format is 24 hours.
- first day of week is Monday.
- within a day, tasks without due_time are sorted behind tasks with due_time.

fdroid:de.mysportsmate.officebreak.name: Office Break
fdroid:de.mysportsmate.officebreak.summary: Active break timer with exercises - reminds you to move at the office.
fdroid:de.mysportsmate.officebreak.description:
Office Break is a simple, privacy-respecting timer that reminds you to take active movement breaks during your workday. Set an interval, hit start, and when the timer expires the app suggests a random exercise. Confirm "Done!" and the timer restarts automatically - over and over, until you stop it.
Stay fit while working from home or at the office, without ads, tracking, or accounts.
Features:
* Adjustable break interval (hours + minutes) with sliders or manual input
* Configurable repetitions, fixed or randomized in a min/max range
* Three context-aware exercise modes: Home Office Workout (bodyweight strength), Home Office Mobility (yoga-inspired stretches), Office (subtle desk-friendly moves)
* 25 built-in exercises across all modes - add your own or disable the ones you don't like
* Optional auto-mode by weekday: bind a different mode to each day of the week (e.g. Office on Mon/Tue, Home Workout on Wed-Fri)
* Work schedule with per-day start/end and lunch break: timer auto-pauses during lunch and stops at end-of-shift; full night-shift support
* Freestyle mode after work hours for free-running breaks without exercise prompts
* Foreground service with persistent notification, screen wake-up, and full-screen lock-screen alert when the timer expires
* Configurable beep, vibration, and custom notification sounds (pick any audio file)
* Text-to-speech: exercise names spoken aloud in your language
* Home screen widget (Glance) with live second-by-second countdown, today's break count, current streak, and a one-tap Start button
* Achievements system with shareable cards (over 35 milestones)
* Local statistics: total breaks, reps, weekly trends, most frequent exercise - all data stays on your device
* JSON backup export and import via Storage Access Framework
* Material 3 theming, light/dark/system modes, accessibility-tuned (TalkBack, reduce-motion, large fonts)
* English and German UI
Privacy:
No analytics, no telemetry, no ads, no third-party SDKs. All data is stored locally on your device. The app never connects to a server. Source code is published under GPL-3.0.

Arcanum is an encrypted container manager for Android that creates and mounts VeraCrypt-compatible volumes. Your files are protected with military-grade encryption and remain accessible only to you.
 Key Features

flathub:ar.com.tuxguitar.TuxGuitar.summary: TuxGuitar is a free and open-source tablature editor
flathub:ar.com.tuxguitar.TuxGuitar.description:
TuxGuitar is a free and open-source tablature editor, which includes features such as tablature editing,
 score editing, import of Guitar Pro (gtp, gp3, gp4, gp5, gpx, gp), PowerTab and TablEdit files,
 export of Guitar pro (gp3, gp4, gp5), Lilypond, pdf, image and audio files. In addition, TuxGuitar's
 tablature and staff interfaces function as basic MIDI editors.
 TuxGuitar's mascot and namesake is Tux, the penguin mascot of many games and programs originally designed
 for Linux. The program is written in the Java programming language and is released under version 2.1 of
 the GNU Lesser General Public License.

flathub:chat.delta.desktop.name: Delta Chat
flathub:chat.delta.desktop.summary: Decentralized private messenger with chat-shared tools and games
flathub:chat.delta.desktop.description:
Delta Chat is a reliable decentralized instant messenger that is easy and fun to use for friends,
 family, groups and organizations. Delta Chat is developed by a dedicated FOSS contributor community
 that jointly releases refinements and new features several times a year, across many stores and
 platforms world-wide.
 Features at a glance:
 🌐 Anonymous. Instant onboarding without a phone number, e-mail or other private data.
 📱 Flexible. Supports multiple chat profiles and is easy to setup on multiple devices.
 🧩 Extensible. Add tools like shopping lists, calendars or gaming apps to any chat.
 🌧️ Reliable. Works under bad and adversarial network conditions.
 🛡️ Secure. Audited End-to-End encryption safe against network and server attacks.
 🏠 Sovereign. Can be run with your own e-mail address or server.
 📜 FOSS. Fully Open Source/Free Software, built on Internet Standards.

flathub:codes.merritt.FeelingFinder.name: Feeling Finder
flathub:codes.merritt.FeelingFinder.summary: A fast and beautiful emoji picker
flathub:codes.merritt.FeelingFinder.description:
Fast and beautiful emoji picker. Easily find the perfect emoji by genre or search. Remembers your recent emojis for quick re-use.
 Features
 Emojis from the Unicode spec
 Variants / skin tones
 Browse emoji categories
 Hover emoji for description
 Search
 Select emoji with arrow keys
 Press Enter or click/tap an emoji to copy to clipboard
 Right-click or Menu key to show variant / skin tone menu
 Alt + Arrow Up / Arrow Down to change category
 Option to quit after copying to clipboard
 Right-click or long-press Recent to clear
 Light & dark theme

flathub:com.pypyrev.linuxdcpp.name: LinuxDC++
flathub:com.pypyrev.linuxdcpp.summary: A file-sharing client for the Direct Connect network
flathub:com.pypyrev.linuxdcpp.description:
LinuxDC++ is a Direct Connect client for Linux based on DC++.
 Utilizing the latest DC++ core, LinuxDC++ offers similar functionality to the Windows client like segmented downloading, TTH based file integrity, etc. with a GTK+ 2 user interface. LinuxDC++ is free and open source software licensed under the GPL.
 Direct Connect (DC) is a peer-to-peer file-sharing protocol. Clients connect to a central hub where they can chat or share files with one another. Users can view other users' list of shared files or search the hub for files.

flathub:com.vargary.focal.name: Focal
flathub:com.vargary.focal.summary: Organize tasks & notes in a tree.
flathub:com.vargary.focal.description:
Tired of scattered notes and lost tasks? Focal brings everything together in one place. Organize
 your ideas, projects, and to-dos in a simple outline format—like folders within folders—so you
 can always find what you need.
 🌳 Outline Your Way: Nest notes inside notes, just like an outline. Break big projects into smaller
 pieces and keep related items together.
 📝 Notes, Tasks, and Boards: Write notes, track tasks with due dates and priorities, or plan
 visually with kanban boards. Use what works for you.
 🔍 Find Anything Fast: Search across all your notes and tasks instantly. Create smart lists that
 automatically gather items by tag, status, or date.
 🏷️ Tag and Organize: Add color-coded tags to group related items across different projects.
 Filter by tag to see exactly what you need.
 ✏️ Write Your Way: Use simple text or rich formatting with headings, lists, and styling—whatever
 suits your style.
 ☁️ Sync Everywhere: Access your notes on all your devices. Everything stays backed up and in
 sync automatically.
 🤝 Share and Collaborate: Invite others to view or edit specific notes or entire sections. Control
 who can read, edit, or manage each part.
 Focal adapts to how you think—whether you're planning a project, studying for exams, or just
 keeping life organized. No complicated setup, no rigid structure. Just your ideas, organized your
 way.

flathub:io.github.martchus.syncthingtray.name: Syncthing Tray
flathub:io.github.martchus.syncthingtray.description:
Syncthing Tray complements the normal web-based UI of Syncthing itself providing the following features:
 A tray icon showing the overall status of Syncthing
 A tray menu showing more detailed status information that also allows to quickly perform common actions such as triggering a rescan
 Notifications for certain events
 Quick access to the normal web-based UI of Syncthing
 Integration with systemd and launcher for Syncthing
 Note that this is the desktop environment independent version. The Plasmoid/KDE-integrations might be installed via a different
 distribution-specific package (but cannot be provided as Flatpak for technical reasons).

flathub:net.wz2100.wz2100.name: Warzone 2100
flathub:net.wz2100.wz2100.summary: Command the forces of The Project in a battle to rebuild the world
flathub:net.wz2100.wz2100.description:
The classic 3D real-time strategy game from 1999 has been updated, upgraded, and modernized for the very latest platforms!
 Command the forces of The Project in a battle to rebuild the world after mankind has been nearly destroyed by nuclear missiles.
 Warzone 2100 offers a story-driven single-player campaign, online multi-player, and single-player skirmish modes. An extensive tech tree with over 400 different technologies, combined with the unit design system, allows for a wide variety of possible units and tactics.
 Highlights:
 Remastered single-player campaign with expanding persistent bases, away missions, and more
 Online multiplayer with up to 10 players, free-for-all or team-play, for massive battles
 Local skirmish with AI bots, for endless replayability
 Extensive tech tree with over 400 different technologies
 Customizable units with a flexible design system that enables a wide variety of possible tactics
 Cross-platform multiplayer
 Support for multiple graphics backends (OpenGL, OpenGL ES, Vulkan)
 100% free and open source

flathub:org.clementine_player.Clementine.name: Clementine Music Player
flathub:org.clementine_player.Clementine.developer: David Sansome, John Maguire & Arnaud Bienner
flathub:org.clementine_player.Clementine.summary: Plays music files and Internet radio
flathub:org.clementine_player.Clementine.description:
Clementine is a multiplatform music player. It is inspired by Amarok 1.4, focusing on a fast
 and easy-to-use interface for searching and playing your music.
 Search and play your local music library
 Listen to internet radio from Spotify, Grooveshark, SomaFM, Magnatune, Jamendo, SKY.fm, Digitally
 Imported, JAZZRADIO.com, Soundcloud, Icecast and Subsonic servers
 Search and play songs you've uploaded to Box, Dropbox, Google Drive, and OneDrive
 Create smart playlists and dynamic playlists
 Tabbed playlists, import and export M3U, XSPF, PLS and ASX
 CUE sheet support
 Play audio CDs
 Visualisations from projectM
 Lyrics and artist biographies and photos
 Transcode music into MP3, Ogg Vorbis, Ogg Speex, FLAC or AAC
 Edit tags on MP3 and OGG files, organise your music
 Fetch missing tags from MusicBrainz
 Discover and download Podcasts
 Download missing album cover art from Last.fm and Amazon
 Cross-platform - works on Windows, Mac OS X and Linux
 Native desktop notifications on Linux (libnotify) and Mac OS X (Growl)
 Remote control using an Android device, a Wii Remote, MPRIS or the command-line
 Copy music to your iPod, iPhone, MTP or mass-storage USB player
 Queue manager

flathub:org.kde.kgoldrunner.name: KGoldrunner
flathub:org.kde.kgoldrunner.summary: Hunt Gold, Dodge Enemies and Solve Puzzles
flathub:org.kde.kgoldrunner.description:
KGoldrunner is an action game where the hero runs through a maze, climbs stairs, dig holes and
 dodges enemies in order to collect all the gold nuggets and escape to the next level. Your enemies
 are also after the gold. Worse still, they are after you!.
 Features:

 Hundreds of levels
 Level-editor
 Two modes for the enemies: classical and KGoldrunner-mode, in KGoldrunner-mode they are more
 intelligent, in the classical mode it is easier to fool them
 Very very difficult levels
 Keyboard or mouse control
 Savable games

flathub:org.lightning_matrix.Lightning.name: Lightning
flathub:org.lightning_matrix.Lightning.description:
Lightning is a desktop messenger for Matrix, the open network for secure, decentralised communication.
 Sign in to any homeserver, or to several accounts at once, and reach people wherever their account
 lives.
 Conversations are organised into Spaces, rooms and threads. Send rich text, pictures, files,
 voice messages, polls, reactions and custom emoji, and find something you sent months ago without
 scrolling back to it.
 Private rooms are end-to-end encrypted throughout: verify your other devices by comparing emoji,
 restore your keys from backup, and search even your encrypted rooms with an index that never leaves
 this computer.
 Group voice calls and screen sharing run in the room itself.

flathub:org.openshot.OpenShot.name: OpenShot Video Editor
flathub:org.openshot.OpenShot.summary: An easy to use, quick to learn, and surprisingly powerful video editor
flathub:org.openshot.OpenShot.description:
OpenShot Video Editor is an award-winning, open-source video editor, available on Linux, Mac, Chrome OS,
 and Windows. OpenShot can create stunning videos, films, and animations with an easy-to-use interface
 and rich set of features.
 Features include: 
 Free & open-source (licensed under GPLv3)
 Cross-platform (Linux, OS X, Chrome OS, and Windows)
 Easy-to-use user interface (designed for beginners, built-in tutorial)
 Supports most video, audio, & image formats (based on FFmpeg)
 Includes popular video profiles & presets (over 70+ profiles, including YouTube HD)
 Advanced timeline (including drag and drop, scrolling, panning, zooming, and snapping)
 Advanced clips (including trimming, alpha, scaling, location, rotation, and shearing)
 Real-time preview (multi-threaded, and optimized for performance)
 Simple & advanced views (or customize your own unique view)
 Powerful, curve-based Keyframe animations (linear, Bézier, and constant interpolation)
 Compositing, image overlays, watermarks, & transparency 
 Unlimited tracks / layers (support for complex projects)
 Video transitions, masks, & wipes (grayscale images and animated masks)
 Video & audio effects (including brightness, gamma, hue, chroma key / blue screen, and more)
 Image sequences & 2D animations (001.png, 002.png, 003.png, etc…)
 Blender 3D integration (animated 3D title templates)
 Vector file support & editing (SVG / scalable vector graphics used for titles and credits)
 Audio mixing, waveform, & editing 
 Emojis (open-source stickers & artwork included)
 Frame accuracy (step through each frame of video)
 Time mapping & speed changes (slow/fast, forward/backward)
 Advanced AI (motion tracking, object detection, & stabilization effects)
 Credits & captions (scrolling and animated)
 Hardware accelerated (encoding & decoding supports NVIDIA, AMD, Intel and more)
 Import & export (EDL and Final Cut Pro formats, supports most video editors)
 Customizable keyboard shortcuts 
 Translations (available in 100+ languages)

flathub:org.prismlauncher.PrismLauncher.name: Prism Launcher
flathub:org.prismlauncher.PrismLauncher.summary: Custom Minecraft Launcher to easily manage multiple Minecraft installations at once
flathub:org.prismlauncher.PrismLauncher.description:
Prism Launcher is a custom launcher for Minecraft that focuses on predictability, long term stability and simplicity.
 Features:
 Easily install game modifications, such as Fabric, Forge and Quilt
 Easily install and update modpacks from the Launcher
 Control your Java settings, and enable Mangohud or Gamemode with a toggle
 Manage worlds and resource packs from the launcher
 See logs and other details easily through a dashboard
 Kill Minecraft in case of a crash/freeze
 Isolate Minecraft instances to keep everything clean
 Install and update mods directly from the launcher
 Customize the launcher with themes, and more
 And cat :3

fedora-packages:alpine/alpine.name: alpine
fedora-packages:alpine/alpine.summary: Powerful, easy to use console email client
fedora-packages:alpine/alpine.description: Alpine -- an Alternatively Licensed Program for Internet News & Email -- is a tool for reading, sending, and managing electronic messages. Alpine is the successor to Pine and was developed by Computing & Communications at the University of Washington. Though originally designed for inexperienced email users, Alpine supports many advanced features, and an ever-growing number of configuration and personal-preference options. Changes and enhancements over pine: * Released under the Apache Software License, Version 2.0. * Internationalization built around new internal Unicode support. * Ground-up reorganization of source code around new "pith/" core routine library. * Ground-up reorganization of build and install procedure based on the GNU Build System.

fedora-packages:apiguardian/apiguardian.name: apiguardian
fedora-packages:apiguardian/apiguardian.description: API Guardian indicates the status of an API element and therefore its level of stability as well. fedora-packages:archivemount/archivemoun.description: Archivemount is a piece of glue code between libarchive and FUSE. It can be used to mount a (possibly compressed) archive (as in .tar.gz or .tar.bz2) and use it like an ordinary filesystem.

fedora-packages:bspwm/bspwm.description: bspwm is a tiling window manager that represents windows as the leaves of a full binary tree. It only responds to X events, and the messages it receives on a dedicated socket. bspc is a program that writes messages on bspwm's socket. bspwm doesn't handle any keyboard or pointer inputs: a third party program (e.g. sxhkd) is needed in order to translate keyboard and pointer events to bspc invocations.

fedora-packages:clover2/clover2.name: clover2

In order to compile, type checking can be done at compile time. In addition, it is designed to be able to use an easy-to-use library like Ruby. Regular expressions, lambda, closure etc are first class objects.

This package provides symbolic links that alias the following Go import paths to github.com/urfave/cli: – github.com/codegangsta/cli Aliasing Go import paths via symbolic links or http redirects is fragile. firefox-addons:2938270.name: WordGlance - Dictionary & Translation
firefox-addons:2938270.summary: Get instant dictionary definitions and translations for any text on any website! Just select text and click the book icon.
firefox-addons:2938270.description:
WordGlance - Your instant dictionary and translation companion!
 ✨ What it does: 
 Dictionary : Get definitions, examples, synonyms, and antonyms instantly
 Pronunciation : Hear words read aloud with one tap, when audio is available
 Translation : See the word's equivalents in your target language, with several to choose between
 Per-site control : Turn WordGlance off on individual websites, right from the popup
 Mobile-friendly : Works perfectly on both desktop and mobile
 Customizable : Choose your preferred languages and settings
 How to use: 
 Select a single word on any website
 Click the 📖 icon that appears
 Get instant definitions and translations
 Click the ‹ › arrows to browse multiple results
A Lookup is about one word. The 📖 icon appears for a single word — WordGlance
does not translate a sentence, a phrase, or a passage. It shows that word's
equivalents in your target language, so you can pick the formal or the colloquial
one.
 Target languages — the language you want a word's equivalents in. Coverage
depends on the source, because each pair comes from a different source: Wiktionary
where it has a Translations block, and a machine-translation fallback where it
does not, which is rougher and usually offers one word rather than several.
Amharic, Arabic, Bengali, Bulgarian, Chinese, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Estonian, Filipino, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Latvian, Lithuanian, Malay, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Serbian, Slovak, Slovenian, Spanish, Swahili, Swedish, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Zulu
 Definitions are English-first. They come from a dictionary of the 19,555
commonest English words that ships inside the extension, and for other languages
from a live provider whose coverage we have measured for one language and not for
the rest. If you read in a language we have not measured, treat the quality as
unverified rather than good.
 Features: 
 Choose the language you are reading in, or leave it on auto-detect
 Customizable target language (defaults to English)
 Dark mode toggle
 Smart caching system
 Works on all websites (or turn it off per-site)
 No account required
 Completely free and open source
 Privacy & Security: 
 The word you select is sent straight from your browser to the services below — that is the only data that ever leaves it. WordGlance runs no servers, logs no lookups, and has no accounts.
 A common English word reaches nobody at all : definitions, examples, synonyms and antonyms for the 19,555 commonest words come from a dictionary bundled inside the extension. A rare word, and any Translation, cost a request.
 Your Definitions are resolved first, and your Translation is asked for afterwards. Within each, a service is contacted only when the ones before it had no answer:
 Free Dictionary API ( freedictionaryapi.com ) — only for a word the bundled dictionary does not carry
 Datamuse ( api.datamuse.com ) — only when neither has synonyms or antonyms to show
 Wiktionary ( en.wiktionary.org ) — every Translation, for the word's equivalents in your target language and its pronunciation
 Google ( clients5.google.com ), MyMemory ( api.mymemory.translated.net ), Bing ( www.bing.com ) — free machine-translation fallbacks, in that order, reached only when Wiktionary lists no equivalent of your word in your target language. MyMemory and Bing answer with a single word where Wiktionary would have offered several to choose between, so a Translation from one of them is a fallback and a rougher one. They issue no cookie and require no sign-in.
 Wikimedia Commons ( commons.wikimedia.org ) is outside that sequence: it is contacted only when you press the pronunciation button, and it receives the recording's file name rather than your word.
 Your settings, cache, and per-site on/off list stay in your browser's local storage and are never transmitted
 No analytics, no tracking, no ads
 Open source code, so you can verify all of this yourself
 Attribution: 
Definitions, examples, synonyms and antonyms come from Wiktionary via the kaikki.org extraction, with wiktextract , under CC BY-SA 4.0 . Translations and pronunciation audio come from Wiktionary and Wikimedia Commons, under the same licence. Relations, where a dictionary entry carries none, come from Datamuse .
 Browser Support: 
This extension is designed specifically for Firefox. There is no Chromium version, and the WordGlance userscript that used to serve one is archived and no longer maintained — it fetches from the page, so every service WordGlance now uses would have to allow it explicitly. If you were using the userscript, come here.
 Open Source: 
WordGlance is completely free and open source under the GPL-3.0 license. Feel free to contribute, report bugs, or request features on our GitHub repository .
 ❤ Love WordGlance? Give it a ⭐ on GitHub!

firefox-addons:3069540.name: AutoStyler – Themes for Autodarts
firefox-addons:3069540.summary: Restyle play.autodarts.com: colours, background, logo, fonts and presets – right inside the page, with a live preview.
firefox-addons:3069540.description:
Unofficial extension. Not developed, operated or endorsed by Autodarts.
AutoStyler restyles play.autodarts.com to your taste – from a calm dark blue at home to full neon arcade for the machine at the club. The menu lives inside the page instead of in a popup, so you see every change right where it happens.
── THE MENU LIVES IN THE PAGE ──
A round icon sits in the bottom right corner, discreet by design and even more restrained during a match. One click opens a drawer built to match the site's own menus. No dimming overlay behind it, because the page is the very thing you are adjusting. Drag a slider and the page follows along – no reload, no second window. The icon can be dragged anywhere in the window and remembers where you put it.
── THIRTEEN READY-MADE THEMES ──
Midnight, Neon Arcade, Emerald, Magma, Northern Light, Royal Gold, Cyber Lime, Amber, Steel, Frosted, Panorama, Vitrine and Paper. One click each. "Original Autodarts" switches everything back off. Your own presets come first in the quick row.
── EVERY COLOUR SEPARATELY ──
Background, surfaces, cards, body text, muted text, banner, accent, border and the two player colours. Text on accent surfaces is set light or dark automatically, whichever reads better.
── READABILITY BUILT IN ──
A contrast check recalculates five colour pairs live against WCAG and tells you whether they hold up – which matters when the screen is read from three metres away. Light or dark: the site is built for dark mode, and AutoStyler carries light themes through cleanly all the same.
── BACKGROUND AND FROSTED GLASS ──
Solid colour, gradient or your own image, with fit, position, darkening, blur and greyscale. Surfaces can be made transparent so the image shows through – header, cards, menus and page surface on separate sliders. A frosted-glass effect behind them keeps the text on top calm and readable.
── YOUR OWN LOGO ──
Replace the logo in the header with an image of your own, and place a watermark in any corner or in the middle. Made for club and company colours.
── OVER 30 TYPEFACES ──
From system fonts through Inter, Roboto and Montserrat to scoreboard faces like Oswald, Teko and Bebas Neue, and arcade faces like Orbitron, Russo One and Press Start 2P. Font size and zoom are separate: size changes the letters only, zoom scales the whole interface. Every typeface is matched to the site's own metrics so scores and names never get clipped.
── TIDYING UP ──
Hide the spectator and settings icons, or click any element away for good and bring it back individually. The header is protected and always stays visible, so navigation never gets lost.
── LOCK IT WITH A PIN ──
An optional PIN keeps the AutoStyler menu shut, and the whole Autodarts profile menu with it – settings, devices, account and, if installed, Tools for Autodarts. Once unlocked it stays open until you lock it by hand or close the tab. Made for the club machine that many hands walk past. To be honest: it is a latch against bystanders, not protection against someone who knows their way around a browser.
── YOUR OWN PRESETS ──
Save your settings under a name, background image, logo and the list of hidden elements included. Export and import set up a second machine in one step.
── ENGLISH AND GERMAN ──
The interface follows your browser, or whichever language you pick in the Info tab.
── HOW IT WORKS ──
The site describes its interface through CSS design tokens. AutoStyler overwrites those tokens instead of inverting the page with a filter. That is why the dartboard, player photos and colour coding keep their real colours, and fixed bars do not shift.
── PRIVACY ──
No data is collected, stored or transmitted. All settings and images stay local to your browser profile. Access is limited to play.autodarts.com . If you pick a Google font, your browser loads it from Google Fonts; choose a system font or "Original" to avoid that.
Shortcuts: Alt+Shift+A opens the menu, Alt+Shift+S switches the theme on and off.
Feedback and bug reports are welcome at florian@frei.email

Why should you choose this app?
- User-Friendly Interface
- Recording and playback
- 2 player mode
- Music list: Access a vast library of sheet music
The app invites you to embrace the world of music with open arms. Whether you're aiming to master the piano, explore other instruments, or simply have fun creating music, this app is your ideal companion. Start your musical journey today and let the power of music transform your life. 
Use the app and learn piano lessons today!

bluejetty:00073304:ios.description:
Famefy offers a fully AI-powered experience where every audience member, comment, and reaction is generated by artificial intelligence. There are no real viewers involved.
Step into the world of AI-driven live streams and connect with a virtual audience that reacts in real time. Whether you're building confidence, rehearsing a performance, or simply having fun, Famefy helps you feel like a true star with lifelike engagement designed to match your energy and style.
Key Features
AI-Powered Audience
Experience virtual fans that react to your livestream experience in real time.
Personalized Fan Reactions
Your AI audience adapts to your content over time, creating a more engaging and tailored experience with every session.
Smart Environment and Voice Analysis
Your tone, pace, and surroundings influence how your audience reacts through intelligent real-time analysis.
Lifelike Interactions
Enjoy realistic comments, cheers, and reactions inspired by real livestream experiences.
Premium Features
Some Famefy features require a Premium subscription or in-app purchase.
AI fans may react, comment, and engage during livestreams. Direct interactive AI fan responses to your spoken messages are available only with Premium.
Step into the Spotlight
Famefy is your personal space to experience the energy of going live in front of thousands. Whether you’re practicing public speaking, testing creative ideas, or exploring what it’s like to entertain an audience, Famefy brings your moment to life through advanced AI-generated engagement.
Disclaimer
Famefy is designed for entertainment and educational purposes only. All audience activity is created by artificial intelligence. There are no real users, viewers, or live broadcasts. Famefy does not collect or store personal data.

bluejetty:00041550:ios.description:
More than metabolic health—this is a revolution. SWITCHAURA is your evolving global wellness hub, blending science, holistic health, spirituality, and mindset coaching to help people worldwide achieve metabolic flexibility, detoxification, longevity, and deep vitality. We believe true transformation happens when body, mind, and spirit are aligned—and when community and collaboration are at the heart of the journey.
SWITCHAURA offers both free and paid access to expert-led programs, wellness resources, and immersive live experiences. Inside, you’ll find science-backed guides, spike protein detox tools, fasting and nutrition programs, educational events, and a growing library of offerings from world-class teachers in health, mindset, personal growth, and conscious living.
Our free access area provides downloadable guides, live events, and curated content to support your journey. Paid programs offer deeper immersion into metabolic health, spike protein detox, longevity science, fasting, and emotional wellness. From structured health protocols to self-paced learning, the platform meets you where you are—whether you're just starting or ready to go deeper.
SWITCHAURA is also home to a vibrant, supportive global community. We offer both women-only and co-ed spaces to ensure everyone feels welcome and inspired. Whether you're engaging in structured programs, live group coaching, or sharing experiences in our private communities, you're never alone on your path to transformation.
Our annual and evergreen programs include the Microbiome Makeover and Gut Repair, the Liver Detox Program, Bi-Annual 5-Day Supervised Water Fasts, the 30-Day One Dress Size Metabolic Reset for women, and Conversations with Deborah—a live event exploring the deep psychology and spiritual insights behind lasting wellness. We also host in-person retreats designed to deepen connection, healing, and embodiment.
New contributors are joining the SwitchAura platform with their own unique programs, expanding the range of transformational tools available to you—from biohacking and breathwork to integrative healing, feminine embodiment, and conscious parenting. You’ll soon discover even more ways to support your wellbeing—through diverse modalities, expert insights, and empowering education.
Deborah Murtagh, the visionary behind SWITCHAURA, is a global authority in metabolic health, longevity science, and holistic transformation. With over 30 years of experience, she has guided hundreds of thousands of people in reshaping their lives through nutrition, fasting, mindset, and deep inner work. She also leads international retreats for those seeking profound transformation at every level.
Download SWITCHAURA today to access wellness tools, expert-led programs, and a global community committed to helping you live a vibrant, inspired, and healthy life—body, mind, and soul.

bluejetty:00072366:ios.description:
DecoLab ► Your Ultimate AI Home Design Companion
*It makes me excited to start making changes to my space*
Generate awesome design renderings in various styles by simply uploading a photo. Whether you’re dreaming of a cozy bedroom refresh, a sleek kitchen overhaul, a modern exterior facelift or a backyard that finally invites you to stay awhile, the app serves up realistic visualizations that feel hand-crafted for your space. Turn any room or whole house into a fresh idea in under a minute! 
► What Makes DecoLab Special?
It’s a smart & creative powerhouse that packs a mighty punch, it takes your photos and transforms them into stunning AI home design visuals with a custom reflection of your personal style. Start with a photo and have a fresh plan, a new mood, and the spark to turn vision into reality! 
See new room designs that flow better, clever furniture arrangements that maximize comfort and circulation, and fresh color palettes that lift the mood. Try different floor finishes that tie everything together, experiment with wall textures, and add decorative accents to your living areas—each option is rendered with lifelike detail. Outside, explore landscape redesigns, patio upgrades, and backyard plans that blend style with function. The visuals are high-quality, so you can picture the final result clearly before you buy a single cushion. 
Features You’ll Love:
·Virtual Home Staging
Furnish empty or unfinished spaces with realistic furniture and decor, transforming them into a stunningly staged image for real estate listings or interior design. Each result gives clear, scalable ideas you can act on.
·Room-by-Room Interior Design 
From cozy nooks to grand dining areas, we’ll help you visualize every corner of your home and tackle each room individually. Swap floor finishes, tweak bathroom layouts, and choose personalized decor touches so each room looks pulled together without the guesswork.
·Landscape Redesign 
Visualize complete redesigns for patios, lawns, and gardens—down to plant placement, hardscape accents, and outdoor living zones. Patio styling, planting schemes, and landscape enhancements are shown in lifelike detail so you can preview your backyard oasis.
·Exterior Renovation
Choose from a variety of architectural styles, remodel facades, roofing and more while keeping the original structure of a house, building or commercial property.
·Design Styles
Choose from a plethora of curated design styles and themes—modern, rustic, minimalist, charm, retro, scandinavian, classic & more—and watch your space transform with thoughtfully placed furniture, realistic materials, and cohesive color palettes. 
·Remove & Replace Objects 
Swap furniture and items to fit your personalized aesthetics. Couches, plants, lamps, tables, wall art, decor—down to any detail. 
·Flooring & Walls 
Try a variety of colors, textures, tones and materials. Switch up between bold transformations and simple tweaks until you find the perfect look.
·Versatility at Its Best
Explore design concepts for any type of space—interior or exterior. Looking to upgrade your patio for summer barbecues? Planning a full reno? Our app caters to both practical renovations and creative enhancements.

The app requires iOS 17 or later.

Plow the fields, plant a variety of crops, water them, and harvest the rewards of your hard work. Every step brings you closer to becoming a successful farmer.

Unlock new tractors of your choice to cultivate larger areas and improve productivity. Enjoy the peaceful countryside environment that brings your farm to life. Make smart decisions, manage your time, and take care of your crops to build a thriving farming business.

bluejetty:00068470:ios.description:
What is your dog or cat trying to tell you?
A bark, a meow—and suddenly you’re wondering what your pet might be thinking. Record their sounds and discover a playful interpretation of what they could be expressing. With Dog & Cat Translator: Pet Chat, every sound can become a new way to play, interact, and bond with your furry friend.
You can also turn your voice into dog or cat sounds, identify your pet’s breed from a photo, and try sounds designed to help calm your dog. Plus, explore expert-created tips on pet care and training.
CORE FEATURES
• Playful Pet-to-Human Translation: Record a bark or meow and discover the message your pet might be trying to share. It’s a fun new way to explore their sounds and enjoy more moments together.
• Turn Your Voice into Animal Sounds: Transform your phrases into dog or cat sounds and play along as you “talk” in your pet’s language.
• Identify a Breed from a Photo: Take or upload a photo of your dog or cat to identify its likely breed and learn about its characteristics.
• Sounds to Help Calm Your Dog: Try specially designed sounds that can capture your dog’s attention and may help them settle.
• Dog and Cat Soundboard: Explore a collection of animal sounds and reactions for playful interactions with your pet.
• Meow Melodies: Enjoy familiar tunes reimagined with cats as the singers—purrfect for feline fans.
• Expert Pet Care and Training Tips: Read expert-created articles about pet health, care, and training to support your best friend every day.
• Funny Pet Videos: Unwind with a collection of entertaining and heartwarming animal videos.
Download the app and discover new ways to play, connect, and share moments with your pet!
Note: Sound interpretations are for entertainment only and are not scientifically proven translations of animal language. Sounds designed to help calm your dog do not replace appropriate training or veterinary advice.

bluejetty:00184804:ios.summary:

Official Selection, PAX 10 Indie Showcase, PAX Prime 2014

5/5 - AppSpy

bluejetty:00184804:ios.description:
Headshots! Paperwork! Semi-Organic Autonomous Skulls collecting taxes from the Deadbeats of the Afterlife!
Official Selection, PAX 10 Indie Showcase, PAX Prime 2014
9/10 - Pocket Gamer (Pocket Gamer Gold Award)
5/5 - AppSpy
4.5/5 - Touch Arcade
4/5 - 148 Apps 
4/5 - Gamezebo
8.5/10 - GameMob
========================================================
You know the old saying, “you can’t take it with you?” Well, we’ve got news for you, my friends, they were WRONG! “Deadbeats” have been taking their riches with them to the afterlife for centuries and it’s the job of the INFERNAL Revenue Service — and its army of skulls — to collect! That’s where you come in.
In “Skullduggery!” you’ll play a Semi-Organic Autonomous Skull employed as a collection agent for the IRS. Using the elasticity of your own brain, flick yourself around the fortresses of the afterlife’s biggest deadbeats.
- BRAIN POWER: Pull back ANYWHERE on the screen to stretch out your brain! Let go to snap your skull forward like a brainy rubber band. 
- BULLET TIME: Touch and hold in mid-air to slow down time, change directions, avoid deadly obstacles, and pull off crazy trick shots!
- GRAVITATIONAL TRUANCY: Repeatedly jump by aiming again while your skull is mid-flight.
- STEALTHINESS: Being small has advantages! Hide in trash cans, chests, and jars. Slip behind surly guards and take them out while their backs are turned!
- HEADSHOTS: Take out enemies with a single well-placed fling to the cranium.
- HEAD TO HEAD: Play ‘head to head’ against your friends to become the afterlife’s most successful agent. 
- BUREAUCRACY: Fill out paperwork and reflect on the inherent emptiness of existence!
“Skullduggery!” features the endearingly grotesque art stylings of game artist extraordinaire Bill Mudron, inspired by the Max Fleischer animations of the 1930’s, and a quirky, doom-jazzy, bureau-noir soundtrack from industrial musician Michael Arthur Holloway.
MORE FEATURES:
- NO In App Purchase. Buy the game, play the game. That’s it!
- A finely-tuned and deeply-satisfying one-touch control scheme specifically tailored to mobile.
- Three distinctly unique and atmospheric worlds with more on the way.
- Dreadful puns.
- Single Player mode with 24 surreal and pleasantly spooky levels.
- Multiplayer “Head to Head” mode with a variety of brain-pounding arenas.
- Hidden rooms and secret chests containing treasure and other delights.
- Pleasing power-ups and epic boss battles!
- Dozens of collectables and secondary objectives for maximum replayability.
- Over 20 unique skulls to unlock, including guest celebrity skulls from some of our favorite games.
- Universal App - play on your new iPhone, iPod touch, iPad and iPad mini.
- Full iCloud support - sync your progress across all your devices.
- Compete with Game Center Achievements and Leaderboards.
- Paperwork, paperwork, paperwork!
===================================================
Hi, We're ClutchPlay Games!
We’re a small indie game studio located in not-so-sunny yet idyllic Portland, Oregon. Our first game, Little Chomp was selected as one of six featured titles at the 2013 PAX East Indie Showcase and more recently, “Skullduggery!” was featured in the PAX 10 Indie Showcase at PAX Prime, 2014. 
We'd love to hear your feedback, so please drop us a line or just say hi at feedback@clutchplaygames.com, or follow us on Twitter at @ClutchPlayGames
We hope you enjoy “Skullduggery!”
For news, support and updated info, please visit us at: 
https://www.facebook.com/DepartmentOfSkullduggery
https://www.facebook.com/clutchplaygames
https://twitter.com/ClutchPlayGames
http://www.clutchplaygames.com/Support

- NO In App Purchase.  Buy the game, play the game. That’s it!
- A finely-tuned and deeply-satisfying one-touch control scheme specifically tailored to mobile.
- Three distinctly unique and atmospheric worlds with more on the way.
- Dreadful puns.
- Single Player mode with 24 surreal and pleasantly spooky levels.
- Multiplayer “Head to Head” mode with a variety of brain-pounding arenas.
- Hidden rooms and secret chests containing treasure and other delights.
- Pleasing power-ups and epic boss battles!
- Dozens of collectables and secondary objectives for maximum replayability.
- Over 20 unique skulls to unlock, including guest celebrity skulls from some of our favorite games.
- Universal App - play on your new iPhone, iPod touch, iPad and iPad mini.
- Full iCloud support - sync your progress across all your devices.
- Compete with Game Center Achievements and Leaderboards.
- Paperwork, paperwork, paperwork!

===================================================

Hi, We're ClutchPlay Games!

We’re a small indie game studio located in not-so-sunny yet idyllic Portland, Oregon. Our first game, Little Chomp was selected as one of six featured titles at the 2013 PAX East Indie Showcase and more recently, “Skullduggery!” was featured in the PAX 10 Indie Showcase at PAX Prime, 2014. 

We'd love to hear your feedback, so please drop us a line or just say hi at feedback@clutchplaygames.com, or follow us on Twitter at @ClutchPlayGames

We hope you enjoy “Skullduggery!”

Ideal for everyone from infants to adults who are seeking a serene escape into dreamland.

bluejetty:00173243:ios.description:
Introducing the ultimate keto diet app & meal planner, designed to help you achieve your weight loss goals and live a healthier lifestyle. Our keto diet plan for weight loss app comes with a host of features, including a net carb calculator, carb manager, and carbs calculator, making it easy to stay on track with your low carb diet. Whether you're new to the ketogenic diet or a seasoned pro, this app will be your personal helper for meal planning, recipe tracking, and nutrition tracking.
Your Personalized keto diet app
With our keto diet app, you can easily track your daily carb intake and monitor your progress. Our net carb calculator helps you calculate the number of carbs you can consume while staying within your daily limit. You can also track your macronutrient balance, including fat, protein, and carbs, to ensure you're getting the right nutrition for your body. By default, this app comes as a free version with limited functionalities. By subscribing to the premium version you have access to various additional features like the weekly meal planner, thousands of recipes and a shopping list. 
AI Recipe Generator
Discover endless meal possibilities with our AI Recipe Generator. Simply input your preferences and let our app create personalized recipes just for you. Enjoy hassle-free cooking with step-by-step instructions and ingredient lists.
Carb Manager and Meal Planning Made Easy
Our carb manager and carbs calculator make it simple to track your carb intake and stay on track with your low carb diet. You can easily log your meals and snacks, and the app will provide insights into your eating habits. The meal planning feature allows you to plan your meals in advance, ensuring that you always have delicious low carb options at your fingertips.
Keto, Low Carb & Paleo Recipes
Our app also includes a selection of recipes including but not limited to low carb and paleo recipes, perfect for anyone looking to mix up their meal plan. From breakfast to dinner, our recipes are designed to be easy to follow and delicious to eat. You can even customize the recipes to fit your preferences and dietary restrictions.

bluejetty:00172229:ios.description:
Spider Solitaire Classic is the #1 classic spider solitaire you know and love for your iPhone, iPad, and iPod. If you like windows spider solitaire, you're going to LOVE this app!! 
Each day you’ll receive a unique Daily Challenge. Solve the Daily Challenge and receive a crown for that day. Earn trophies each month by winning more crowns! Your Daily Challenges, crowns, and current trophy status are available to view any time. Play the current day’s deal and replay it as many times as you’d like on that day. 
You can move cards with a single tap or drag them to their destination. You can either play the easy 1-suit games, or if you feel up-to the challenge, try your luck with 2-suit, 4-suit, or even Spiderette game modes.
=====FEATURES======
• Daily Challenges
• Winning Deals
• 1-Suit games (Easy)
• 2-Suit games (Medium)
• 4-Suit games (Hard)
• Standard spider solitaire rules and scoring
• Single tap to place a card or drag and drop
• Unlimited undos
• Smart hints show potentially useful moves
• Portrait or Landscape
• Left handed and Right handed option
• Interruption friendly with auto-save and resume
• Timer, moves, and statistics
• Fun and stunning winning animations
• Beautifully crafted and curated themes
• Universal app for iPhone, iPad, and iPod Touch
If you've ever played solitaire (also known as Patience or Klondike) or any of its variants such as Tri Peaks, FreeCell, Spiderette, Blackjack, Video Poker and other poker card games, then you are going to love spider solitaire classic! Play spider solitaire classic for free today!!

• You can turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase. 
• No cancellation of your subscription is allowed during the active subscription period.

bluejetty:00022768:ios.description:
Old school action RPG roguelike with manual combat.
Powerlust is an old school action RPG roguelike with manual combat and a dark atmosphere.
Completely free, no forced ads, no p2w.
Micro transactions are just donations with some cool cosmetic rewards like different camera perspectives (top down, TPP, FPP), camera filters, character customization and the bloodbath mode. There are also some quality of life features like a faster character specialization unlock and a shared item stash.
Made by one guy.
Hobby project made by one guy (me). I spent quite a few years on it already. No huge corporations involved :)
No rigid classes.
You can create your own class, nothing is locked, feel free to play as a fire mage wielding a two handed sword or a necro archer.
Tons of masteries and skills.
There is a vast number of options to choose from when it comes to spells, weapons, abilities and masteries. You can create a ton of builds and constantly find new ways of crushing your enemies!
Still in development
This game is under ACTIVE DEVELOPMENT, I have many updates planned for it. I'd appreciate any feedback, it will be a really huge help in further development. Check out my twitter for constant updates and share your thoughts via email at bartlomiejmamzergames@gmail.com
Features:

bluejetty:00185731:ios.name: Classic Solitaire: Patience
bluejetty:00185731:ios.summary: Solitaire Classic - also known as Klondike Solitaire, or Patience in Britain is one of the best-known card game around the world due to its simple rules and easy gameplay. It is a combination between puzzle and memory training game. In orde
bluejetty:00185731:ios.description:
Solitaire Classic - also known as Klondike Solitaire, or Patience in Britain is one of the best-known card game around the world due to its simple rules and easy gameplay. It is a combination between puzzle and memory training game. In order to win, you would need to deploy strategy, skills and a little bit of luck. This game is a great choice to play and train your brain in your free time.
The ultimate objective of Solitaire Classic is to move all the cards to 4 foundations (hearts, diamonds, clubs, spades) at the top left, construct four piles arranged in following order Ace, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, Jack, Queen and King. Aces would serve as basement in the foundation, whereas Kings are the topmost cards that complete the 4 foundations. 
There are 7 columns and from left to right, each column contains one more card than the previous. Cards are moved from column to column simply by single tap or simply dragging them in order from low to high and must be alternated between red and black. The reminder of the cards are face-down in the pile. 
Sequence and Foundation are all empty when a new game is begun.
Solitaire Classic: Klondike Card - FEATURES:
- Multiple game modes:
If you are a new player, choose Random Deal with basic game rules. Otherwise, Winning Deal and Vegas Deal would become good options for you to challenge your skills with others.
- Unlimited smart hints and free undos.
Solitaire Classic: Klondike Card Game is totally free to enjoy. So use hints whenever you get stuck and need any suggestion for next move.
- Customizable themes
There are 3 card faces, 2 card backs, 3 backgrounds and so on for you to change. Personalize themes to suit your taste in Solitaire Classic: Klondike Card.
- Daily challenges
Accomplish missions everyday to receive unique and exciting rewards. The more challenges you conquer, the more crowns you collect.
- Standard or Vegas scoring
We uphold the true spirit of Classic Klondike Solitaire and optimize user experience on mobiles. In Standard scoring (the default), you earn points based on time and moves; while in Vegas, your ante is $52 to start each game and earn $5 for each card moved to a suit stack.
- Complete with other players.
Race against friends or players from other countries and see your ranking on Leaderboard.
- Statistic trackers: 
Study your progress by tracking score, number of move and total time in each mode. 
- Left-handed mode
We support left-handed players to make everyone enjoy Solitaire without any boundary.
- Klondike Solitaire Draw 1 card or 3 cards.
Play Draw 1 games where it is almost easy to win, or try a memory training game with Draw 3 mode.
If you are a fan of poker, puzzle or memory training genre, don’t miss this super addictive and kid-friendly game. Play anytime to train your brain. Try the Solitaire Classic: Klondike Card for FREE!

bluejetty:00046168:ios.summary:
SPARQ AI is the Most Powerful Car Health Monitor that can help car owners predict vehicle breakdowns before they occur, preventing you from paying for expensive repairs. Powered by SPARQ's AI Model.
Compatible with vehicles 2010 and newer
bluejetty:00046168:ios.description:
SPARQ AI is the Most Powerful Car Health Monitor that can help car owners predict vehicle breakdowns before they occur, preventing you from paying for expensive repairs. Powered by SPARQ's AI Model.
Compatible with vehicles 2010 and newer manufactured for the US Market. Perform Remote Diagnostics, Diagnose more than 50,000 Trouble Codes, Monitor Real-Time Vehicle Condition, Access to SPARQ's Proprietary A.I. Car Health Scoring System, and additional features that give you control over your vehicle.
SPARQ's AI (Beta) is trained on automotive insights from manufacturers, car owners of the same vehicle, and first party data gathered from your car's trouble codes and driving behavior. Allowing SPARQ to provide a multitude of personalized car recommendations and predictions that are tailored based on your vehicle's present, past and future. 
Key Features
- Comprehensive Diagnostics. Ability to perform full comprehensive diagnostics on vehicles, including generic and manufacturer-specific codes.
- AI Powered Health Scoring System. Providing an overall rating of the user's vehicle based on the data that is collected from the user's car along with their driving patterns.
Individualized Car Component Health Status. A summary of the overall health status of major components of the user's car. Providing deeper insights into different vehicle systems in the car.
- Vehicle Records (Beta). Users can create registration, inspection, and service records and reminders on the SPARQ App. Providing users with a single destination point for their vehicle history, and future maintenance milestones.
- Vehicle Specs. Vehicle Specifications about the user's vehicle will be automatically populated by SPARQ. Allowing users to easily check on their vehicle specs, such as rim sizes, tire sizes, fuel data, etc...
- Multi-Vehicle Access. Users will be able to add multiple vehicles under their profile so they can have boundless access to their vehicles' information. Users will also be able to retrieve their car information without an active connection to SPARQ AI. However, a connection to the device is required to obtain Diagnostic Data from the vehicle.
Start Your Journey Today.

bluejetty:00169843:ios.summary: Welcome to Solitaire Daily: Card Game, where strategy meets relaxation in this timeless classic card game right on your device. Whether you're a classic solitaire enthusiast or new to the classic solitaire game, Solitaire Daily offers a smo
bluejetty:00169843:ios.description:
Welcome to Solitaire Daily: Card Game, where strategy meets relaxation in this timeless classic card game right on your device. Whether you're a classic solitaire enthusiast or new to the classic solitaire game, Solitaire Daily offers a smooth, engaging experience that has captivated players for centuries.
How to Play:
- Simple Card Sorting: To solve the Solitaire deal, you need to tap, drag or drop to sort cards of 4 suits - hearts, diamonds, spades and crosses in ascending order, Ace, 2, ... Jack, Queen, King. There is one deck - 52 cards in the classic Solitaire game.
- Column Options: You will have 7 card column options where you can move one card or consecutive cards from one column to another.
- Empty Columns: Move the King or any set of consecutive cards starting with a King to empty columns.
- Get Help: Stuck? Use the card stock to find the card you need to continue in this free solitaire experience.
Features You’ll Love:
- Classic Solitaire Gameplay: Experience traditional solitaire games with 1-card and 3-card draw modes for varying difficulty levels. Perfect for classic solitaire fans!
- Personalized Themes: Customize your solitaire game with beautiful card backs and background themes to make it uniquely yours.
- Mind-Challenging Puzzles: Tackle hundreds of unique challenges designed to test your skills in solitaire card games and provide hours of entertainment.
- Smart Hints & Unlimited Undos: Stuck on a move? Use unlimited hints and undos to find your way through the challenge and help you become a solitaire master.
- Daily Challenges: Start each day with a fresh daily challenge in solitaire games to improve your concentration, patience, and strategic thinking.
- Progress Tracking: Monitor your stats, including win rates, fastest completion times, and game history to track your improvement in solitaire card games.
- Intuitive Interface: Enjoy a smooth, user-friendly interface that’s easy for players of all ages to navigate.
Why Choose Solitaire Daily?
Solitaire Daily offers more than just card games. It's a moment of peace in your busy day. Perfect for unwinding, stimulating your brain, or simply enjoying a moment of solitude, this free solitaire app brings a mindful approach to the classic card game. Whether you're killing time on a lazy afternoon or sharpening your mind, Solitaire Master is the perfect companion. And it's totally free!
Accessible to Everyone:
Whether you're a seasoned Solitaire master or new to the solitaire card games, Solitaire Daily's intuitive gameplay and supportive features make it easy to pick up and impossible to put down.
If you like playing Classic Solitaire, Spider Solitaire, Spades, Tripeaks Solitaire, Pyramid Solitaire, FreeCell Solitaire, or any Patience Solitaire card game, then don't miss this free solitaire! Download the free solitaire card game available for your mobile device today!

bluejetty:00069909:ios.name: Assault Commander Rearmed
bluejetty:00069909:ios.summary: Assault Commander Rearmed is a turn-based military strategy game played on a hexagonal map. This game is the successor/reinterpretation of Assault Commander Ultimate with isometric 3D graphics, new player profile, research system, and updat
bluejetty:00069909:ios.description:
Assault Commander Rearmed is a turn-based military strategy game played on a hexagonal map. This game is the successor/reinterpretation of Assault Commander Ultimate with isometric 3D graphics, new player profile, research system, and updated artificial intelligence.
• Play the campaign's single player missions on 6 difficulty levels.
In the game, you command an army with the goal of capturing the enemy’s headquarters or destroying all enemy units. As you progress through the campaign, you will face larger maps and command more units and buildings.
• Use infantry, tanks, artillery, ships, and other units of modern warfare.
As you advance, you’ll be able to build a greater variety of units. Alongside ground units, you’ll eventually access fighter planes and warships.
• Improve properties of your units and buildings by researching upgrades.
In the game, every building and unit can be upgraded. You’ll collect coins during missions, which can be used for research upgrades, enhancing unit firepower or the production capacity of certain buildings.
• Request reinforcements from the central supply.
In later missions, reinforcements can be requested, though only occasionally. On higher difficulty levels, this may be essential to keep up with the enemy’s superior forces.
• Build and use packages to temporarily improve your units in tactical game.

listings.description:
Assault Commander Rearmed is a turn-based military strategy game played on a hexagonal map. This game is the successor/reinterpretation of Assault Commander Ultimate with isometric 3D graphics, new player profile, research system, and updated artificial intelligence.

• Play the campaign's single player missions on 6 difficulty levels.
In the game, you command an army with the goal of capturing the enemy’s headquarters or destroying all enemy units. As you progress through the campaign, you will face larger maps and command more units and buildings.

• Use infantry, tanks, artillery, ships, and other units of modern warfare.
As you advance, you’ll be able to build a greater variety of units. Alongside ground units, you’ll eventually access fighter planes and warships.

• Improve properties of your units and buildings by researching upgrades.
In the game, every building and unit can be upgraded. You’ll collect coins during missions, which can be used for research upgrades, enhancing unit firepower or the production capacity of certain buildings.

• Request reinforcements from the central supply.

bluejetty:00069144:ios.name: Vargo Anesthesia Mega App
bluejetty:00069144:ios.summary: The Vargo Anesthesia Mega App is a comprehensive, clinician-built platform designed to support anesthesia providers in both preoperative preparation and real-time clinical decision-making. Developed and refined over more than 15 years, the
bluejetty:00069144:ios.description:
The Vargo Anesthesia Mega App is a comprehensive, clinician-built platform designed to support anesthesia providers in both preoperative preparation and real-time clinical decision-making. Developed and refined over more than 15 years, the app integrates essential anesthesia, critical care, and perioperative content into one unified system.
Built for efficiency and clarity, the Mega App allows providers to quickly access high-value clinical information—whether preparing for a case, reviewing complex physiology, or managing time-sensitive situations in the operating room.
The Vargo Anesthesia Mega App brings together a wide range of core anesthesia resources, including:
Weight-Based Medication Dosing and Equipment Tables
Adult and pediatric dosing and equipment references designed for accuracy across a wide range of patient sizes
Cheat Sheets
High-yield summaries for rapid review of key anesthesia and critical care concepts
Pediatrics
Focused pediatric anesthesia guidance and considerations
Case Tips
Extensive, case-based insights across a broad range of surgical procedures
Regional Nerve Blocks & OB Regional
Practical guidance for regional anesthesia techniques, including obstetric applications
Drugs and Drips
Detailed pharmacology with dosing, mechanisms, and clinical application
Coagulopathies & Blood Management (TEG/ROTEM)
Focused content for complex perioperative and critical care scenarios
CABG (Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting)
Step-by-step guidance from setup through separation from bypass
Calculations & Clinical Tools
Essential calculations including tidal volume, weight-based dosing, and more
Max Local Anesthetic Calculator
Quick reference for safe dosing limits
Crisis Management
Immediate access to critical event management, including:
Local Anesthetic Toxicity (LA Max)
Malignant Hyperthermia (MH)
Blood / TEGs / ROTEM
Other high-risk intraoperative events
The app is structured for rapid navigation and real-time usability:
Clear, organized layout for quick access
Concise presentation of complex topics
Built to support decision-making under pressure
- All future updates and additions are included with a one-time purchase. There are no subscriptions or recurring fees.
- Designed for every level of the anesthesia care team.
***iCloud must be switched on to save personal notes.***
This application is intended for educational and clinical reference purposes only. It is designed to support—not replace—the independent judgment of qualified healthcare professionals. It does not diagnose, treat, or provide patient-specific medical advice. All information must be verified based on the individual patient and clinical context.

bluejetty:00062851:ios.description:
Word Crossy – Brain Word Game is a calm yet addictive word puzzle where word connect, crossword and word search all come together in one relaxing brain-training game.
Swipe to connect letters, build words, uncover hidden words and gently grow your vocabulary as you play.
Whether you love word games, classic crossword puzzles, word search, anagram word scrambles or light brain training, Word Crossy will feel like home.
Why you’ll love Word Crossy
● Relaxing word connect gameplay
Swipe to link letters, form words and fill crossword-style boards at your own pace. No rush, no stress – perfect for coffee breaks, commuting or winding down before bed.
● Travel the world with postcard scenes
Progress along a world map, unlock new chapters and collect passport-style stamps. Each area comes with cozy, postcard-like backgrounds so every word level feels like a tiny vacation.
● Weekly Events for extra rewards
Join limited-time word challenges built around simple, satisfying goals. Play during the week, collect event tokens and turn them into bonus coins, boosts and special prizes to help you progress.
● “Wonderful Day” daily progress track
Fill a light daily meter just by playing. Reach small milestones, light up your day and claim extra rewards for spending a few relaxing minutes in the game.
● Daily Challenge & Masterpiece Hunt
Solve a fresh word puzzle every day, then collect pieces of famous paintings to build your own in-game mini gallery. Play a quick daily level, grow your collection and show off your “masterpieces”.
● Hundreds of hours of handcrafted content
Enjoy thousands of carefully designed word levels with a smooth, gentle difficulty curve. No sudden spikes – just rewarding progression for fans of word games, word connect and crossword puzzles.
● Helpful boosts when you’re stuck
Use hints, shuffle and letter reveal to nudge yourself forward. You’ll never be stuck on a crossword board for long, so the game stays relaxing instead of frustrating.
● Polished for iPhone and iPad
Clean fonts, readable layouts and a refined UI designed to feel comfortable on both iPhone and iPad, whether you play in short bursts or long sessions.
● Multi-language support
Play your word game in English, French, German, Spanish, Italian and more. Great for both native speakers and players who want a gentle vocabulary workout.
If you’re looking for a relaxing word game that mixes word connect, crossword and word search with beautiful scenes and light brain training, Word Crossy – Brain Word Game is for you.
Give your brain a friendly workout, relax with words and start your Word Crossy journey today.
Download free and see where your words take you.
Subscription Terms
We offer multiple auto-renewing subscription options (for example Weekly, Monthly, Yearly). The exact price for each option is shown in the app before purchase and may vary by region.
Subscriptions auto-renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. After purchase, you can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.game-division.net/privacy.html

Doccle is your digital administration assistant. You receive all your important documents from different companies together on this platform. You can easily pay, sign or share the documents. * Notification every time a new document is available to you
* Permanent access to all your important documents
* Documents are kept as long as you want them to be
* Easy and secure payment of invoices via your trusted bank
* Payment reminder when the due date approaches
* Sign documents legally

* Forward documents to other people or to your accountant.
* Doccle is secure and free
* Doccle is available in Belgium and the Netherlands.
