bluejetty:00165286:ios.description:
BestMate is the #1 all-in-one app for managing and growing your entire business. More than 10,000 businesses trust BestMate to increase sales, save time, and streamline their operations on one powerful platform—available on mobile and desktop.
Create invoices, send estimates, answer calls with an AI receptionist, collect payments, schedule time, 24/7 portal & website, send & receive text messages, manage team, log expenses and much more – all in one place. 
Bestmate automates and makes running your small business easy, fast and secure – all on the cloud accessible anywhere, anytime, any platform.
INVOICES, ESTIMATES, & WORK ORDERS
• Create Invoices, Estimates, and Work Orders / Bookings in less than one minute.
• Send emails, messages & automated reminders to customers.
• Allow customers to pay invoices online. 
• Collect payments and track all your invoices in one place.
AI RECEPTIONIST
• Answer business calls automatically, including after-hours and missed calls.
• Collect customer and job details during every conversation.
• Schedule appointments directly into your business calendar.
• Review call details and follow up with customers from BestMate.
SCHEDULING & BOOKING
• Manage appointments & bookings with customers on your app.
• Track your bookings with calendar view of upcoming appointment
• Attach customer details, notes, etc
• Reminders and emails sent automatically to customers
PAYMENT PROCESSING & TRANSACTIONS
• Get paid faster with online payment processing
• Accept credit card, debit card, cash and bank ACH processing
• Keep track of all your online & cash transactions
• Multi-currency functionality
CRM - CUSTOMER & SUPPLIER MANAGEMENT
• Add customers and suppliers in app
• Track past invoices & estimates with one tap to know their history
• Add notes & details about customers
• Deliver a great customer experience
• Get more insights with dashboard and analytics
WEBSITE & BOOKING PORTAL
• Branded Website: Branded website created automatically for your business to share with customers
• Customer portal: Customers can schedule bookings, approve estimates, pay invoices with an online booking portal
TEXT MESSAGING
• 2-way text messaging: Send & receive texts from customers. Attach invoice & estimate links to texts
TEAM MANAGEMENT
• Smooth team collaboration: Assign tasks and schedules to team members, share invoice details, and track time and expenses 
TAXES & REPORTING
• In-depth reports for profit & loss, invoices, estimates, schedules, requests, timesheets, expenses
• File taxes automatically & manage accounts perfectly
• Integrations with accounting software 
EXPENSES, TIMESHEETS, & INVENTORY MANAGEMENT
• Manage expenses and timesheets
• Create and keep track of products and services.
• Add inventory to each item to organize your business
AND MORE FEATURES 
Automatic Reminders, Integrations, Data Synced to Cloud, On-the-go Mobile & Web App, Transactions, Dashboard, Analytics, and many more!
Download Bestmate today and change the way you work.

Designed for both
bluejetty:00074282:ios.description:
Sleep Better with Guva – White Noise & Soothing Sounds for All Ages
Struggling with sleep? Whether you’re a tired parent soothing a restless baby or an adult seeking deep relaxation, Guva is your ultimate sleep companion.
Designed for both babies and adults, Guva provides a collection of calming white noise, gentle lullabies, and relaxing melodies to help you fall asleep faster and stay asleep longer. Block out distractions, reduce stress, and create the perfect sleep environment with just a tap.
Why Guva?
For Babies & Kids: Comfort your little one with gentle lullabies, soothing shushes, and rhythmic white noise.
For Adults: Relax with nature sounds, ambient noise, and soft music to unwind after a long day.
Works Offline: No internet? No problem. Use Guva anywhere—even in Airplane Mode.
-Loops:
One of the best ways to counteract irritating background noises is to simply mask them with another, “whiter” noise.
-Music:
Try different musics to mix with your loops to find out which helps you fall asleep.
-Shushes:
If you've spent hours shushing your baby to sleep, you'll want to try this , which provides the rhythmic, soothing shushing sound for you.
-Lullabies:
Sometimes all a baby needs for a perfect night's sleep is a little music.
-Records:
Save your family's favorite Soothing and Calming sounds.
-Animations:
Guva also displays soothing animation while it's playing. The images serve as a calming night-light that can help kids fall asleep.
-Night Light:
Uses your phone's screen to provide a soft and gentle light with colors.
-Tips:
Learn the experts secrets for helping your baby get a good night's sleep
How it works:
• Select sleeping sounds and combine them to create a mix that you love.
• Adjust the volume of each sound individually to find the perfect mix.
• Set a timer and Night Light if you like.
• Get your baby to sleep in minutes
• Includes Animations for toddlers
Features:
• Thousands of combinations for sound mixes
• Easily Save your Mixes for Later Use
• 104 High Quality Ambient sounds to Choose and Mix
• 68 High Quality Soothing Music Tracks
• 10 Shush Sounds
• 18 Lullabies from Allover the World
• 15 Recording Spots
• 8 Animations with sleeping melodies for toddlers
• Night Light Option
• Individual volume adjustment to mix sounds
• Timer feature to set a duration when you go to sleep
• AirPlay Supported

bluejetty:00065386:ios.description:
Learn Trading Faster with Real Market Practice
Most traders don’t fail because they lack information.
They fail because they never get enough real practice.
Trader Trainer is the fastest way to build trading skill — without risking money.
Practice real market scenarios using historical data from over 10,000 stocks, and train your ability to read charts, manage risk, and execute trades just like in live markets.
Instead of watching videos or guessing with real money, you learn by doing.
New: Learn — 22 Hands-On Lessons
Learn takes you from reading candles to trading setups and indicators, one lesson at a time. Each lesson teaches a skill, tests you on real charts, then grades your practice trades on the rules, not the profit. Earn a badge for every lesson you finish.
Practice Real Setups — Not Random Charts
Most simulators give you random charts. Trader Trainer lets you train specific setups on demand.
Start directly at confirmed breakout scenarios and practice how to:
- Enter at the right moment
- Manage risk
- Stay disciplined under pressure
Spend less time searching and more time executing.
What You Actually Get Better At
Trader Trainer is designed to help you improve the skills that actually matter:
- Reading price action in real time
- Executing entries and exits with discipline
- Managing risk with stop losses and position sizing
- Identifying which strategies work best for you
Discover Your Edge
Track your performance across every trade:
- Win rate
- Average gain and loss
- Drawdowns
- Holding time
- Strategy performance
Stop guessing. Start knowing what works.
How It Works
- Replay historical charts candle by candle
- Place trades as if the market is live
- Use real indicators and drawing tools
- Practice without financial risk
It’s like a flight simulator for traders.
Built for All Levels
New traders:
Learn faster by getting real reps without risking money.
Experienced traders:
Refine your strategy, test setups, and sharpen execution.
Why Traders Choose Trader Trainer
Because watching content doesn’t build skill.
Practice does.
Key Features
- Learn
22 hands-on lessons across Foundations, The Process, Setups and Indicators, with graded practice on real charts
- Setup-based practice
Train breakouts, mean reversions, uptrend dips, bull flags, downtrend rips, dead cat bounces, and support breakdown setups and real trading scenarios on demand
- Real market data
10,000+ historical stocks with realistic price action
- Accelerated learning
Simulate weeks of trading in minutes
- Full indicator suite
MACD, RSI, VWAP, Bollinger Bands, Ichimoku, SuperTrend and more
- Advanced drawing tools
Trend lines, Fibonacci, support and resistance
- Trade analytics
Measure your performance and find your edge
- Challenge mode
Grow a virtual portfolio and level up as a trader
Free to start: practice 10 random stocks a day and take the four Foundations lessons. Premium unlocks every setup mode, all 22 lessons and unlimited practice. The annual plan starts with a one-week free trial.
If you’re serious about improving as a trader, you need more than information.
You need practice.
Download Trader Trainer and start building real trading skill today.

bluejetty:00160482:ios.description:
Nodeshifter is a modern, roguelike arcade game that pits you against an invading horde of Kryptorians in the single most deadly offensive launched against the forces of humankind — through the computer! So get your power gloves out because you’ve been approved to pilot a state-of-the-art Nodeshifter digital vessel. 
Each Nodeshifter comes fully equipped with a rapidly orbiting Node capable of summoning destruction at a scale the likes of which has been heretofore unseen. Ok so maybe the Nodeshifter isn't exactly that advanced… and yes maybe the weapon systems are a little crude but don’t worry along the way you will pick up a number of upgrades to make smashing aliens easier. Sure, it may be in pixels, but that doesn’t make it any less metal.
To become a Star Defender pilot takes guts, skill, and bravery. But if you are selected to be a part of this elite alien fighting space force then your name will be etched in the stars of valor forever.
Power-Up Your Play Style: Acquire unique and game-changing Enhancements for your Shifter that will dramatically alter your strategy and play style for the run. Try out new combinations for punishing results.
Even Loss is Progress: Pick up Saalt from your fallen foes to purchase Cassettes that will give you a competitive advantage in future runs. These power-ups are permanent upgrades that can be chosen to better fit your uniquely preferred play style and preference.
New Paths of Destruction Every Time: Every level of Nodeshifter is dynamically generated so that your pixel carnage is fresh every time you play. It’s so timeless, it’s practically undead!
A Unique World to Explore: I mean, “explore” is a loaded word here, but there’s a story and everything. And it kinda rules?
Think you have what it takes to beat the hardest game known to mankind? Join the journey of a galactic lifetime and download Nodeshifter today!

bluejetty:00129211:ios.name: 55688 Taiwan Taxi
bluejetty:00129211:ios.summary: The APP lets users view recent ride records, rate drivers, and save favorite drivers. In addition to cash, it supports nearly 30 payment methods, including linked credit cards, LINE Pay, Easy Wallet, Business Account Service, EasyCard, JKOP
bluejetty:00129211:ios.description:
The APP lets users view recent ride records, rate drivers, and save favorite drivers. In addition to cash, it supports nearly 30 payment methods, including linked credit cards, LINE Pay, Easy Wallet, Business Account Service, EasyCard, JKOPay, Pi Wallet, Taiwan Pay, and more for a seamless payment experience!
【Book a Ride in the APP - No Need to Wait for a Phone Line】
• GPS Booking: If your device has an accurate GPS signal, the APP can locate you and find nearby addresses for easy booking.
• Address Booking: Enter your pick-up and drop-off addresses directly.
• Trip History Booking: Rebook using addresses from previous trip records.
• Book for Others: Book a ride for family or friends. The passenger can pay, or you can pay with your linked payment method.
• Nearby Landmark Search: Search attractions or business names and quickly book by landmark location, such as "Taipei 101."
• Favorites: Save frequently used pick-up addresses or landmarks for quick booking.
• Airport Drop-off: Schedule airport drop-off in advance.
【Diversified Taxis - Taxis That Are Not Yellow】
• Diversified taxi services offer more choices and better quality.
• Options include comfort, Luxury, and 6-seater business class to suit different travel needs.
• Services include on-demand rides, scheduled rides, and airport drop-off.
• Once your scheduled ride is confirmed, the APP will remind you before your trip. You can also tap "My > Reservation" to view booking details.
【24/7 Satellite Trip Monitoring - Ride with Peace of Mind and Arrive Quickly】
• Vehicle Location: Check the vehicle's real-time location during the ride.
• Share Trip: Share your trip with family or friends so they can see your vehicle information and current location.
• Lost Item Assistance: Contact the driver through the APP after your most recent trip to recover belongings.
• Ride Records: Keep recent trip times and routes for easy follow-up.
【More Features - Safe, Comfortable, and Thoughtful】
• Linked payment methods help you get off quickly without needing change.
• In-vehicle payments also support physical credit cards, EasyCard, Senior Citizens / Disability Cards, and third-party QR code payments.
• Driver Information: View dispatch information and call the driver directly if needed.
• Driver Ratings: Rate your driver and help us improve.
• Fare Estimate: Enter your drop-off address before booking to estimate the fare.
【Service Coverage - Across Taiwan】
• Taiwan Taxi provides service across Taiwan, with 55688 ride-booking services gradually expanding to outlying islands.
【About Taiwan Taxi - Taiwan Taxi Co,. LTD.】
Taiwan Taxi is a leading taxi brand, combining satellite dispatch, real-time map data, traffic information, and 24-hour trip monitoring to provide safe and reliable transportation services.

Use Later’s social media management app to create content on the go for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Pinterest, LinkedIn, & Twitter/X.
SAVE MORE TIME by shooting & editing posts for all platforms while you’re on the go. Save your ideas as drafts, then schedule them to automatically post whenever you want.
REUSE YOUR BEST POSTS on your other social networks for easy content. Just make a few tweaks & re-schedule them right in the app.
GET MORE ENGAGEMENT with Best Time to Post recommendations. Schedule posts during precise date & time windows and watch the likes roll in!
REACH NEW FOLLOWERS with unique Hashtag Suggestions tailored to your audience. We’ll supply the best hashtags, all you have to do is click to add them to your caption.
CREATE, EDIT, & SCHEDULE WITH LATER SOCIAL!
IG: @latermedia
GROW ON SOCIAL WITH THESE LATER TOOLS:
- SCHEDULING FOR ALL SOCIAL NETWORKS: Save time and use the Later mobile app to schedule to Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Linkedin, Twitter/X, and Pinterest. 
- COPY POSTS: Duplicate a post (even if it’s already been published!), make updates, and schedule it again on any platform. 
- DRAFT POSTS FOR ALL SOCIAL NETWORKS: Streamline your posting process by drafting your post ideas directly in Later Social and schedule to post whenever you’re ready.
- BEST TIME TO POST FOR INSTAGRAM: Later learns when your Instagram followers are most engaged, and gives you scheduling suggestions that are unique to your audience and can be accessed directly on the calendar.
- HASHTAG SUGGESTIONS FOR INSTAGRAM: Increase engagement on your posts by adding Hashtag Suggestions recommended by the Later mobile app.
- MEDIA LIBRARY: Add content to your Media Library and it’ll sync across Later’s desktop and mobile apps, so you can upload or download directly to your device and schedule content from anywhere.
- VISUAL PLANNER: Get a preview of your Instagram feed with the Visual Planner — just drag & drop posts to rearrange the posting order.
- SCHEDULE FIRST COMMENT: Keep the clutter out of your caption by organizing your hashtags in the automatically posted first comment.
- INSTAGRAM REELS & TIKTOK AUTO PUBLISHING: Plan your video content ahead of time and schedule them to automatically publish at a set time without any further action or notifications required. 
- MULTI-PROFILE SCHEDULING (iOS ONLY): Get your posts prepped quickly by starting with a single post and customizing it for each platform.
https://later.com/terms/

bluejetty:00149844:ios.description:
Are you ready for a fast-paced Warplane battles?
Hero Wings - delivers the most intense free to play action game. Build, upgrade, team up and compete. Survive epic fast-paced 3v3 multiplayer battles. Become the strongest and fastest pilot and destroy the enemy team! Select your fighter from different designs and powers. Choose your primary and special weapons from the great selection including: machineguns, missiles, cannons, shotguns, laser, frost and quantum weapons.
FEATURES
COSTOMIZE THE STRONGEST WARPLANE - Outsmart your enemies by picking the right combination of aircrafts, weapons and characters. You can create your own warplane with unique skins to stand out and show off on the battlefield!
DIFFERENT 3V3 GAME MODES - Snatch: squad up against the opposing team. Grab and hold gems to win.
Bounty: in under three minutes destroy enemies to earn points, the team with the most points is the winner!
CHESTS - With every victory earn chests to unlock rewards, discover powerful new cards and upgrade existing ones. Build your card collection. This is your chance to be one step ahead of your enemies.
MASTER YOUR ABILITIES - The game is easy to learn, but hard to master! Fighters with different speed, armor and weapons. Practice to control them like a pro to decide the course of the battle.
Progress through numerous arenas. Level up your ranks to earn different prizes.
Play free anytime and anywhere!
A steady internet connection required.

bluejetty:00152040:ios.description:
Remy Network is a free, ad-supported streaming app by Grammy-nominated artist Remy Ma. Enjoy original series, reality shows, documentaries, music specials, live concerts, sports, and more — all celebrating hip-hop culture and authentic storytelling. Creators can also share their work and grow their own channels. 
Dive in to premium branded experiences and discover curated channels and entertainment with Remy Network’s Culture Hub.
Users of this application can subscribe to optional auto-renewing subscriptions for Remy Network Premium to obtain access to additional features. Should you choose to subscribe, please be aware that it will automatically renew each month and your credit card will be charged through your iTunes account. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period at the subscription cost agreed upon at the time of the original auto-renewing subscription purchase. You can turn off auto-renew at anytime from your iTunes account settings but it must be turned off at least 24 hours before the end of a current period to avoid being charged for that time period. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during an active subscription period. Please go to https://www.remynetwork.com/privacy and https://www.remynetwork.com/terms for more information.
Auto-renewing subscriptions available in this app include:
Remy Network Premium - 3.99 per Month

bluejetty:00022648:ios.name: Insta360
bluejetty:00022648:ios.summary: Insta360 cameras and handheld gimbals give creators, athletes and adventurers tools to create like they’ve never created. Whether you’re upping your shooting game with an Insta360 cameras, the Insta360 app is a creative powerhouse in your p
bluejetty:00022648:ios.description:
Insta360 cameras and handheld gimbals give creators, athletes and adventurers tools to create like they’ve never created. Whether you’re upping your shooting game with an Insta360 cameras, the Insta360 app is a creative powerhouse in your pocket that acts as your camera’s sidekick. Let AI do the work with auto editing tools and templates, or dial in on your edit with a host of manual controls. Editing on your phone has never been easier. 
New Album Page Layout
Thumbnails now automatically uses the best angle to easily identify and manage files.
AI Edit
AI can handle the entire reframing process! Sit back and let your action highlights make themselves, now faster with improved subject detection for even easier editing.
Shot Lab
Shot Lab is home to tons of AI-powered editing templates that help you create viral clips in just a few taps. Discover over 25 templates, including Nose Mode, Sky Swap, AI Warp and Clone Trail!
Reframing
The creative possibilities are endless with easy 360 reframing tools in the Insta360 app. Tap to add a keyframe and change the perspective of your footage.
Deep Track
Whether a person, animal, or a moving object, keep the subject centered in your shot with a single tap!
Hyperlapses
Speed up your videos to create a stabilized hyperlapse in just a few taps. Adjust the speed of your clip on a whim—you have full control over time and perspective. 
Download-Free Editing
Edit and share your clips to social media without downloading them to your phone first! Save your phone’s storage space and edit clips while you’re on the go.
Please feel free to reach out to us at any time!
Official website: www.insta360.com (you can also download the Studio desktop software and the latest firmware updates)
Official customer service email: service@insta360.com
Plus, discover the best content from creators around the world in the Insta360 app! Find new video ideas, learn from tutorials, share content, interact with your favorite creators, and more. Download now and start exploring!
Here are the Insta360+Privacy Policy and Insta360+ User Service Agreement
Insta360+Privacy Policy: https://www.insta360.com/support/supportcourse?post_id=20767&utm_source=app_oner
Insta360+ User Service Agreement: https://www.insta360.com/support/supportcourse?post_id=20768&utm_source=app_oner
If you would like to share feedback about our app, please search for the "Insta360 Official" account in the app private message system, and send us a private message after following.

bluejetty:00098557:ios.description:
Find the Imposter among your friends!
From the creators of #1 Charades in US.
Spy – The Ultimate Party Game of Deception and Deduction!
Gather your friends, sharpen your wits, and dive into Spy—the exhilarating group game of mystery, subtlety, and clever deduction! Perfect for parties, casual gatherings, family nights, or even breaking the ice with new friends, Spy transforms any setting into a thrilling game of hidden identities and cunning strategy. All you need is one iPhone and your closest allies—or rivals!
How Does It Work?
The concept is simple, yet the challenge is real: you're either a Local who knows the secret location, or you're the Spy, trying desperately to blend in. But there's a twist—Spies only see a vague theme (like “Vacation Spots” or “Famous Landmarks”), while Locals know exactly where they are.
Gameplay That's Easy to Learn, Yet Hard to Master
1) Quick Set-Up: Choose your theme, the number of players, spies, and the playing time—then let the game handle the rest.
2) Secret Identities: Pass the device around to secretly view your role. Are you a confident Local or the elusive Spy?
3) Interrogate and Investigate: Take turns asking subtle, strategic questions about the location. "Is it noisy there?" or "Would you wear sandals there?" The Spy listens intently, searching for clues, while Locals try not to give away too much.
4) Suspicion and Strategy: Think you've spotted the Spy? Call a vote—but beware! Accusing wrongly means victory for the Spy.
5) Daring Guess: If you're the Spy, feeling brave, and confident you've cracked the code, you can guess the location outright. A correct guess brings victory, but fail, and the Locals celebrate your defeat!
Socialize, Strategize, and Outsmart!
Spy is more than just a game—it’s a way to connect, laugh, and challenge each other. Every round is filled with hilarious suspicion, clever misdirection, and surprising reveals that will have your group on the edge of their seats. Whether you're at a party, out with friends, or spending time with family, Spy guarantees unforgettable moments and endless laughter.
Can you uncover the truth—or will you deceive everyone around you?
Download Spy now and let the intrigue begin!

bluejetty:00074094:ios.description:
Unpuzzle: The Ultimate 3D Block and Parking Puzzle Game!
Get ready to become the Parking Master in Unpuzzle! This engaging block puzzle game combines the challenge of traffic jam puzzles and tap away block mechanics to create a unique gaming experience. Your mission? Solve tricky car parking jams, slide cars to clear the way, and master the art of the tap away 3D gameplay. Whether you’re a fan of wooden block puzzles or addicted to car out challenges, Unpuzzle has something for everyone!
How to Play:
Car Out! Remove cars by sliding them out of the parking jam in the direction indicated. Each move matters as you navigate the car parking game to free the vehicles trapped in a chaotic traffic jam. Can you become the Car Master 3D?
Tap and Slide Blocks Tackle levels by tapping on blocks and cars, moving them out of the way to clear the path. This isn't just another block puzzle—it’s a strategic brain workout wrapped in a fun and satisfying puzzle game.
Rotate for Solutions Rotate the view to find the best approach to solve the puzzle block challenges. Master the tap out gameplay by using your brain to think ahead and plan each move.
Boosters & Power-Ups Use bombs, hammers, and other tools to help you clear super-hard car parking levels. These power-ups are crucial for becoming the ultimate car traffic solver!
Main Features:
Challenging Brain Games Test your strategic thinking with every tap and slide. The more you play, the better you become at solving these parking jam challenges, sharpening your mind in the process.
Unique Levels Dive into endless block puzzle games with a variety of intricate layouts. From simple car out games to complex traffic puzzle scenarios, every level offers a fresh challenge.
Realistic 3D Gameplay The car parking game levels are brought to life with stunning 3D visuals. Enjoy a more immersive parking order experience as you navigate through multiple car parking games.
Compete and Conquer Race against the clock and other players in our parking master levels. Prove you’re the best in car out car parking jam 3D and earn your spot on the leaderboards!
Offline Play Take Unpuzzle with you wherever you go. No internet? No problem! Enjoy this tap away experience anytime, anywhere.
Why Choose Unpuzzle?
Brain Training Master Unpuzzle isn’t just another sliding puzzle—it’s a full-fledged brain training app. Perfect for fans of blocks games, cube block puzzles, and anyone looking to boost their strategic skills.
Stress Relief Unwind with each level as you solve traffic jam puzzles and clear the car out challenges. The simple mechanics combined with satisfying gameplay provide the perfect escape from daily stress.
Family-Friendly Fun Suitable for all ages, Unpuzzle is the perfect car parking and block puzzle experience for everyone. Whether you’re an adult honing your strategy skills or a kid enjoying a fun parking game, there’s something for every puzzle lover.
Customization Options Personalize your experience with a variety of car and block skins. Make each level uniquely yours as you tackle parking jam challenges in style.
Endless Gameplay With thousands of unique car parking and block puzzle levels, there’s no end to the challenges you’ll face. New puzzles and layouts keep the game fresh and exciting.
Ready to Master the Puzzle?
Download Unpuzzle today and dive into the ultimate block puzzle and parking jam 3D experience. Whether you’re tapping away wooden blocks, sliding cars in traffic puzzles, or racing against other players in parking games, Unpuzzle offers endless fun and a serious test of your skills. Become the Car Master, solve the traffic jam, and enjoy one of the best car parking games out there.
Are you ready to clear the way? Tap, slide, and become the Unpuzzle legend now!

bluejetty:00092946:ios.description:
Times are changing – Christianity remains. Enhance your spiritual journey with artificial intelligence. Unlock the transformative potential of generative AI while staying connected to your Christian beliefs, fostering a harmonious integration of technology and spirituality.
- Get instant answers
- Free Bible Reader—Multiple Bible versions including KJV, BSB, and Nova Vulgata; bookmark verses, take notes, and deepen your understanding.
- Image generation—simply describe your vision, and our Christian AI model creates a picture
- Voice chat—talk naturally using your voice or microphone, and hear responses spoken back or shown in text. It can also read any text aloud for you
- AI web search—find accurate, real-time information on any topic
- Listen to a Bible Podcast to deepen your understanding of Scripture
- Fun, interactive Bible Quiz—study the Bible like never before!
- Free up time for other activities
- Harness the power of AI through a Christian lens
- Notes: Rapidly dictate or write polished articles, essays, blogs, emails, and comments. Built-in AI refines grammar, elevates style, and translates.
- Get personalized guidance and support
- Use for free or buy a subscription
AI will play an ever growing role in the future – don't get left behind in the digital revolution. Through advanced algorithms and machine learning, Christian AI provides personalized insights, content generation and guidance that align with your faith.
Featuring an advanced AI image generator that transforms your ideas into divine digital art, paintings, drawings and photos. Harnessing state-of-the-art machine learning technology, our tool creates inspirational visuals, faith-based graphics, and spiritually uplifting pictures designed to bring your Bible stories, sermons, and prayers to life. 
Bible Reader:
Our Bible Reader is completely free to use and designed for Christians of all backgrounds. Choose from multiple Bible versions tailored to your tradition—such as the King James Version (KJV), Berean Standard Bible (BSB), and the Nova Vulgata (English translation for Catholics).
Bookmark your favorite verses, write personal notes, and revisit passages anytime. It's ideal for daily devotionals, sermon prep, or in-depth Bible study. Seamlessly integrated with our Christian AI platform, it supports your spiritual growth by combining timeless Scripture with modern technology.
Accessible offline and always free, our Bible Reader helps you stay rooted in God's Word.
About the Voice Chat Feature:
The voice chat functionality offers a hands-free, interactive way to engage with the Christian AI model. Whether you're asking spiritual questions, requesting Scripture readings, or just exploring new ideas, you can speak directly to the AI and hear clear, friendly spoken responses. It also reads selected Bible passages or text aloud, making it a perfect companion for on-the-go learning, prayer, or devotion. This makes your experience more natural, accessible, and enriching—just like having a helpful, faith-based assistant with you at all times.
AI-Powered Web Search: A Smarter Way to Discover Christian Truths Online
Explore the world through intelligent AI-powered web search that delivers fast, relevant, and reliable information. Whether you're researching biblical history, exploring current events, comparing products, or answering everyday questions, this feature pulls from trusted sources across the internet to bring you accurate, up-to-date results. With natural language understanding and powerful search capabilities, you can ask complex questions or simple queries and get clear answers tailored to your needs. It's like having a smart research assistant by your side—ready to help with both spiritual topics and practical day-to-day inquiries.

bluejetty:00118960:ios.description:
Docusign eSignature is the world’s #1 way for businesses and individuals to securely send and sign agreements from practically anywhere, at any time, from almost any device. The Docusign app is easy to use, includes unlimited free signing for all parties, and is trusted by millions of people worldwide.
HOW DOCUSIGN WORKS | e-Sign PDFs, forms, and contracts on the go.
• Step 1: Create your customized digital signature directly on your device.
• Step 2: Upload documents easily via email, Google Drive, DropBox, Box, Evernote, Salesforce, or photo scanning.
• Step 3: E-sign your documents for free with no monthly limit.
STREAMLINED, SIMPLIFIED MANAGEMENT | Send and monitor agreements straight from your device.
• Step 1: Import files to prepare and send them out for signature.
• Step 2: Prepare your document with “Sign Here” tags that show precisely where to sign, initial, or add additional information and invite others to sign.
• You can set the signing order and workflow for multiple signers.
• Docusign supports both in-person and remote signing.
• Responsive signing functionality automatically adapts documents for mobile to the size and orientation of the signer’s device.
• Step 3: Remind signers to sign with a single tap or void a document that has already been sent for signature.
• Step 4: Receive real-time push notifications when a document has been signed.
E-SIGNATURE THROUGH DOCUSIGN IS LEGAL AND SECURE.
Docusign’s complies with the eSign Act, which means:
• Agreements are legally binding.
• There is a complete audit trail to track who signed when and where.
• Documents are encrypted; this is safer and more secure than paper.
• Docusign is ISO 27001 SSAE16 compliant.
Docusign’s free eSignature app supports multiple document types and formats, including:

bluejetty:00045125:ios.description:
Cape Cod 5 Mobile Banking is a free app that allows you to bank at any time, from anywhere on your iOS device. Available to all Cape Cod 5 customers, use the mobile banking app to: check account balances, view transaction history, deposit checks, make transfers, pay bills, manage your budget, set ATM/debit card controls and more! Need account support? Contact the Cape Cod 5 customer support team using the secure messaging conversations feature directly within the app. You can also find Cape Cod 5 locations near you. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
ADDITIONAL FEATURES
Built-In Budgeting Tools: Create a plan, budget to meet your financial goals and track your progress from within the app with Personal Financial Management tools
Integrated Debit Card Controls & Travel Notices: Manage debit/ATM card security controls 
Alerts & Notifications: Set account alerts to be notified when certain activity occurs on your account.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact/Support: Message Cape Cod 5 customer service directly from within the app for account-related assistance. Locate Cape Cod 5 ATMs or Banking Centers.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same level of security that protects you when you’re on Online Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED

bluejetty:00176431:android.description:
Embark on an adventure in Stranded Island: Survival Games, where you're stranded on an archipelago. As a castaway, survival hinges on exploration of the island survival games, resource management, and thrilling rescue missions on the survival games. As the ultimate castaway, explore lush landscapes, aid survivors, and build a vibrant community. 
Delve deep into the forest island's mysteries and master the art of rescue in survival games. Craft a seaworthy boat to explore the archipelago and save fellow castaways. As an island castaway stranded deep on a wild island, your fate rests in your hands.
Gather resources, craft new buildings, rescue new team members and explore the sea in the island survival games
🏝 Island Survival:
Navigate through the untamed beauty of the island games, discovering hidden resources crucial for your survival. Adapt to the environment and master the art of crafting tools, shelters, and weapons to brave the dangers of the island survival games.
⛵ Castaway Rescue:
Rescue scattered survivors in the island survival games, collaborate with your island games team and put your efforts together to build a boat, explore the islands of the archipelago, gather resources and build your survival games village! 
🥥 Stranded Island Challenges:
Face unique challenges specific to each island in the archipelago, always new tasks in the island survival games - gather crafting resources, get fruits to cook for your castaway island games team, mine in the depths of a cave, and cut through wild vegetation!
🏡 Build your village:
Help your fellow castaways by rebuilding their homes in the survival games - build, ,craft, upgrade and decorate your stranded island village and bring it to its full glory!
Prepare to craft and collect in the island survival games, find the rest of your crew and expand your settlement!
If you're looking for island games & survival games then Stranded Island: Survival Games is the one for you! Test your survival skills, rescue your castaway team, explore the island games and experience the thrill of island survival games! Can you turn your castaway story into an epic tale of survival and rescue? Find out in this captivating survival games adventure!

bluejetty:00154129:ios.description:
Transform Your Mind with "BrainBloom" – The Ultimate Brain Training Experience
Designed for users of all ages, "BrainBloom" combines neuroscience-based exercises with engaging gameplay to sharpen cognitive skills. Here’s what makes us stand out:
1. Daily Personalized Training
 - Receive a tailored 4-game workout plan each day, targeting memory, problem-solving, math, and focus.
 - Games adapt dynamically based on performance, ensuring continuous growth.
2. 24+ Scientifically-Designed Games
 - Explore four categories: Memory (e.g., pattern recall), Problem-Solving (logic puzzles), Math (mental arithmetic), and Focus (attention drills).
 - Inspired by proven cognitive models like the Stroop effect and neural plasticity research.
3. Challenging Puzzle Adventures
 - Conquer escalating levels in Sort Puzzles, One-Stroke Drawing, and more.
 - Perfect for post-training sessions to stretch your critical thinking.
4. Smart Progress Analytics
 - Visualize growth with interactive 4D skill graphs and weekly reports.
 - Track accuracy, speed, and milestones across all games.
5. Achievements & Rewards
 - Unlock badges for streaks, high scores, and skill mastery.
 - Compete with friends and share progress via the Profile Hub.
Why Choose "BrainBloom"?
- Evidence-Based Design: Games rooted in cognitive psychology and neuroscience.
- Adaptive Difficulty: Algorithms adjust challenges to match your skill level.
- Engaging & Fun: Vibrant visuals, soothing soundscapes, and addictive gameplay loops.
Download Now and Start Your Brain Transformation Journey!

listings.description:
Think fast. Type faster. Have the last word!
Dive into The Last Word—a live, multiplayer word-puzzle battle royale where every millisecond counts. Unscramble letters, outwit real opponents, and survive round after round of lightning-quick challenges. It’s the ultimate blend of word games, brain training, and competitive action—all in one free download!

Battle Mode (real-time multiplayer)
Instant 5-Player Showdowns – Everyone solves the same puzzle at the same time. Winner takes all!
Battle-Royale Tournaments – Advance through escalating rounds until only one wordsmith remains and takes home the trophy.
Global Matchmaking – Face off against friends or foes from around the world—no waiting, no turn-based play.

Friend Challenge Mode (2-Player)
Think fast, type faster—because friends make the best rivals!
Invite a friend or family member to race you through the same puzzle.
Finish first, collect rewards, and brag your way up the leaderboard!

Solo Mode (single player)
Practice any time–even offline–then jump back into Battle Mode!
Race against the clock, beat your best time, and compare your scores to players around the world!

Fast & Varied Puzzles
Word Hive, Word Bridge, Word Dash, Word Pool, and more—no two rounds play alike.
Tackle classic word styles like scrambles and anagrams, or spread your wings with fresh twists like Word Bridge and Word Hive.

Climb the Leaderboards
Earn coins, XP, trophies, and prizes as you rise from rookie to legend.
Track detailed stats: total wins, words spelled, trophies earned, and more.

Power-Ups & Daily Rewards
Freeze the clock, reveal tricky letters, or unleash a last-second victory word.
Log in daily for free coins, power-ups, and surprises!

Customize Your Wordling
Unlock skins and outfits—show off your style while you claim victory.

Build Gorgeous Dioramas Based on Famous Books
Unlock and build cozy dioramas based on works of classic literature.  
Unlock humorous book recaps and prizes.

Play Anywhere, Anytime
Free to download. Always ready to play!
Are YOU ready to have the last word?

Join millions of players mastering these fast-paced word battles in the most electrifying puzzle arena on mobile.
Download The Last Word now and prove you’ve got the quickest mind in the game—one victory at a time!

bluejetty:00042969:ios.name: Ballogy: Move, Train, Recover
bluejetty:00042969:ios.summary:
Ballogy turns effort into data and data into development.
Every rep, run, and rest day becomes a number you can train against. Athletes track how they Move, Train, and Recover using nothing but their phone and any wearable. Coaches run the
bluejetty:00042969:ios.description:
Ballogy turns effort into data and data into development.
Every rep, run, and rest day becomes a number you can train against. Athletes track how they Move, Train, and Recover using nothing but their phone and any wearable. Coaches run their teams, camps, and combines from one place. Here is how it works.
- Get your MTR score – Move, Train, Recover. Three numbers that tell you exactly where you stand and what to do next.
- Count reps without counting – point your phone at the rim, the net, or the bar. Object detection logs your drills and shots automatically while you work.
- Record your runs – distance, pace, splits, and route, tracked from your phone or your watch.
- Log your lifts – exercises, sets, reps, and weight, with your total volume trending over every session.
- Recover on purpose – connect any smart wearable and your sleep and steps feed straight into your score. Rest is part of the work.
- Train with an AI Coach – your own data becomes a custom plan that adjusts as you improve. No more guessing what to do tomorrow.
- Compete against yourself first – streaks, badges, and personal bests built for athletes who are trying to get better, not popular.
- 18+ sports supported – basketball, soccer, football, volleyball, baseball, track, and more. One development system, whatever you play.
FOR COACHES AND PROGRAMS
- Coach HQ – rosters, assigned workouts, completion tracking, and progress for every athlete on your team. Available on mobile and desktop.
- Get your team on and invite your roster in minutes, and start assigning work!
Whether you are a varsity starter, a walk-on, a rec league regular, or the coach holding it all together, Ballogy meets you where you are and shows you the next step.
Ballogy uses Apple Health to read your steps, heart rate, sleep, and workout data so your MTR score reflects everything you do, and to write your Ballogy activities back into the Health app.
Ballogy includes a free version and a subscription version with premium features. You can subscribe and pay on the App Store using your Apple ID. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renew may be turned off after purchase by going to the Manage Subscription page in settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.
Terms of Service: https://www.ballogy.com/terms-conditions
Privacy Policy: https://www.ballogy.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00073770:ios.name: VIN Report for Used Cars
bluejetty:00073770:ios.summary: Buying a used car? Get a free VIN check report providing answers to the key questions you should ask about the used car such as market value, depreciation, price and listing history, specs, recalls, theft record check, vehicle history (free
bluejetty:00073770:ios.description:
Buying a used car? Get a free VIN check report providing answers to the key questions you should ask about the used car such as market value, depreciation, price and listing history, specs, recalls, theft record check, vehicle history (free in some cases). Simply scan or enter a car’s VIN barcode and the app decodes the VIN and instantly generates a free comprehensive report with up to 200 data points.
Our mission is to help the consumer get better educated and informed about a used car before buying it. We know buying a used car is an arduous and frustrating experience (we know as we've been through it many times). We believe having the right information and data helps make the process a bit less difficult and helps you get a better price and make a more informed decision.
Each VIN check of a used car is Powered by iSeeCars.com's renowned data analysis engine which has been featured in many major publications and media outlets such as Consumer Reports, New York Times, Wall Street Journal, ABC/CBS/NBC News, CNBC, Forbes, Fortune, and many others.
Each used car VIN report and lookup includes up to 200 data points such as:
*** Market Value and Charts
Get an estimate of the used car’s market value compared to other cars that have been sold in the same local area.
*** Listing and Price History 
See a history of where and when the used car had been sold along with the prices and how long the car was on the market.
*** Vehicle History, Open Recalls, Stolen Car Check, and More
See how much the car was driven compared to the average car. Instantly check the vehicle history report (free in some cases) from Carfax or Autocheck, check for open recalls, see if the car had been stolen previously and look up other key things before buying or selling a used car.
*** Projected Depreciation 
Get an estimate of how much the used car will depreciate over 1, 2 and 3 years and in comparison with similar and competitor cars.
*** Best Time to Buy (and Sell) 
As with houses, cars also exhibit seasonal fluctuations. See when you should buy or sell to get the best prices.
*** VIN Decoder / VIN Lookup
Through the app, easily use your phone’s camera as a scanner and scan the VIN barcode of a used car and our app's built-in VIN Decoder look ups if it is a legitimate VIN (of a vehicle model year 1981 and newer - that’s the year when the U.S. government started standardizing VINs) and generates an instant report. The VIN (Vehicle Identification Number) is typically located on the windshield or passenger door sill.
*** Dealer Scorecard 
For a used car currently for sale, see how the dealer compares to other dealers for price, transparency and responsiveness.
WHAT USERS ARE SAYING:
>> This is excellent information about vehicles, and very valuable when one is considering purchasing a used or new vehicle. Glad I found the site, and will share with family and friends.
>> Better than CarFax. Won't ever shop for a car without this app.
>> I love how there are so many tools to make comps and a educated decision
>> Excellent. The data is well organized- great charts for comparison. Very helpful info!
WITH iVIN PRO, GET VIN REPORTS WITH NO ADS PLUS ACCESS TO LOCAL MARKET ANALYSIS AND IN-APP INTEGRATION OF YOUR VEHICLE HISTORY REPORT SUBSCRIPTION. 
If you subscribe via iTunes:
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period at the rate of the selected plan. Subscriptions and auto-renewal may be managed by going to Account Settings after purchase.
Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when purchasing a subscription.
Monthly price for iVIN PRO: $99.00
iSeeCars iVIN PRO service terms: https://www.iseecars.com/Terms.jsp
Privacy policy: https://www.iseecars.com/Privacy.jsp

• Thrilling background music

• Win rewards and use them to unlock game boosters

bluejetty:00093445:ios.description:
Welcome to Car Combine Mania, a thrilling puzzle game that challenges your strategic thinking and creativity! In this game, you’ll rotate digital cars and drag them onto grid. Your mission is to strategically place these cars horizontally or vertically, matching three or more of the same value to merge them into a higher value. Start from level 1 and work your way up to level 7 by combining cars efficiently. Each successful merge allows a little character to hop into a car, adding a fun and rewarding twist to the gameplay. But beware—when the grid fills up with no more space for new cars, the game ends! With visually stunning designs, strategic merging mechanics, and power-ups to clear the board, Car Combine Mania offers an addictive and immersive experience for puzzle enthusiasts of all ages.
Game Features：
1.Stunning Visual Design: Enjoy a vibrant and eye-catching interface that enhances your gaming experience.
2.Strategic Merging: Plan your moves carefully to merge cars and progress through the levels.
3.Power-Ups: Use special tools to clear areas and create space for new cars.
4.Engaging Gameplay: Combine cars, watch characters hop in, and aim for the highest score!
Ready to test your puzzle-solving skills? Download Car Combine Mania now and start your merging adventure!

Record your own routes on a map, add waypoints, take pictures along the itinerary and up
bluejetty:00175062:ios.description:
Discover millions of outdoor trails around the world. Choose between hiking, running, bike, MTB, kayak, ski or up to 80 different types of activities.
Record your own routes on a map, add waypoints, take pictures along the itinerary and upload them to your Wikiloc account from your phone.
Enjoy free offline topographic maps from all over the world for you to use without coverage or data. Great when you're out in the mountains or traveling without Internet connection.
Want to take your outdoor experiences even further? With Wikiloc Premium:
- Turn your mobile into a GPS navigator. Your smartphone will guide you with a heading indicator and sound alerts to warn you if you go off-track during navigation.
- Route Planner: Choose the places you want to pass through and Wikiloc will create a route prioritizing the most popular stretches of trails from other community members.
- 3D Maps: Without leaving home, discover the terrain relief, evaluate elevation changes, and take a look at the panoramic views that await you along the way.
- Live Tracking. Share your position in real time with your family & friends while doing the route.
- Send to your GPS: Download trails from Wikiloc directly to your Garmin, Apple Watch, Suunto or COROS. Feature available for compatible devices.
- Search by Passing Area: Find trails passing through your chosen specific areas.
- Weather forecast for a perfect outdoor activity.
- Advanced search filters.
By purchasing Wikiloc Premium you’ll be contributing in helping us out to maintain Wikiloc’s infrastructure. 
Furthermore, you’ll also contribute protecting the earth, as 1% of your purchase will directly go to 1% for the Planet, a global network of businesses, nonprofits, and individuals working together for a healthy planet.
Wikiloc Premium is available with a quarterly or annual subscription. 
Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase or at the end of the trial period if applicable. Wikiloc Premium subscriptions automatically renew. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period unless you decide to cancel your subscription renewal at least 24 hours before the renewal date.
You can manage your subscription or turn off auto-renewal by going to your user Account Settings after the purchase. For your convenience, we also provide links to manage your subscription from your Wikiloc Profile > Settings, that you can access from both web or app.
Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Wikiloc for Apple Watch uses HealthKit to save your Wikiloc activities into the Health app and to read the heart rate and active energy data. Most popular Wikiloc activities have an equivalent Apple workout and will be saved into the Health app.
Terms of use: https://www.wikiloc.com/wikiloc/terms_en.html?v6.0
Privacy policy: https://www.wikiloc.com/wikiloc/privacy.html?v4.1
Join us at Wikiloc.com, the community where millions of nature, travel and sports lovers share their adventures, from the most popular excursion to the most remote expedition on the planet.

bluejetty:00045931:ios.description:
Companies and Organizations that use the allGeo (previously known as myGeoTracking) time clock and field service automation platform perform more jobs per day, reduce overtime, respond quickly to unexpected events in the field, and raise customer satisfaction levels. The platform provides a highly customizable workflow to help businesses automate, manage & optimize their field operation and also integrate with leading Payroll, CRM, & ERP systems.
allGeo app provides a suite of tools to assist field employees with their daily tasks - daily job dispatch, location tracking, with geofencing, group messaging, field data capture including pictures, mobile forms, signature capture, scans and reports. Reports include mileage, attendance logs, daily tasks records and compliance. Advanced features such as “zero-touch geofence time clock” ensures that no manual clocking in and out is needed. The job site geofence makes clocking in and out automatic with customized alerts and reminders sent to managers and employees. The app can be customized to provide ‘lone worker safety’ solution.
allGeo app provides strong privacy controls to the user to manage location tracking - enable tracking based on manual clock-in OR enable based on pre-set work schedule.
The allGeo platform delivers these advanced capabilities as well:

bluejetty:00015842:ios.description:
Já pensou em ter um Vade Mecum com atualizações automáticas e capaz de adicionar legislação por conta própria no ato de sua publicação, como o Novo Código de Processo Civil? 
Então o que você está esperando para conhecer o Vade Mecum de Direito e consultar, marcar e anotar as mais de mil normas que ele oferece?
--
O Vade Mecum de Direito é um aplicativo jurídico voltado aos Operadores e Estudantes do Direito e a todas as pessoas interessadas por legislação. 
-- 
O Vade Mecum de Direito dispõe de mais de mil textos legislativos. Além disto, a Akobyx Software assume o compromisso de adicionar, sempre que possível, todas as leis federais requisitadas por seus usuários com a maior brevidade possível. 
-- 
Principais características do Vade Mecum de Direito: 
- Atualizações: O conteúdo é atualizado automaticamente e de forma quase imediata pelo aplicativo. Basta uma conexão ativa com a internet.
- Pesquisa de Palavras-Chave: A pesquisa do aplicativo não se limita a indicar os artigos que contêm a(s) palavra(s) procurada(s). Além disto, os termos são realçados e o texto é deslocado para a primeira ocorrência da procura.
- Sistema Integrado de Anotações: Fazer uma anotação em um artigo qualquer é uma experiência fantástica. Além disto, o ícone informativo deixa claro quando há algo anotado para o item que está sendo lido.
- Sistema Integrado de Marcações: É possível utilizar até seis diferentes cores de forma simultânea para fazer destaques no texto.
- Navegação Rápida e Intuitiva: O aplicativo foi construído tendo em mente a navegação rápida pelos textos. Desta forma, a tela de seleção de artigos permite deslocamento rápido e, ainda, filtragem por números. Ir para o Artigo 2.001 do Código Civil, por exemplo, é um piscar de olhos.
- Gestos: Passe textos, artigos, índices e o que mais quiser utilizando gestos.
- Textos Bem Formatados: Todos os textos legislativos têm cada um de seus artigos cuidadosamente formatados. Isto resulta em uma experiência de leitura agradável, com textos dispostos de maneira correta e ocupando praticamente todo o espaço útil da tela.
- Leitor de Normal Integral: Os textos podem ser consultados de forma integral através de uma interface própria para leituras mais longas.
- Extremamente Configurável: Através do painel de preferências, localizado nos Ajustes do aparelho, é possível configurar o aplicativo para satisfazer todas as suas necessidades. Praticamente todo aspecto do programa pode ser alterado. 
Outras funções: envio de email durante a leitura de um artigo, ordenação por nome ou número dos textos ou, ainda, por quantidade de visualizações de cada um deles, ordenação de nomes ignorando ou não preposições, rotação do aplicativo, tamanho da fonte de leitura e mais. 
-- 
Adquirir o Vade Mecum de Direito é ter a certeza de possuir textos jurídicos precisos e adequadamente atualizados. Este é o compromisso que a Akobyx Software assume para garantir que o Vade Mecum de Direito continue sempre como o melhor compêndio de legislação da App Store.
-- 
Em razão do limite de caracteres para esta descrição, não é possível colocar toda a lista de leis presentes no aplicativo. Para isto, por favor verifique o site do Vade Mecum de Direito (link abaixo).

bluejetty:00137194:ios.summary:

-- ABOUT THE GAME --
After winning a priceless pendant at the grand opening of Papa's Paleteria, excitement turns to chaos when Toby the Sea Lion dashes off with your cheris
bluejetty:00137194:ios.description:
Craft refreshing paletas and ice pops in Papa's Paleteria To Go!
-- ABOUT THE GAME --
After winning a priceless pendant at the grand opening of Papa's Paleteria, excitement turns to chaos when Toby the Sea Lion dashes off with your cherished prize! Papa Louie sets off in pursuit, and leaves you to run the new shop instead! Now it's up to you to helm the operation, crafting delectable paletas and ice pops for everyone visiting the seaside town of San Fresco. Pour a variety of purees, creams, and chunky fillings into paleta molds, and send them to the deep freeze for a quick chill. Decorate the frozen treats with a variety of dips, drizzles, and toppings before serving them to your picky customers. Work your way through the holidays as you serve seasonal ice pops, unlock new ingredients, and earn Daily Specials featuring delicious paleta recipes that will keep your customers coming back for more.
-- GAME FEATURES --
SWEET SHAPES AND FRESH FILLINGS - Choose a mold to craft each paleta with a unique shape, then fill it with a variety of fruit purees, chunky fillings, sweet creams and custards. Chill the mold in the freezer to create the perfect frozen treat.
TOP AND DECORATE - Add delicious dips, sprinkles, crumbles, and decorative drizzles to the frozen paleta, turning your pops into irresistible works of edible art!
HOLIDAY FLAVORS - Celebrate the seasons with delicious holiday flavors!
As you reach new ranks, the seasons and holidays in San Fresco will change, and your customers will start ordering holiday-themed paletas! Unlock a treasure trove of molds, fillings, dips, toppings, and drizzles tailored to each special occasion, ensuring your customers indulge in the spirit of the season!
SERVE SPECIAL RECIPES - Earn Special Recipes from your customers, and serve them as the Daily Special in the Paleteria! Each Special has a bonus you can earn for serving a prime example of that recipe. Master each special to earn a special prize!
CUSTOMIZE YOUR WORKERS - Play as Hacky Zak or Liezel, or create your own custom character to work in the restaurant! You can also show off your holiday spirit with a massive variety of holiday outfits and clothing for your workers. Choose unique color combinations for each item of clothing, and create your own style with millions of combinations!
SPECIAL DELIVERY - Some customers don't want to travel all the way to the San Fresco Wharf for their paletas. When you start taking phone orders, customers can call to place their order, and you'll hire a Driver to help take and deliver orders to their homes instead!
FOOD TRUCK FUN - After you hire a Driver, you can send them out in a Food Truck between days to serve whatever you like! Use your imagination to create your own unique paletas and ice pops, then serve them from the Food Truck and see who shows up to try them. You can even mix and match ingredients from different holidays in the Food Truck for creative combinations!
COLLECT STICKERS - Complete a variety of tasks and achievements while playing to earn colorful Stickers for your collection. Each customer has a set of three favorite Stickers: Earn all three and you'll be rewarded with a brand-new outfit to give to that customer!
AND MUCH MORE - Decorate the lobby with themed holiday furniture, send coupons to your customers to persuade them to visit the restaurant, and unwind with Foodini's Mini-Games to unlock an array or new rewards, from furniture to fashionable attire!
-- MORE FEATURES --
- Hands-on ice pop shop in the Papa Louie universe
- Multi-task between filling molds, chilling paletas, and topping the pops
- Custom chefs and drivers
- 12 separate holidays to unlock, each with more ingredients
- Earn and master 40 unique Special Recipes
- 90 colorful Stickers to earn for completing tasks
- 148 customers to serve with unique orders
- Use Stickers to unlock new outfits for your customers
- 129 ingredients to unlock

bluejetty:00016215:ios.description:
Welcome to Halloween Color by Number!
Celebrate the magic of Halloween with a relaxing paint by number adventure. From glowing pumpkins and haunted houses to witches, ghosts, gothic castles, and cozy autumn scenes, every illustration is designed to help you slow down, get creative, and enjoy the season one color at a time.
Relax and Unwind
Take a break from your busy day with an easy and satisfying coloring experience. Simply tap each numbered area to reveal beautiful artwork at your own pace. Whether you have a few quiet minutes or a relaxing evening, Halloween Color is the perfect way to recharge while expressing your creativity.
Celebrate the Halloween Season
Step into a world filled with spooky fun and festive charm. Discover beautifully illustrated Halloween scenes featuring haunted houses, glowing jack-o'-lanterns, black cats, witches, ghosts, gothic castles, trick-or-treat adventures, and many more seasonal surprises. New Halloween artwork is added regularly, so there's always something exciting waiting for you.
Seasonal Themes
Make the app feel fresh all year long with built-in Seasonal Themes. Instantly switch between Classic Mode, Halloween Mode, Thanksgiving Mode, and Christmas Mode to match your favorite holiday or simply enjoy a brand-new look. Every season brings a different atmosphere to your coloring experience.
Thousands of Beautiful Coloring Pages
Beyond Halloween, explore a growing collection of thousands of paint by number illustrations across a wide variety of themes. Color elegant flowers, adorable animals, peaceful landscapes, fantasy worlds, mandalas, fashion, and holiday favorites. No matter your mood, you'll always find artwork you'll love.
Easy Color by Number
Coloring is simple for everyone. Just follow the numbers and watch every picture come to life with a few relaxing taps. Zoom in to color the smallest details, use hints whenever you need a little help, and enjoy a smooth, intuitive coloring experience from beginning to end.
Fresh Content Every Week
There's always something new to discover. Our artists continuously create fresh coloring pages inspired by holidays, changing seasons, and popular trends, giving you new reasons to come back and enjoy coloring every week.
Designed for Everyday Relaxation
Whether you're unwinding after work, spending quality family time, or simply looking for a peaceful creative hobby, Halloween Color fits perfectly into your day. It's an enjoyable way to relax, stay inspired, and celebrate every season through beautiful digital art.
Download Halloween Color Today
Download Halloween Color by Number today and discover a relaxing coloring experience filled with creativity, seasonal celebrations, and thousands of beautiful illustrations. From Halloween nights to Christmas mornings, every season is more colorful with Halloween Color.

bluejetty:00076917:ios.description:
Proctor a Tennessee driving written test online from anywhere by using Tennessee’s Proctor ID App.
Intuitive and easy-to-use, PID is unlocked by a selfie match to verify identity, or by using a self-selected pin or TouchID/FaceID. 
In five simple steps, you can register for your Tennessee PID:
1. Download the app and set permissions
2. Verify access to your phone number
3. Use your device camera to scan the front and back of your driver’s license or ID card
4. Follow the app’s registration steps to take a selfie 
5. Set up app security and you’re good to go! 
This app requires an iPhone 6s (iOS 13.1) or newer device.

bluejetty:00172771:ios.description:
The latest version of Lovebrush Chronicles is now live! Experience a dreamy romance brought to life by renowned voice actors such as KENN, Junichi Suwabe, Shinnosuke Tachibana, Kosuke Toriumi, and Daisuke Hirakawa, alongside exquisite artworks and enchanting music. As a talented art student with mysterious powers, you'll explore diverse worlds, encounter "him", and write your own love story.
[Game Features]
1. Countless Parallel Worlds, Epic Million-Word Storyline
From dazzling fantasy realms and post-apocalyptic Eden to enigmatic myth tales and cozy modern romance, begin your journey across parallel worlds. Unravel the mysteries of time and love, where every universe invites your footsteps.
2. Branching Story Paths, Discover Diverse Endings
Experience branching storylines where each romance option reveals unique perspectives of the core narrative. Your choices shape personal journeys, and every decision leads to a different ending.
3. Build Your Love Story, Every Interaction Matters
Experience exciting interactions through Live 2D calls, romantic dates, and shared activities. Build connections, uncover heartfelt stories, and collect precious moments. Every interaction brings you closer to love's magic.
4. Exquisite Original Artwork, Immersive Voice Acting
Top voice actors and exquisite artworks unite in harmony. Lose yourself in flawless audio and visuals designed to captivate every sense.
[Game Theme]
This is a story about choice—
Face the challenge or flee it, accept goodwill, or fight against it.
Here, you can choose to kindle romance or walk a solitary path, dedicating yourself to your goals.
This is a story about growth—
Who you are is shaped by every choice. Each decision ripples through the story, changing small details or entire destinies.
A moment will come when your choice changes everything, with no turning back.
This path with no return bears the name of growth.
That brush in your grasp can transform all creation's colors.
Every choice you make charts a different destiny.
Remember, you can only paint the world that you believe in.
About:
Website: http://www.lovebrushchronicles.com/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/LBChronicles_EN

bluejetty:00149056:ios.description:
Welcome to GlucoSense – the smart, simple, and personalized CGM companion.
Connect your continuous glucose monitor to understand your blood sugar patterns faster and easier than ever. GlucoSense automatically provides personalized insights about how your lifestyle is impacting your blood sugar, and provides tips for managing with confidence in the future. 
Why GlucoSense?
-- Turn raw CGM data into clear, personalized blood sugar insights
-- See how sleep, meals, workouts, stress, and insulin affect your glucose
-- Track carbs in seconds with AI-powered food logging
-- Get a daily GlucoScore that summarizes glucose stability, trends & time in range
-- Sync your Dexcom or Freestyle Libre CGM, wearable, and health data — all in one app
-- Share your data with family, friends, and healthcare providers
-- Designed for people with Type 1, Type 2, or anyone wearing a CGM
Simple. Smart. Seamless.
If you're looking for a smarter way to manage your blood sugar without the hassle of too much logging, GlucoSense is here to help. We believe understanding your glucose should be easy, connected, and empowering — not stressful.
Download GlucoSense today and take charge of your blood sugar journey.
(CGM REQUIRED)
Questions, ideas, or feedback? Email us at support@glucosense.ai
DISCLAIMER
GlucoSense does not diagnose conditions or provide medical advice. It is a data visualization tool designed to support awareness of your glucose levels. Always consult a healthcare provider for medical concerns or emergencies.

bluejetty:00064411:ios.name: World of Cubes Craft & Mine 3D
bluejetty:00064411:ios.summary:
Create your own worlds with thousands of random players or friends online in Multiplayer mode or start your own survival game on the infinite randomly generated maps! 
Explore universes and random worlds created by others. Upload your own
bluejetty:00064411:ios.description:
Create your own worlds with thousands of random players or friends online in Multiplayer mode or start your own survival game on the infinite randomly generated maps! 
Explore universes and random worlds created by others. Upload your own maps and creations from single player mode to online Multiplayer server to play with others! Build whatever you can dream of by yourself or with many other users online in real time Multiplayer mode. Protect your own online creations with passwords so that only friends and people you know can access them! 
Start your own survival game on the infinite map! Find different resources, craft new items and build your own shelter to survive the nights! Watch out zombies, pumpkin heads and other aggressive mobs to save your health and hunt down eatable mobs (cows, horses, pigs, chickens) to overcome your hunger. Get compass with coordinates in order to easily orient in the infinite world. Don’t panic if you are dead in Survival mode – you can always get Resurrection pack instantly in the game’s Shop and get back all of your inventory after resurrection! 
Customize your character by choosing unique skin from 160+ available skins for Multiplayer games. Angel, Steelman, Vampire, Frankenstein, Messi and many other skins are available for your selection. All skins are grouped into 7 themed skin packs: FUTURISTIC, MOSNTERS, CARTOON, SPORT and others. 
Select your favorite Blocks Texture Pack. Choose one from 4 predefined Texture Packs in the Options: CLASSIC, MEDIEVAL, MODERN and TECHNOLOGY.
Our centralized server contains 10+ maps to get your creative adventure started either alone or together with random people or your friends online in Multiplayer mode:
- The Maze Runner (THEMAZERUNNER)
- Halloween (HALLOWEEN)
- Pirate Island (PIRATEISLAND)
- Amusement Park (AMUSEMENTPARK)
- Community Town (COMMUNITYTOWN)
- Community Village (COMMUNITYVILLAGE)
- Fantasy World (FANTASYWORLD)
- Landscape Farm (LANDSCAPEFARM)
Just save any of the above maps locally, modify them in Creative mode and upload into online server for real time Multiplayer gaming. 
Features:
• Survival mode for single player with infinite maps, crafting, building and mobs
• Creative mode for Online Multiplayer or Single player
• Centralized server that hosts all rooms and games globally
• Built-in chat in Multiplayer mode with multicolor support
• Password protected Parental control for Multiplayer Chat. Disable chat for younger children. 
• 1000+ of user created maps for creative Online Multiplayer mode
• 160+ player skins available for Multiplayer gaming
• 10+ great predefined maps on the server to get started with creative single player or Online Multiplayer game
• 7+ themed skin packs: FUTURISTIC, MOSNTERS, CARTOON, SPORT and others
• 4+ different Block Texture Packs to choose from
• Ability to create password-protected maps to build exclusively with friends or people you know
• Ability to create read-only maps viewable to all players. But only you can modify them!
• Upload your maps from Single player creative to Online Multiplayer server!
• No need to setup and/or host a server
• No subscription or additional fees required

COMMUNITY SITE: http://woc.solverlabs.com/ 
YOUTUBE: http://www.youtube.com/user/WoCSolverlabs/
FACEBOOK: http://www.facebook.com/worldofcubesonline 
TWITTER: http://twitter.com/WoCSolverlabs

bluejetty:00165363:ios.description:
Ready for some incredible puzzles and brain training? Then welcome to Merge Mystery! You can merge any of the same magic items or sea elements to unlock hundreds of illustrations. Wipe off the dust and find new items, merge them into useful tools and earn surprising treasures. You never know what awaits. Unlock new areas within. With an abundant combination of items to discover and hundreds of engaging puzzles to solve, the Beacon makes sure it always has new secrets waiting for you.
Puzzles and brain training.
Merge eggs to match apple strudel, Vanilla cheesecake & Blueberry muffin then evolve them to uncover more powerful ones! Encounter and solve challenging puzzle levels: match the items to win. Combine recipes and Merge them to unlock brand-new delicious treats for your bakery! Start as a waffle house and expand your range of fresh bakes. Filled with over 25+ delectable bakery treats, from luxurious cookies to indulgent triple chocolate cakes!
Game features:
• Discover over 1000 fantastic objects to match, merge and interact!
• Merge sweet ingredients to make cakes, pies, and other treats.
• Relax as you play a fun and interactive merge game.
• Discover new secrets to the story and new plot twists.
• Solve the mysteries puzzle.
• Merge similar crops
In Merge Mystery, you’ll solve match puzzles to win fabulous rewards you can use to design and decorate the gardens of your beautiful home. Alongside your trusty sidekick, you’ll explore, merge, and upgrade a world of enchanting and mystical items as you dream up the most stunning and sought-after country grounds there is.
MERGE – Combine what you have into more useful tools.
How to play:
1. Tap the boxes which have a lightning mark on them, to get new items for you to merge.
2. Drag the same items together to merge them up.
3. Complete the decorating task by using the coins you got.
Test your puzzle solving skills to complete over 300 challenging match 3 levels and a camp puzzle full of twists with near unlimited customizations. How many combinations can you make from hundreds of items? Get special boosters.
Please note that our game is free to play, but you are able to purchase game items with real money.
If you like Fun Puzzle Game then Merge Mystery: Lost Island is just for you. 
Privacy Policy: http://wannaplay.games/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Service: http://wannaplay.games

Why Choose Fifty410?
With Fifty410, you’ll find more than just answers; you’ll find connections. From expert insights to shared experiences, our app is here to make your GLP-1 journey feel informed, comfortable, and personalized.

Key Features
• Personalized Profiles: Create your own profile to receive information and recommendations based on your interests and needs. Keep track of your saved articles, favorite discussions, and resources, all in one place.

• Community Groups and Discussions: Join group discussions tailored to various topics, from managing side effects to meal ideas and fitness tips. Participate in conversations with others who are navigating the same path, and find support in a safe, friendly environment.
• Inspiring Stories and Testimonials: Read real-life stories from others who have benefited from GLP-1s, and share your own progress or experiences. The Fifty410 community is a place for honest conversations and positive reinforcement.
• Privacy First: We prioritize your privacy and confidentiality. Fifty410 is built with security in mind so you can feel safe sharing and connecting in the community.
Who Should Download Fifty410?
Fifty410 is for anyone considering or currently using GLP-1 therapies who seeks a supportive, informed, and welcoming community. Whether you’re just starting out, exploring treatment options, or looking for wellness tips, Fifty410 is here to provide guidance and camaraderie.
