bluejetty:00119819:ios.description:
Music Writing is easy and fun when you use iWriteMusic!
Experience the perfect harmony of ease and versatility in sheet music creation with iWriteMusic!
Say goodbye to complicated notation apps and hello to intuitive design. 
Enjoy quick and beautiful sheet music creation with a comprehensive suite of essential tools for concerts, lessons, and music classes. 
Best fit for professional musicians, music teachers and students. For songwriters, composers and arrangers. For both singers and instrumentalists (piano, violin, cello, guitar, flute, saxophone, trumpet, drums, etc.). Great for writing down ideas, creating lesson materials, creating lead sheets, or creating scores and parts for chorus groups, choirs, chamber orchestras, jazz bands, Latin bands, orchestras, and more. For daily practice, rehearsals, concerts, iWriteMusic will help you enrich your musical life!
Check out 7 reasons to choose iWriteMusic.
1. You can understand this app almost instantly!
Because of Truly Intuitive and Extremely Simple user interface, you barely need to read pages of manuals nor watching numbers of instruction videos. Unlike Finale, Sibelius and other similar apps, you just have a few things to learn to be able to use this app pretty well.
2.Double your productivity with our Highly Efficient Input System.
If you’re already familiar with notation apps and looking for faster & more efficient entry system, try our innovative One-Flick Entry System along with Traditional Entry System to get your job done in no time!
What is Traditional Entry System?
- The choices will appear with ToolBox.
- Select a value and the location separately.
- Recommended to those who are not yet familiar with any music notation apps.
What is OneFlick Entry System?
- The choices will appear when you touch the screen.
- Select a location and the value at once. 
- The selection will change as you slide your finger to left/right.
- Recommended to those who are familiar with music notation apps and looking for faster and more efficient entry system.
3. Creates beautiful sheet music / music score
- absolutely professional quality!
- rich options for page layout adjustment
- easy parts creation
- easy score/parts management
- direct print-out via AirPrint
4. Supports most of major notation elements
- multi-track writing
- multi-voice writing
- percussion/drums notation
- chord symbols and lyrics
- multi-bar rest
- time change
- key change
- clef change
- tempo change
- grace note
- articulations and dynamics marks
- easy song transpose
- partial transpose
and many more!
5. Useful playback options for practice
- mixer with solo, mute and voice select
- loop and swing options
6. Data & sheet music sharing
- exports/Imports iWriteMusic data file
- exports PDF or JPG
- exports Standard MIDI file which can be imported by other apps such as GarageBand
7. Extremely Compact Size (15 MB)
You can save your device storage space
for photos and other apps.
ATTENTION: 
Latency during playback and drawing may occur by device capacity or number of tracks and background applications.

This Offline Music Player & Editor aims to be the best offline MP3 music management application. It supports multiple audio formats, allows you to customize playlists, and features a professional equalizer for a personalized listening experience. It also includes over ten audio editing tools, allowing you to edit MP3 audio with a single click and create your own music. 

Core features of Offline Music Player & Editor:

Supports multiple import methods
- Want to listen to music offline?
- Our free Offline Music Player & Editor supports multiple import methods: file import, photo import, import from other apps, Wi-Fi transfer, inter-device transfer, and even Apple Music.

Offline Music Player & Editor supports all major formats—MP3, M4A, M4R, WAV, AAC, FLAC, ALAC, AIFF, CAF, etc.

Offline Music Player & Editor: Manage your music library freely
- Convenient and fast sorting function, supporting intelligent grouping by song, album, and artist, as well as customizable song metadata, personalized album art, etc. Music management is very simple and convenient.
- Use the built-in search function to quickly find the content you need.

Offline Music Player & Editor: Create and manage playlists
- You can create your own playlists (unlimited). Adding, editing, and deleting are all very simple.

Offline Music Player & Editor: Listen to music and edit audio on your device without an internet connection.

Powerful Offline Music Player & Editor
- Supports offline music playback in full-screen or mini mode. The MP3 player also supports lock screen control, headphone control, and a sleep timer.

Offline Music Player Widget
- The offline music player widget is available in multiple sizes.
- The offline music player widget supports song switching and fast playback of free music playlists. 

Offline Music Player & Editor, Customizable Music Equalizer
- To personalize your music experience, our music app features a built-in equalizer with advanced audio functions such as scene presets, custom equalizer, reverb adjustment, and bass boost.

Offline Music Player & Editor, Rich Personalization Tag Management
- You can modify song information such as song title, artist name, album art, genre, etc. It also supports custom album art and artist covers, giving you complete control over the app's content.

Stylish App Interface
- Create your own personalized MP3 offline music player and editor using personalized interface theme colors and a night mode.

Offline Music Player & Editor, Powerful Audio Editing Toolbox, One-Click Audio Editing!
- Millisecond-level perfect editing, precise and fast
- Audio mixing, fade in and fade out
- Adjust pitch and tempo
- Adjust audio speed
- Merge two or more tracks into one to create beautiful songs!
- Customize pitch, timbre, and tempo to make your music even more beautiful! 
- Adjust the pitch
- Compress audio, share or upload to friends.
- Audio format conversion,

Offline Music Player & Editor——Create a unique MP3 music player by customizing interface theme colors and user information.

Offline Music Player & Editor, meticulously optimized, feature-rich, yet only one-tenth the size of similar apps (actual size depends on your device model)!
Only 25MB!
It won't take up much space on your phone.

What are you waiting for?
Download and experience it now!

Note: If you subscribe through Apple, the fee will be charged to your App Store account upon confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew unless you turn off auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.

If you encounter any problems, difficulties, or have any comments or suggestions while using the offline music player and editor, please contact us via email: caoyong@taoyongtool.com.

bluejetty:00188914:android.description:
ONCF TRAFIC is a mobile application of the National Railway Office (ONCF).
To make your mobility easier, the new ONCF TRAFIC app allows you to be informed in real-time about the state of traffic and traffic on your train.
With a single click, the mobile application will offer you several features:
The nearest station:
ONCF TRAFIC allows you to locate the station closest to you and suggests the route to follow to get there.
Schedule:
You can consult the timetables and the next departures.
Traffic status:
Stay continuously informed about traffic conditions to better anticipate your trips.
Details of your trip:
Thanks to ONCF TRAFIC, you can consult all the details of your journey: Stations served, Distance and journey time of your journey, Lane number, 1st class location.
ONCF-TRAFIC also informs you about the connecting stations where you must get off, either to change trains or to take a SUPRATOURS coach if you are going to a destination not served by rail (Agadir, Essaouira, Laayoune, Béni Mellal, Tétouan ...).
With ONCF-TRAFIC, you can also access the oncf-voyages.ma store online website to buy your ticket online as well as the ONCF2255 Customer Relations Center if you want more information.

bluejetty:00061015:ios.description:
The Voxox CloudPhone mobile app is a business phone system in your pocket with unique and innovative features. Now you can use one device to manage your business and personal calls while on the go. CloudPhone answers and routes your calls professionally while giving you the flexibility to communicate with your customers where and when you choose. 
***Mobile app features unique to CloudPhone:***
1. Free business text messages anywhere in the United States, Canada, and Mexico with a monthly plan (up to 5000 messages)
2. One touch access to features such as call recording, conference calling, eavesdrop and flip call.
3. Eavesdrop on incoming voicemails in real time and answer important calls.
4. Unparalleled call quality - Calls sound great and stay connected even in poor network conditions with our patent-pending codec. 
5. Calls to International destinations at super low rates. Great for the global entrepreneur!
Other mobile app features include:
1. Forward business calls to any number and ensure you never miss an important call
2. Read your voicemail transcriptions
3. Flip calls from your mobile to a deskphone or other device 
4. Access your phone contacts and favorite business contacts
5. Use your business number to place outbound calls or return calls from call history
6. View and manage call activity (calls, voicemails and recorded calls)
7. Receive notifications for missed calls, voicemails and recorded calls
You must be an existing CloudPhone customer to use this application. All CloudPhone plans include a local or toll free phone number, a professional company greeting, an auto attendant for call routing, voicemail and call forwarding.

bluejetty:00171157:ios.description:
The 4Warn Weather app offers a sleek and fluid map displaying real-time radar, temperature, and surface winds. Whether you're planning your week or just stepping out for the day, our app provides detailed 48-hour and 10-day forecasts tailored to your specific location, accessible by city, zip code or wherever you are. 
Key Features of the 4Warn Weather App: 
- Live From the 4Warn Weather Office: Livestreams of the best meteorologist team, for up-to-the-minute coverage of weather impacting the region and your backyard. 
- Interactive Weather Maps: Better, more dynamic weather radar that is more interactive and easier to read. 
- Updates from the WDIV Local 4 Weather Team: Get real-time insight, video forecasts and up-to-date analysis from our dedicated meteorologists 
- More Detailed Forecasts: Now including windspeed and direction! Get 3- and 10-day forecasts in both quick view and detailed formats, ensuring you're fully prepared no matter the weather. 
- Live Weather Alerts: Experience integrated weather alerts including tornado likelihood rankings from 1 to 10 for upcoming storm cells. 
- Customizable Notifications: Choose from WDIV Local 4 weather alerts and National Weather Service warnings for comprehensive alerting including tornadoes, severe thunderstorms and flash floods, directly on your map. 
- MIPics: Share and view photos and videos from your community and where events are taking place. Nothing is more powerful than the sights and sounds shared by our viewers, far beyond the forecasts and maps. 
- Dark Mode: A new visual option for easier nighttime viewing. Dark mode is enabled based on your device's settings.
Beyond just forecasts, the 4Warn Weather app offers fully automated, specific weather alerts with up to 15 minutes lead time before severe conditions hit. You can set up alerts for up to 16 locations, including your current mobile location, ensuring that you and your loved ones stay safe. 
Metro Detroit, don't just watch the weather. Stay a step ahead with the 4Warn Weather app. Download or update today, and take control of your weather experience. Your peace of mind is now at your fingertips.

bluejetty:00150269:ios.name: Mad Puck - Hockey Team Manager
bluejetty:00150269:ios.summary:
Mad Puck keeps you connected to your team’s coaches, players, families, friends, and sponsors at any level of hockey — from novice house league to the most competitive travel teams.
Mad Puck officially supports hockey, ringette, sledge hoc
bluejetty:00150269:ios.description:
Mad Puck keeps you connected to your team’s coaches, players, families, friends, and sponsors at any level of hockey — from novice house league to the most competitive travel teams.
Mad Puck officially supports hockey, ringette, sledge hockey, box lacrosse and soccer / football.
Summary of features:
* Scheduling
* Calendar sync
* Attendance
* Chats
* Play-by-play
* Stats (game and cumulative)
* Tasks
* Polls
Upgrade your team to premium (paid subscription) to get more great team features:
* Share images
* Post game interviews
* Post game reports
* Attendance waitlist
* Lines
* Teams (pickup)
* Sponsor promotions
* Player awards
* Support Mad Puck development
Learn more at https://www.madpuck.com/premiumteams
Upgrade your fan to premium (paid subscription) to get more great fan features:
* Remove Ads across all of your teams
* Play-by-play shot locations
* Additional cheer & chat reactions
* Premium fan badge
* Support Mad Puck development
Most Mad Puck features are free! Upgrade your experience and support Mad Puck with a subscription. See pricing at: https://www.madpuck.com/pricing
Every hockey team has an extended hockey family; a group of dedicated parents, relatives, friends, and volunteers who make the game fun for those on the ice. With Mad Puck, the hockey family can work together to track every game, every big play, and every goal!
For more info, visit www.madpuck.com
SCHEDULING & ATTENDANCE
See your upcoming games and practices in the Agenda view or past games and your win-loss-tie record in the finished view. The agenda provides quick access to update your attendance as well as an attendance summary for the event.
Automatically sync your teams online calendar with Mad Puck so you only have to add events in one place. Mad Puck supports syncing calendars from MBSportsWeb, RAMP, TeamSnap, SportsEngine, BenchApp, League Athletics, eSportsDesk, Goalline, RYNA, Crossbar, LeagueApps and Home Teams Online (HTO).
Add your Mad Puck calendar to your personal calendar so all your personal and hockey events are in the same place.
Multiple options allow you to control how attendance is managed - require attendance responses for every event or just events that players can't make.
FOLLOW LIVE PLAY-BY-PLAY
As your hockey family tracks the game at the rink, a live play-by-play feed displays all the action as it happens.
Now, out-of-town relatives or business-travelling parents can follow every game live, and you can even send a cheer to the team! It’s almost as good as being at the rink (concession stand coffee not included!)
BECOME AND EXPERT STATISTICIAN
All the stats and plays entered during a game are tabulated in real-time, giving your team an instant analytical advantage. And the Mad Puck advantage doesn’t stop when the final horn sounds: you can view individual game stats, cumulative season stats, and splits, all generated from the crowdsourced data collected during each game.
TRACK STATS AND PLAYS
The game is on the ice, but Mad Puck is fueled by the hockey family in the stands. Parents, friends, and volunteers can choose which types of plays or stats they want to track for each game (such as faceoffs, shots on goal, goals, or penalties).
It’s a true crowdsourced data collection model: you can work together as a team to track every play, while still enjoying the game.
PARENTS
Parents can manage attendance for their player, see the full game stats or track their player’s progress throughout the year with cumulative stats.
COACHES
Coaches can use real-time stats to help inform in-game decisions, or highlight areas for improvement at their next practice. And, coaches no longer need to spend hours inputting and generating cumulative stats after every game. Less busy work means more time dedicated to the craft of coaching.
Built for hockey families by hockey families.
https://www.madpuck.com/terms
https://www.madpuck.com/privacypolicy

bluejetty:00023686:ios.description:
► We’re going to the zoo, zoo, zoo…
Ever wanted to shave an alpaca, shower an adorable but filthy elephant calf, lead a column of acrobatic chimpanzees all the way to the banana pile, or throw watermelons to a ravening hippo? These are just a few of the crazy, cute and super fun tasks you’ll have to perform to keep the animals happy in this colorful, delightful zoo simulator that offers a whole range of entertaining mini games that challenge, charm and amuse in equal measure, covering all aspects of zoo life and animal care. 
Become a zoo tycoon and master every aspect of animal welfare in this awesome idle animal game, just don’t let the lions get in with the alpacas, and watch your hands when you’re feeding the crocodiles…
► How about you?
• Can you master all the skills required to run a zoo? There’s always work for idle hands, with feeding, grooming, washing, and herding all covered in a wide range of entertaining and instructive mini games that include maze puzzles, moving pins, obstacle courses, cutting, catching and a whole lot more.
• Intuitive gameplay, gradually increasing difficulty levels, and vast variety challenges ensure that animal fans of all ages will be engaged and entertained by this fun idle game with a huge heart.
• Who’s the cutest of them all? Look after fluffy alpacas, playful baby elephants, cheeky little monkeys, lovely lion cubs, and huggable hippos. Even those snap-happy crocodiles are kind of adorable. Complete the game levels to meet their needs and get rewarded with happiness and love expressed in dance, emojis and the occasional wholehearted roar.
• Charming graphics, fun animations, and entertaining haptic effects make the Zoo a colorful, absorbing, and super relaxing place to spend time for animal lovers of all ages, relieving stress for adults and helping develop cognitive and fine motor skills in young children.
• With an emphasis on fun, simple gameplay and a beautiful game world, Zoo helps build awareness of animal welfare and protection, as well as respect for nature, while maintaining a sense of joy and age-appropriate humor.
► You can come too!
Rate your chances as a zoo tycoon? Want an idle game that lets you indulge your overwhelming love for animals in a simulator that also boasts gorgeous gameplay, fun puzzle challenges, and original wacky humor? Want to build a zoo where all the animals are kept happy all the time, and every species lives in peace, love and harmony? 
Then download Zoo – Happy Animals right away and get to work to ensure that it’s another day in paradise for all the cute and cuddly creatures at the zoo.

bluejetty:00080884:ios.name: Bow Smash: Archery King
bluejetty:00080884:ios.summary:
Archers, grab your bows! Draw, aim, shoot! Dive into the world of shooting games to smash your enemies with the precision of an archery king or queen and win every fight! 
Jump into a tough arrow war field in this exciting shooting game wi
bluejetty:00080884:ios.description:
Archers, grab your bows! Draw, aim, shoot! Dive into the world of shooting games to smash your enemies with the precision of an archery king or queen and win every fight! 
Jump into a tough arrow war field in this exciting shooting game with a plot twist! You don’t have to run around a city searching for enemies for hours like in other shooters—just move your bow along a track to shoot arrows and have fun in this shooting game! Embark on an engaging journey to test your precision, speed, and strategic thinking! 
Welcome to our shooter game—Bow Smash: Archery King! From now on, you’re an arrow master fighting in an epic arrow war for exciting rewards! Every level of this target game is an obstacle course adventure designed to push your shooting skills to the limit. Navigate through targets, get into the right gates, and destroy big enemies for awesome rewards. Shoot your way to victory through every target with the precision of an arrow master! 
One of the standout features of Bow Smash: Archery King is the ability to merge arrows. Combine them to create more powerful arrows with a high level of destruction in this shoot game. They’ll fly faster to reach every target, making each shot stronger during your target games. Embrace your role as the magic archer, harnessing these arrows to defeat foes in these immersive battle 3D fighting games. 
The excitement doesn't stop with all these throwing games! Discover a companion to assist your archer hero during the fight or enhance your bow and arrow with buffs. There’s also a slot machine that upgrades your arrows before the start of your target-hitting games! And at the end of each battle 3D, you’ll face an obstacle course of pillars hiding a treasure chest. Can you hit all big targets enough times to claim your reward? Find out in our thrilling shoot game! 
Features of our bow and arrow game: 
Intense fighting games: Leave a trail of destruction while smashing every boss on your way to victory to become the legendary archer hero!
Treasure hunt: Your path to glory is filled with challenges, but our stick game will reward your magic archer skills with incredible prizes and buffs! 
Challenging target games: Prove yourself in this ultimate arrow game and become the legendary master among other archers.
Simple mechanics: Merge arrows to craft more powerful ones, ensuring your victory in every boss fight from our stick game!
Fun smashing games: Take a break and have a whale of a time as a bow master in the archery battle from these time-killing games!
Experience the thrill of an archery battle during these throwing games. From smashing through barriers to getting into a boss fight, this target game is packed with action! Relax with our time-killing games whenever and wherever you want to become a bow master among other archers! 
Can you claim the title of the archery king or queen? Download Bow Smash now and embark on your adventure into the world of smashing games! Find out if you have what it takes to become the ultimate archer of all hitting games!

bluejetty:00136297:ios.description:
Mistero VPN brings your VPN, Safari ad blocker, security checks, and photo cleaner together in one simple privacy toolkit.
Connect with one tap on public Wi-Fi, reduce intrusive ads and trackers in Safari, check suspicious links, filter unwanted calls and texts, and reclaim storage—without juggling multiple apps.
PRIVATE VPN FOR EVERYDAY USE
• Connect to available VPN locations in one tap
• Mask your IP address while the VPN is active
• Choose WireGuard, OpenVPN, or IKEv2
• Use Auto-Connect when Mistero launches
• Turn on Kill Switch to help stop network traffic if the VPN disconnects
• Explore available locations, recommended routes, and streaming-optimized routes where available
SAFARI AD BLOCKER & WEB PROTECTION
• Reduce ads, pop-ups, and common tracking content in Safari
• Choose regional filter lists and manage trusted websites
• Help block known phishing pages and malicious domains
• Enable protection through Safari Extensions
SMART SECURITY CHECKS
• Run one Smart Scan across key protection settings
• Review iOS version, passcode, and Face ID status
• Check Wi-Fi for visible connection or DNS anomalies
• See whether an email address appears in known data-breach records
• Scan QR codes and review their links before opening them
• Check password strength and generate stronger passwords
• On iPhone, enable caller identification, spam call blocking, and SMS filtering
PHOTO & VIDEO CLEANER
• Find similar photos, screenshots, and large videos
• Review items before removing them
• Compress large photos and videos to save storage space
• Remove location and device metadata from selected photos
Mistero helps you protect your network, browse with fewer distractions, check common digital risks, screen unwanted communication, and keep your photo library under control.
Call identification, call blocking, and SMS filtering are available on iPhone only. Other feature availability may vary by device, region, network, and system settings.
Some features require a subscription or purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm your purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. Your account may be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings.
Privacy Policy: https://www.misterovpn.com/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Service: https://www.misterovpn.com/terms-of-service.html

Proudly created in Canada.
Boost Your Productivity with Task Flow: To-Do & Reminders
Task Flow is more than just a to-do list; it's a comprehensive task manager and planner designed to transform your good intentions into achievements. Whether you prefer a straightforward checklist approach or a full-fledged task management system, Task Flow adapts to your style.
Organize, Plan, and Track with Ease
Seamlessly organize and track your tasks, whether they're daily errands or part of larger projects. Task Flow's unique time-based view and customizable structures cater to how you work, ensuring your to-do list is always relevant and organized.
Key Features of Task Flow:
- Versatile Prioritization: Discover numerous ways to structure and prioritize tasks without losing sight of their project affiliations. Use Task Flow's dynamic 'My Task Flow' feature to focus on imminent tasks across all projects, ensuring no deadline is missed.
- Multi-Project Integration: Easily link a single task, like 'buy car sweets', to multiple projects like 'Groceries' and 'Vacation', keeping you organized and efficient. Completion in one project marks it done everywhere.
- Focus Timer: Boost your concentration with our Focus Timer. Set dedicated work periods and breaks to maintain productivity and avoid burnout. Extend timers for task completion and leverage the continuous option for uninterrupted work sessions.
- Project Visualization: Visualize your projects your way – as simple lists or dynamic Kanban boards. Personalize with custom icons and colors to make each project uniquely yours.
- Comprehensive Task Details: Enhance each task with subtasks, priorities, notes, and attachments for a detailed, organized approach. Highlight critical tasks within a project with elevated priorities.
- Effortless Task Access with Widgets: Interact with your tasks directly from your iPhone and iPad Home screen. View and add tasks conveniently through our intuitive widgets.
Task Flow is the ultimate organizer and tracker for anyone looking to master their to-do list, manage their day efficiently, and keep track of tasks in a GTD (Getting Things Done) manner. Whether you're planning daily tasks or tracking progress in various projects, Task Flow is your go-to app for staying organized and productive.
Unlike some of the many task managers for iPhone, iPad, and Mac, Task Flow is under active development and continues to grow with each new update. You can learn more at https://taskflowapp.com

Privacy Policy: https://taskflowapp.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00041615:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00041615:ios.description:
Clap Finder - Clap Finder is an application that allows you to locate your device by clapping.
Our app offers a convenient way to easily locate your device. By activating the "Clap Finder" feature, all you need to do is clap, snap your fingers, whistle, or do all three, and wait for your phone to emit a response, enabling you to quickly locate it without any difficulties.
Sound Collection
You can select the phone's alarm sound from a list. As a signal emitted by your phone, you can choose one of our 20 custom sounds. Clap your hands and wait for the phone to "respond". You will definitely not confuse them with melodies from other devices. Not enough? You can also set your own melody from your files.
Easily and quickly find your misplaced phone with the help of this app. The Clap to Find My Phone - Clap Finder application is designed to assist you in locating your device effortlessly, whether you're in a crowded area, in the dark, or somewhere at home.
How to use Clap Finder:
1. Start our application (Clap Finder section).
2. Change the alarm sound (if necessary).
3. Choose what sound your phone should respond to (clap, whistle, finger snap, or all of them together).
4. Click the "START" button to activate the "Clap Finder" mode.
5. Lock your phone without closing the application.
6. Start clapping (whistling or snapping your fingers) if you forget where your phone is.
7. Our application will detect the search sound and respond with a sound signal.
8. Your phone has been found.
Unplugged Charging Alarm Mode
Do you often encounter a problem when someone unplugs your phone from charging? Now you can activate the continuous charging mode, and if someone disconnects your phone from charging, our application will start beeping to notify you about it.
How to use Charging Alarm:
1. Go to the Charging Alarm section.
2. Make sure the phone is charging with a wire.
3. Press the "START" button and lock the application.
4. Now if someone disconnects your phone from charging, it will start beeping.

listings.name: Clap Finder:  Find My Phone !
listings.description:
Clap Finder - Clap Finder is an application that allows you to locate your device by clapping.

Our app offers a convenient way to easily locate your device. By activating the "Clap Finder" feature, all you need to do is clap, snap your fingers, whistle, or do all three, and wait for your phone to emit a response, enabling you to quickly locate it without any difficulties.

Sound Collection
You can select the phone's alarm sound from a list. As a signal emitted by your phone, you can choose one of our 20 custom sounds. Clap your hands and wait for the phone to "respond". You will definitely not confuse them with melodies from other devices. Not enough? You can also set your own melody from your files.

Easily and quickly find your misplaced phone with the help of this app. The Clap to Find My Phone - Clap Finder application is designed to assist you in locating your device effortlessly, whether you're in a crowded area, in the dark, or somewhere at home.

How to use Clap Finder:
1. Start our application (Clap Finder section).
2. Change the alarm sound (if necessary).
3. Choose what sound your phone should respond to (clap, whistle, finger snap, or all of them together).
4. Click the "START" button to activate the "Clap Finder" mode.
5. Lock your phone without closing the application.
6. Start clapping (whistling or snapping your fingers) if you forget where your phone is.
7. Our application will detect the search sound and respond with a sound signal.
8. Your phone has been found.

Unplugged Charging Alarm Mode
Do you often encounter a problem when someone unplugs your phone from charging? Now you can activate the continuous charging mode, and if someone disconnects your phone from charging, our application will start beeping to notify you about it.

How to use Charging Alarm:
1. Go to the Charging Alarm section.
2. Make sure the phone is charging with a wire.
3. Press the "START" button and lock the application.
4. Now if someone disconnects your phone from charging, it will start beeping.

COACHING
Personalized coaching based on biometric, lifestyle & hormonal cycle data. Reach your wellness goals in the areas of weight loss, fitness, hormonal balance, sleep, healthy aging, intimacy, or general health & wellbeing.
WELLNESS CONTENT LIBRARY
Fitness: yoga, pilates, shape & strength, mobility & stretching, cardio, pre & postnatal fitness
Mindfulness: breathing exercises, affirmations, meditations, binaural beats, relaxation music, sounds of nature, meditations for moms, ASMR & more
Nutrition: Power ingredients that support your body throughout your hormonal cycle, cycle phases recipes, pre & postnatal nutrition & supplementation
Beauty: cycle-supporting guidance, how-to videos, face yoga, skincare academy, DIY skincare recipes
New & Expecting Moms: the Fourth Trimester podcast guiding you through birth & motherhood preparations, meditations, postpartum fitness, postpartum nutrition, pregnancy fitness
Quick Reads: goal-supporting articles
ACTIVITY 
-Insight into activity progress 
-Track & monitor steps, active time, energy burned, distance & activity duration 
SLEEP
-Track & monitor sleep patterns 
-Identify light, recovery sleep & awake periods
-Understand sleep efficiency & quality 
MINDFULNESS 
-Reduce stress & anxiety with mindfulness exercises
-Track meditations with Leaf/Ivy to determine calmness levels
-Track Cardiac Coherence & Respiratory Rate (Ivy Exclusive) 
MENSTRUAL CYCLE
-Private Key Encryption keeps data private 
-Track periods & phases of the menstrual cycle
-Log moods, symptoms, weight & temperature
-Guidance based on your hormonal cycle & individual needs
HYDRATION
-Get reminders, track water intake & monitor progress 
-Works optimally with Spring 
STRESS
-Learn stress management skills
-See which lifestyle habits impact stress
WELLNESS SCORE
-The Wellness Score shows step, activity, sleep, meditation & hydration progress throughout the day & night
READINESS SCORE (IVY HR & IVY+ users)
-Biometric feedback that measure body readiness
-Track heart rate, resting heart rate, respiratory rate & cardiac coherence
-Optimize workouts with biometric insight 
INSIGHTS 
-Informative videos & articles 
-Gain knowledge to improve wellness habits, best practices for optimal biometric feedback, and menstrual cycle guidance 
INTEGRATIONS
Sync certain data measured by Leaf, IVY HR, IVY+, or Time to the Apple Health app (optional)

bluejetty:00024195:ios.summary:

FOUR WAYS TO MEASURE
- Tap to drop pins around a region and get its area inst
bluejetty:00024195:ios.description:
Marea turns any map into a precise area and distance calculator. Measure fields, plots, rooftops, lawns and lakes — anything you can see from above — in seconds.
FOUR WAYS TO MEASURE
- Tap to drop pins around a region and get its area instantly.
- Draw a freeform shape with your finger and Marea traces the outline.
- Walk the perimeter and GPS drops pins automatically as you go.
- Auto-detect plots — tap to find buildings, fields and parks already on the map and turn one into a measurement in a single tap.
RESULTS IN EVERY UNIT
Area in square meters, square feet, acres, hectares, square kilometers and square miles — plus the distance between every point.
TRACTOR MODE
Turn your phone into a field-coverage guide. Set your implement width and speed, then drive: Marea records each pass, draws your covered area live, and tracks total distance and worked acreage. Pause, resume and save passes.
GRID OVERLAY
Drop a measured grid over any plot to plan rows, sections or spacing — horizontal, vertical or both, with the spacing, direction and color up to you.
PROJECT AN AREA
Pin a saved plot to the centre of the screen at its real size, then pan and rotate around it to plan, compare or align on the ground.
ORGANIZE & ESTIMATE
- Save your areas and revisit them anytime
- Drop labeled markers on the points that matter
- Keep a to-do list for every area
- Add notes and attach photos
- Estimate prices by multiplying any rate by the measured area
SHARE ANYWHERE
Send a web link to any saved area — anyone can open it in a browser to see the polygon, its size and details. You can also export a KML file or share a map image or PDF.
BUILT FOR THE FIELD AND THE JOB SITE
Made for farmers, agronomists, roofers, pavers, landscapers, surveyors and real-estate pros:
- Estimate roofing, asphalt, paving, turf and seeding quantities
- Check property lines, lot sizes and parcels
- Plan plots, gardens and farmland
Subscription terms:
- The subscription auto-renews at the end of each term.
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
- You may manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase.
Privacy policy and Terms of Use: https://mapareacalculator.com/privacypolicy/

bluejetty:00132785:android.name: Holy Bible - King James
bluejetty:00132785:android.summary:
Embark on a rich and personal journey with the Bible experience. Our platform provides audio capabilities, themed organization, and customizable settings to deepen your biblical understanding in an accessible and engaging way.
Key Features
bluejetty:00132785:android.description:
Embark on a rich and personal journey with the Bible experience. Our platform provides audio capabilities, themed organization, and customizable settings to deepen your biblical understanding in an accessible and engaging way.
Key Features:
Access to Audio and Text of the Bible: Easily listen to and read playlists of Bible books, strengthening your connection with the scriptures.
Dark Mode: Reduce eye strain with a comfortable reading environment for nighttime sessions.
Save Favorites: Quickly mark your preferred verses for easy access and convenient sharing.
Daily Inspirational Audio Messages: Receive new motivational messages daily to uplift and inspire your spirit.
Biblical Glossary: Enhance your understanding by learning the meanings of less common words and terms.
Gospel Radio: Stream gospel music and messages to enrich your spiritual journey and maintain your faith connection.
Interactive and Fun Games: Enjoy puzzles, quizzes, and memory games featuring biblical characters and stories, making learning interactive and enjoyable.
Text Annotation: Highlight key passages and verses for quick reference during reading sessions, ensuring easy retrieval of important scriptures.
Reading Tracker: Keep a detailed record of your reading history, tracking dates and times to monitor your progress and commitment.
Verses by Theme: Explore and search verses related to specific themes for focused and profound Bible study.
Reading Rewards: Stay motivated with rewards and achievements as you accomplish your reading goals, adding a gamified aspect to your spiritual journey.
Verse Sharing as Images: Share beautifully designed images of your favorite verses to inspire and encourage friends and family.
Adjustable Text: Customize text size for optimal and comfortable reading during your sessions.
Annual Reading Plan: Follow a structured plan organizing daily chapter readings throughout the year, available in audio and text formats to suit your preferences.
Bluetooth Audio Control: Easily manage media playback via Bluetooth, including track skipping, pause, play, and volume adjustment, ensuring an excellent auditory experience.

bluejetty:00033683:ios.summary:
Baixe agora os melhores Esboço de Pregações

bluejetty:00033683:ios.description:
Baixe agora os melhores Esboço de Pregações
Maravilhosos e educativos esboços de pregações para seguir a Palavra de Deus.
O que é Esboço de Pregação ? Como o próprio nome diz, é um sermão que expõe. Mas, expõe exatamente o que? Claro que expõe a Palavra de Deus, mas não precisando necessariamente focar em um número específico de passagens Bíblicas.
O Esboço é como um esqueleto que sustenta um corpo. Quem coloca carne ou conteúdo na mensagem é o pregador. Mas quem dá vida à pregação é o Espírito Santo. Este é um recurso muito útil: usar esquemas elaborados para organizar a fala para pregar eficazmente.
Gostaria de compartilhar com você alguns esboços de Pregações, Estudos Bíblicos, Sermões, Mensagens Biblicas e muitos conhecimentos mais para enriquecer sua vida e capacitá-lo para manejar bem a palavra de Deus.
Este aplicativo foi integrado à inteligência artificial, permitindo ao usuário criar seus próprios estudos, pregações ou tirar qualquer dúvida sobre qualquer tema relacionado à Bíblia.
Centenas de esboços rápidos para uso em reuniões de célula ou pequeno grupo, estudos bíblicos, programas de rádio, devocionais e pregações em geral.
Peça ao Espírito Santo para dar a você novas revelações da palavra de Deus e capacitá-lo na pregação do Evangelho.
Nesta aplicação você encontrará uma variedade de esboços de pregações e diversos textos baseados na Bíblia ao crescimento e à fé cristã. 
Esboço de Pregações contém, entre outros:
- Estudo sobre Tiago 1:22 
- Esboço de pregação sobre oração 
- Reconstrução dos muros de Jerusalém – estudo
- Estudo Bíblico sobre Batalha Espiritual
- Pregação sobre Armadura de Deus 
- Unidade do Corpo de Cristo 
- Deus fala comigo 
- Estudo sobre oração de Jesus 
- Como sermos semelhantes a Jesus
- O Tipo de Pregação que Precisamos 
- Famílias em Desintegração – Esboço de Sermão
- O Evangelho de Jesus Cristo 
- A Ambição de um Cristão 
- E se João 3:16 não fosse verdade? 
- Um exemplo de como viver como um cristão
- Considerai os vossos caminhos 
- O Deus de Gideão está conosco 
- e máis.
Alguns estudos bíblicos incluídos:
- “Eles não Sabem o que Fazem”
- A justiça de Deus
- Kairós e Khronos
- Amai-vos uns aos Outros como eu Vos Amei
- “Deuses” no meio Cristão”
- Qualquer Palavra de Cristo Jamais Falhará
- O Amor de Deus
- O Drama de Ser Humano
- O que é o Pecado
- O Trabalho Paciente na Lavoura de Deus
- A Antítese da Santificação
- A Causa Foi um Grande Amor
- Se o Senhor é o seu Deus!
- A Deus Pertence o Poder e a Glória
- Romanos 1
- Sob a Figueira
- “Paz! Perfeita Paz!”

bluejetty:00082739:ios.description:
Designed by experts and scientifically proven to help you learn, Uptime is an exciting way for you to spend 5 minutes immersing yourself in content that will help turn you into the smartest person in the room. Whether it’s meditation, politics, or career advice you’re after, our Hacks can have you feeling confident and well-informed across any area of your life.
WHY UPTIME?
• It’s effortlessly engaging. Our 5-minute summaries (which we call Hacks) are easy to understand, quick to get through, and cover every topic imaginable.
• We save you time. Uptime finds the world’s top non-fiction books, podcast episodes, documentaries, and online courses, and summarizes them so you can take away all the key information in a fraction of the time.
• You choose what works for you. Our content is available as text to read, audio to listen to, or as visual stories you can tap through. Whether you’re sitting down to concentrate or out on the go, Uptime is designed to suit your needs.
• We’re built for learning. Designed by experts, Uptime has a science-based methodology that’s proven to foster long-term information retention.
• We help you take action. We don’t just leave you to consume facts. Our Insights in Action provide you with tips and tricks that you can implement in your everyday life.
• Uptime helps you reach your goals. Watch your streak go up and see how many hours you’ve saved — a book might take hours, but a Hack only needs 5 minutes.
• You can bank the best bits for later. Save your favorite quotes, insights, and actions as Sparks to refer back to, and even categorize them into Boards to share with your friends.
• Our content is one of a kind. Many of our Hacks are written by the creators themselves, not only guaranteeing authenticity but offering unique insight you can’t get anywhere else. 
• We guarantee quality. We curate only the top creators – with New York Times best sellers, the latest Netflix documentaries, top-rated Apple and Spotify podcasts, and courses from the world’s most prestigious universities.
WHAT IS EVERYONE SAYING ABOUT UPTIME?
"Uptime: the app that helps you appear well-read (without actually reading). No time for those big books everyone talks about? With a new app you can grasp Hawking, Piketty and Gladwell in five minutes." – The Times
“Uptime has a crucial role to play in making education and knowledge more accessible and affordable..” – Lily Cole, author
"Read less, absorb more: Unless you have unlimited free time, you’ll never be able to consume everything that strikes your interest. Uptime provides a workaround…" – Fast Company's best new apps of 2021
TRY UPTIME PREMIUM
It's free for 7 days with no ads, unlimited content, and access to perks such as audio voice and speed selection, monthly streak repair, and deeper learning.
If you purchase Uptime Premium, payment will be charged to your Apple account. Subscriptions will automatically renew at the end of your current period, unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the subscription period. You will still have access to all your subscription features and content for the remaining time of your then-current period.

bluejetty:00096742:ios.name: Word Associations Solitaire
bluejetty:00096742:ios.summary: Word Associations Solitaire is a relaxing solitaire word game where you match words by meaning, category and association. Draw from the deck, move cards between piles and place each word where it belongs before you run out of moves. If you
bluejetty:00096742:ios.description:
Word Associations Solitaire is a relaxing solitaire word game where you match words by meaning, category and association. Draw from the deck, move cards between piles and place each word where it belongs before you run out of moves. If you enjoy solitaire, word games and smart matching puzzles, this game gives you a fresh way to train your brain and grow your vocabulary.
Each level deals a new mix of word and category cards. Some cards are face-down in the tableau, others are waiting in the stock pile. Your job is to reveal cards, find connections between words, and sort them into the correct categories using classic solitaire-style movement. Plan ahead, use your limited hints and undos carefully, and clear the board in as few moves as possible.
PLAY A UNIQUE MIX OF WORD GAME + SOLITAIRE
This is not another generic card solitaire or basic word search. Word Associations Solitaire combines:
Word associations and categories
Solitaire card movement and stock/waste piles
Strategic move limits, undos and hints
It feels familiar if you know solitaire, but adds a new layer of meaning: every word must match a category, and every category has a limited capacity.
KEY FEATURES
Unique blend of solitaire and word association
Relaxing, offline-friendly word card gameplay
25 handcrafted levels with progressive difficulty
40+ themed word categories (weather, foods, animals, hobbies, school, music, nature and more)
Limited moves for extra challenge and strategy
3 undos and 3 hints per level to help when you are stuck
Rewarded ads that can give you extra moves when you need a second chance
Smooth drag-and-drop controls and clear mobile UI
HOW TO PLAY
Category cards represent groups like “Weather”, “Pets”, “Fruits”, “Jobs” and many more
Word cards contain individual words such as “Sunny”, “Guitar”, “Doctor” or “Strawberry”
Place category cards in the foundation slots, then stack matching word cards on them
Use the tableau to temporarily hold cards and uncover face-down ones
Draw from the stock pile when you need more options; the top waste card is always playable
Complete a category by filling it with the required number of related words
Clear all categories before your move limit reaches zero to win the level
STRATEGIC, BUT STILL RELAXING
Every move matters:
Move limit per level keeps the puzzle tight and strategic
Remaining moves change color as you approach zero, giving you a clear warning
Use undos to fix mistakes and hints to highlight a helpful move
No timers required; you can play at your own pace and think through each decision
BRAIN TRAINING THROUGH WORD ASSOCIATIONS
Word Associations Solitaire is great if you like:
Building and practicing your vocabulary
Recognizing patterns and connections between concepts
Gentle brain training and logic puzzles
Word games that are more than just spelling
You will constantly scan the board for relationships: animals vs. foods, emotions vs. jobs, tools vs. instruments, and many more. It is a subtle but effective workout for your memory and verbal reasoning.
DESIGNED FOR MOBILE
Portrait-optimized layout for comfortable one-handed play
Simple tap or drag-and-drop controls
Quick sessions that fit into a break or commute
Light footprint and offline-friendly once downloaded
Whether you are a solitaire fan looking for something new, a word game lover chasing a different kind of challenge, or just someone who enjoys calm, thoughtful puzzles, Word Associations Solitaire offers a satisfying mix of strategy, vocabulary and card play.
Download Word Associations Solitaire and start matching words by meaning and category today.

listings.name: Word Associations Solitaire
listings.description:
Word Associations Solitaire is a relaxing solitaire word game where you sort words by meaning. Place a category card in a slot, then stack every word that belongs to it. Draw from the deck, move cards between columns and clear the board before you run out of moves.

HOW TO PLAY
- Move a category card into an empty slot to open that category.
- Stack matching words on it: Blue Shark goes on Sharks, Banana goes on Fruits.
- Use the columns to hold cards and uncover the ones underneath.
- Draw from the deck when you need new options.
- Fill every category before your moves run out to win.

FEATURES
- 2,940 levels that grow from gentle warm-ups to big boards
- 899 categories to discover, with word cards and picture cards
- Journey mode: 13 illustrated chapters, from a meadow farm to outer space
- A new daily challenge every day, with a calendar to track your streak
- Custom games: pick the difficulty and play a fresh deal
- Hints, undo and jokers for when you get stuck
- Dark mode for evening play
- Play in English, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Japanese, Korean and Chinese
- No timer and no internet needed

WHY PLAYERS LIKE IT
It feels like classic solitaire, with a word puzzle on top. Every deal asks you to spot connections: which words are animals, which are foods, which belong to music or space. It is a calm way to train your brain and grow your vocabulary in a few minutes a day.

Download Word Associations Solitaire and start sorting words today.

bluejetty:00168079:ios.description:
Faça agora o seu download do aplicativo Bíblia Sagrada King James Atualizada e tenha sempre à mão a Palavra de Deus!
Bíblia King James Atualizada KJA é uma coleção de escritos antigos que contêm registros de transações e as instruções de Deus para Seus filhos. A palavra Bíblia é de origem grega e significa "livros". Embora muitas vezes pensemos na Bíblia (KJA) como um único livro, ela é na verdade uma biblioteca divina encadernada em um único volume.
A Bíblia Sagrada KJA é a tradução dos manuscritos canônicos originais em hebraico, aramaico e grego por um Comitê Internacional com mais 50 eruditos.
O resultado foi uma Bíblia com uma tradução que excede os padrões de confiabilidade e ainda conta agora com notas explicativas e esclarecimentos sobre temas específicos.
A mesma apresenta também conforto e prazer na leitura, sabendo disso, nós não poderíamos deixar de proporcionar aos nosso clientes uma Bíblia de confiabilidade singular e justamente por isso que tamanha satisfação nos faz apesentar aqui a Bíblia King James Atualizada, tendo a mais absoluta certeza da completa satisfação do leitor e estudante das Escrituras Sagradas.
Gostaria de seguir a palavra do Senhor no seu celular?
Não basta só ser Cristão, é necessário ter um bom aplicativo da Bíblia King James Atualizada em Português instalado em seu celular!
Ver e ouvir a palavra do maior e melhor homem que veio a passar pela Terra e saber interpreta-la, levando-a além dos olhos e chegando ao coração.
Bíblia King James Atualizada é um aplicativo que permite você navegar através de toda a sabedoria da Palavra de Deus em uma linguagem simples e claro com só uns poucos cliques.
Cheguei no App A Bíblia King James Atualizada , é o livro inspirado por Deus e escrito pelos homens que ele escolheu para cumprir seu propósito, nele vemos o caráter de Deus.
¡Leve a Biblia a todas partes! Os melhores conselhos para sobrellevar os problemas mais complicados da vida encontram-se em suas páginas. As escrituras são muito úteis e ajudam a muitas famílias a ser felizes.
Além disso, o aplicativo inclui um melhor estudo e compreensão da Bíblia:
- Estudo da Bíblia: Nós fornecemos uma compreensão básica de cada livro da Bíblia. Em cada guia o autor, data, finalidade da escrita, versos-chave, prenúncios e escreveu um breve resumo será incluído. Esta ferramenta irá ajudá-lo a entender melhor a Bíblia e vai encorajá-lo a estudar de maneira mais profunda.
- O Dicionário Teológico do Novo Testamento mas completo e singelo com grande quantidade de definições e termos teológicos explicados e ordenados para sua fácil compressão.
- Devocionais Diários: leituras breves de versos bíblicos relacionados, ajudassem você a estar mais de para perto de Deus todos os dias.
- Estudos Bíblicos Variados: Estudos bíblicos variados na doutrina cristã básica que cada crente deve saber. De Grande bendicion a sua vida diária.
Perguntas e respostas da Bíblia: irá ajudá-lo a entender melhor a Bíblia e vai encorajá-lo a estudar de maneira mais profunda.
Podcast Cristaos.
BENEFÍCIOS da Bíblia King James KJA:
- Acesso aos livros da Bíblia (KJA) em Português totalmente offline
- Você pode gostar do texto ao seu gosto
- Você pode ler a bíblia no modo diurno e no modo noturno
- Você pode copiar os textos da App e compartilhá-los
- Fácil de ser usada, com a sua cara e ainda podendo utilizá-la sem precisar de acesso à internet.

bluejetty:00064732:ios.name: Community Bank Oelwein
bluejetty:00064732:ios.summary: Community Bank of Oelwein is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes lif
bluejetty:00064732:ios.description:
Community Bank of Oelwein is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Community Bank of Oelwein:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Community Bank Oelwein app, you must be enrolled as a Community Bank of Oelwein Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00036889:ios.description:
Welcome to a world of word games where decoding meets conquest! This game is designed to challenge and entertain you with a unique blend of word puzzles, cryptograms, and logic games that ignite your mind and test your deduction skills. Perfectly crafted for word game enthusiasts, this experience combines the fun of word puzzles with the intrigue of cryptograms, creating a delightful brain-teasing adventure suitable for all ages.
Immerse yourself in a game filled with fascinating quotes and endless word puzzles. Each level offers a fresh challenge, from simple word scrambles to complex cryptograms that will keep you engaged for hours. The intuitive gameplay ensures that both beginners and seasoned players can enjoy and find their perfect challenge level. As you advance, you’ll encounter a variety of quotes, from historical facts to inspirational proverbs and sayings by famous figures, enriching your vocabulary and broadening your knowledge.
The game is meticulously designed to provide a distraction-free environment, allowing you to focus on solving word puzzles without any interruptions. The hand-curated quotes are carefully validated to be error-free, ensuring a smooth and enjoyable experience. With no typos, ads, or distractions, you can fully immerse yourself in the puzzle-solving fun.
The game also features educational elements, blending word puzzles, cryptograms, and word games seamlessly. As you decode and advance through varying difficulty levels, you’ll unlock new knowledge and enrich your understanding of different topics. The game is designed to entertain and educate, making it a perfect choice for those who love word games and enjoy the challenge of guessing words.
FEATURES:
Enrich Vocabulary: Decode numerous words based on provided clues.
Activate Thinking: Numerous levels with unique word codes to decipher will keep your mind agile.
Intuitive Gameplay: Suitable for beginners and experienced players with varied difficulty levels.
Diverse Difficulties: Multiple levels of difficulty from easy to complex.
Inspirational Hints: Letter hints assist in solving challenging word puzzles.
Embark on this unique word game adventure and discover as many quotes as possible across different categories. Whether you are a casual gamer or a word puzzle expert, this game offers an immersive and challenging experience that will keep you entertained and intellectually stimulated.

bluejetty:00123455:ios.summary:
GialloZafferano, il primo sito italiano di cucina, con oltre 7000 ricette, videoricette e audioricette dal successo garantito.
Ogni giorno la redazione di GialloZafferano seleziona e organizza le migliori ricette per aiutarti a scoprire, i
bluejetty:00123455:ios.description:
GialloZafferano, il primo sito italiano di cucina, con oltre 7000 ricette, videoricette e audioricette dal successo garantito.
Ogni giorno la redazione di GialloZafferano seleziona e organizza le migliori ricette per aiutarti a scoprire, in qualsiasi momento della giornata, nuove idee per i tuoi pranzi e le tue cene. In più puoi scegliere di ricevere, con una notifica push, la migliore ricetta del giorno.
GialloZafferano è inoltre attento al tuo benessere e ti offre tante informazioni nutrizionali complete e la possibilità, grazie al nuovo motore di ricerca, di filtrare le ricette anche in base e preferenze e intolleranze. Con questa nuova versione potrai cercare comodamente ricette senza glutine, senza lattosio o a basso nichel e ricevere tante idee per piatti sani e leggeri.
Cerca o sfoglia tutte le nostre ricette, ordinate per portata e per categoria. Tante informazioni utili dalla difficoltà di realizzazione, ai tempi di preparazione e cottura e il numero di portate.
La nuova versione dell’app comprende tante novità che ti permettono di cercare nuove ricette, averle sempre disponibili e contribuire alla community con la tua versione della ricetta:
> Ricettari: Se ti piace una ricetta, mettigli un 'cuore' e crea i tuoi ricettari; Il pranzo della domenica, una cena con gli amici, il menu dedicato a un’occasione speciale.. Sei tu che scegli il nome dei tuoi ricettari e quali ricette lo compongono.
> Lista della Spesa: Segna gli ingredienti che ti servono per le tue ricette preferite e porta l’app di GialloZafferano a fare la spesa con te; ti ricorda cosa devi comprare e a che ricetta servono. Ti serve un aiuto? puoi condividere la lista della spesa come e con chi vuoi.
> Commenta le ricette: racconta il piatto che hai cucinato e se vuoi aggiungi una foto per condividere o contribuire con i tuoi feedback alla Community di GialloZafferano.
>Valori nutrizionali e ricette per il benessere: per mangiare sano e conoscere meglio ciò che cucini, anche sotto il profilo dei valori nutrizionali.
>Podcast e audioricette: prepara le ricette più famose con la nuova modalità “podcast interattivo”. Potrai cucinare a mani libere ascoltando le indicazioni di GialloZafferano passo dopo passo.
E se hai bisogno di sostituire un ingrediente, cambiare le dosi o vuoi provare una cottura alternativa, chiedi al team di GialloZafferano, ti risponderà in tempi brevissimi.
Giallo Zafferano sempre con Te: grazie alla nuova registrazione, all’utilizzo del tuo profilo Facebook o al tuo account Apple ID, tutti i servizi di GialloZafferano possono essere utilizzati a tua scelta sull’app o sul sito. Ovunque troverai i tuoi ricettari, la tua lista della spesa o i tuoi commenti alle ricette.
T&C: https://privacy.stbm.it/site/giallozafferano/condizioni-generali.html
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00183504:ios.description:
Manage your Virgin Money or Virgin Atlantic Credit Card.
Our app is the easiest way to stay in control. Check your balance, manage your payments, and master your spending. Do all this and more from your phone.
* GREAT FEATURES FOR YOU *
Track your balance and transactions in real time
- View your latest transactions immediately and keep a check on your balance.
Manage your payments
- Set up and manage your Direct Debit and make one-off payments with your banking app. 
Make transfers
- Transfer a balance from another credit card or move money into your bank account. Transfer fees apply.
See latest offers
- Check out your latest credit card offers. From 0% interest on transfers to boosting your credit limit, don’t miss out. Subject to eligibility, transfer fees apply.
Pay in instalments
- Pay for bigger buys of £250 or more over 3 to 36 months. Eligible customers only. Fees apply.
Freeze card
- Temporarily freeze your card to stop it being used. Unfreeze to use it again.
Easily and securely view your PIN
- Use the app to view your PIN instantly. 
In-app chat support
- Get instant answers to your credit card queries with 24/7 in-app chat support. 
Sign in with your face or fingerprint

- See your Virgin Points clock up and discover all the ways to earn and spend Virgin Points with our handy guides.

bluejetty:00039232:ios.description:
Con San Pablo Farmacia digital, tendrás a un clic de distancia todo nuestro catálogo de medicamentos, vitaminas, artículos de cuidado personal y mucho más. 
Descubre todas nuestras categorías y disfruta de promociones, ofertas de temporalidad y mucho más. Encuentra todo lo que necesitas en la app de San Pablo Farmacia.
App Farmacia San Pablo es tu aliado en medicina.
En nuestra app de farmacia a domicilio contamos con más de 11,000 productos listos para ser agregados a tu carrito y recibirlos en la puerta de tu casa. 
Descubre nuestras categorías y encuentra los productos que estas buscando:
• Medicamentos (medicinas genéricas y de patente)
• Equipo y botiquín
• Bebés
• San Pablo Natural
• Vitaminas y suplementos
• Dermocosméticos
• Alimentos y bebidas
• Cuidado personal y belleza
• Salud sexual
Con la farmacia digital de San Pablo, no salgas de casa, contamos con un amplio catálogo en el que podrás encontrar lo que necesitas.
Envíos gratis a todo México
La app de San Pablo Farmacia no tiene fronteras. Disfruta los beneficios de nuestro amplio catálogo de farmacia online y recibe tus productos sin costo hasta la puerta de tu domicilio, en compras mayores a $1,000 MXN.
Si vives en Ciudad de México, Estado de México, Querétaro, Puebla, Jalisco, Morelos y Pachuca tendrás tu pedido en 120 minutos o menos.
No importa dónde te encuentras, nuestra farmacia a domicilio llega hasta ti.
Ofertas y promociones para ti
Con nuestro programa Club Salud podrás disfrutar de beneficios diseñados especialmente para nuestros clientes.
Sólo debes regístrate en el programa y podrás tener:
• Acceso a promociones
• Notificaciones de las ofertas semanales más importantes
• Acumula compras y recibe productos gratis*
• Programar envíos
Métodos de pago
Con San Pablo Farmacia, puedes tener la confianza de realizar tus pagos con total seguridad.
Sólo agrega tus productos al carrito y paga con toda seguridad con tarjetas de crédito o débito de Visa, MasterCard o American Express, tan sencillo como eso puedes adquirir los medicamentos online sin complicaciones y con procesos seguros para ti.
Si lo prefieres, también puedes pagar en efectivo o tarjeta contra entrega de tus productos.
Encuentra una Farmacia, Consultorio o Clínica cerca de ti 
Si necesitas acudir a una de nuestras más de 190 farmacias, puedes ingresar a la app y ubicar una farmacia cerca de ti.
También puedes localizar nuestros consultorios médicos donde podrás:
Solicitar una consulta de medicina general
Solicitar consultas de servicios médicos de especialidad como ortopedia, traumatología y nutrición, entre otros.
Solicitar estudios médicos de laboratorio en nuestras clínicas o estudios de gabinete como rayos x, ultrasonidos y más.
Disfruta de tus compras con los beneficios de la app de Farmacia San Pablo y conviértete en uno de nuestros clientes.
Si tienes dudas o consultas, llámanos al 800 0726 722 y un ejecutivo te atenderá las 24 hrs. del día.
Nos encantaría leerte y que seas parte de nuestra farmacia en línea. Si tienes sugerencias, escríbenos a atencion.cliente2@fsanpablo.com y atencion.cliente3@fsanpablo.com
*Consulta los productos participantes

bluejetty:00183863:ios.description:
The MIT Federal Credit Union app allows you to manage your finances – anytime, anywhere. View account balances and recent transaction history, transfer funds both internally and externally, pay bills and loans, locate branches and ATMs, and deposit checks. Budget with Money Management, send funds to friends and family via “Person to Person,” manage debit cards with Card Control, view statements, open accounts, and apply for loans. Enjoy convenient and secure personal banking that is quicker and easier than ever before! This is a free service available to all MIT Federal Credit Union members enrolled in e-Branch (online banking). The app requires a United States phone number; otherwise, please call MIT FCU at 1-781-423-2022 or email info@mitfcu.mit.edu and note a convenient time to contact you for installation assistance. Please note that wireless carrier data usage rates related to your individual service plan may apply.
To learn more:
-MIT Federal Credit Union website: http://www.mitfcu.org
-MIT Federal Credit Union Member Services phone number: 1-781-423-2022

bluejetty:00126262:ios.summary:

Open the app and see your whole cycle as a flower: every petal is a day, co
bluejetty:00126262:ios.description:
WoPee is a simple, beautiful period tracker that helps you understand your cycle and ovulation, and stays with you through pregnancy and the weeks after the birth.
Open the app and see your whole cycle as a flower: every petal is a day, coloured by phase, so you always know where you are. Track your period, notice changes and never miss an important date.
Key features:
• Track your menstrual cycle and full period history
• See ovulation and fertile days predicted in advance
• Colour-coded calendar, with a guide to every colour and mark
• Log your pill, sex and protected sex
• Smart reminders for your period, fertile days, ovulation and your pill
• Pregnancy mode: follow your pregnancy week by week, each trimester in its own colour
• After the birth: count the weeks since your baby arrived, with the first six weeks of recovery marked
• Choose from six colour themes: Bloom, Berry, Peach Sorbet, Rose Gold, Lavender Bloom and Coral Reef
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• iCloud sync across your devices, with no account and no ads
• Export your history to a text file
• Adjust cycle length, period length and fertile window to fit your body
WoPee helps you understand your body better and stay prepared every day.
WoPee is not a contraceptive and is not meant for medical diagnosis. Predictions are estimates based on your cycle settings.

bluejetty:00089311:ios.description:
EveryDose is the easiest way to stay on track with your medications -- for free! Features include medication reminders, health info and tips, progress sharing, and much more.
HELPFUL MEDICATION REMINDERS
We won't let you miss a dose! Our reliable medication reminders help you stay on track with your daily medication routine.
• Easily schedule reminders for medications, vitamins and supplements 
• Customizable scheduling options include daily, as needed, specific days and more
• Quick actions allow you to act on your med reminders without opening the app
• Adjust the frequency of notifications to meet your needs
STAY ORGANIZED WITH A VIRTUAL MEDICATION LIST
Medication schedules can be complex. Keep an up-to-date, accurate medication list on your mobile device at all times.
• Easily add medications, vitamins and supplements from our comprehensive database 
• Share your medication list with loved ones or caregivers with the touch of a button
• Mark medications as taken, skipped or snoozed throughout the day to stay on track
• View your medication history, including taken and skipped doses
DRUG INTERACTION ALERTS AND MED INFO
Stay safe and informed. We'll alert you if a newly-added medication has a potential interaction with your existing drug list, and we'll provide you with need-to-know info about your meds.
• Drug-to-drug interaction alerts help to prevent medication errors
• Our med info leaflets provide you with must-know info about your medications
• Food info helps you learn which foods or beverages to avoid with your specific meds
PROGRESS SHARING
Managing your health is not a solo adventure! Add friends and set up progress sharing to keep your loved ones in the loop with your health.
• Add friends within the app to send them progress report emails
• Schedule monthly or weekly progress reports for your EveryDose friends, or send them one-off reports at times of your choice
GET PREMIUM FEATURES WITH EVERYDOSE PLUS
To upgrade to enhanced features, you can subscribe to EveryDose Plus, our paid subscription. EveryDose Plus includes:
Multiple Profiles
• Track medications for up to 5 additional profiles
• Get separate reminders for each profile
• Choose a different color theme for each profile
Health Journal
• Keep a log of 13 different health metrics, like blood pressure, blood glucose, weight, and more
• Get reminders when it’s time to log your health metrics 
• Visualize your health data in chart format and set up automated reports 
• Connect to Apple Health for seamless data syncing
Refill Reminders
• Keep track of the number of pills remaining for your meds
• Set a refill reminder to nudge you when it’s time to refill your prescription
Personalization Features
• Make the app yours with 6 different color themes
• Choose from 30 profile avatars
• Customize your medication reminders to include the med name
Subscription Pricing and Terms:
For access to the EveryDose Plus premium features, we offer an auto-renewing monthly subscription at $9.99/month and an auto-renewing annual subscription at $69.99/year. The annual subscription comes with a 14-day free trial available to first-time subscribers only. 
Payment for EveryDose Plus will be charged to the credit card connected to your iTunes Account when you subscribe. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage your subscription by going to the My Subscription section of the app or the Subscriptions section of the App Store. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.
Questions? Email us at support@everydose.ai.
Thanks for trying EveryDose! Our mission is to make your daily medication routine easy, so you can focus on the things that matter the most.

bluejetty:00159483:ios.summary:
Bluetooth® compatible with the Lansinoh® Smartpump and Smartpump 2.0!

bluejetty:00159483:ios.description:
Bluetooth® compatible with the Lansinoh® Smartpump and Smartpump 2.0!
The Lansinoh® Smartpump 2.0 app simplifies tracking pumping sessions, breastfeeding, diaper changes and so much more! By seamlessly pairing with the Lansinoh® Smartpump and Smartpump 2.0 through Bluetooth® to automatically track pumping sessions, your busy days and new mommy brain have become easier to manage.
QUICKLY VIEW A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR DAY- A Dashboard and Timeline view allow you to quickly look for trends and changes, keep track of set reminders or missed sessions, and gain insights on you and baby’s daily routines.
EASILY TRACK PUMPING SESSIONS- Easily connect your Smartpump and Smartpump 2.0 via Bluetooth® technology, with a built-in guide to help you learn your new pump! Seamlessly track pumping sessions from the moment your Smartpump or Smartpump 2.0 is turned on. The time and date stamp along with the easy-to-use breastmilk volume input provide a snapshot of your pumping trends. View your pump settings from the app, saving you one less hassle. Also, you can record sessions as a timer with any other breast pump, so you can keep all your milk production information in one place.
BREASTFEEDING BUDDY- Breastfeeding may be natural, but it does not always come naturally. Lansinoh® Smartpump 2.0 app records the time you start breastfeeding and the duration of that feed. It also keeps track of which side baby nursed from last. This way, you always know which side to start from the next time the baby is hungry - one less thing for you to remember!
TRACK BOTTLE FEEDING- Keep track of what time the baby had a bottle and how much the baby ate.
DIRTY DIAPER DIARY- As a new mom, you may be surprised at how much you have to keep track of baby’s bathroom habits. The app creates a fun space to record baby’s wet and dirty diapers. Add a picture of baby's diaper so you can quickly reference at doctor's appointments.
GROWTH CHARTS- Keep track of baby's weight, height and head circumference and compare to the WHO growth charts or Fenton growth charts for Premie babies. Chart automatically determined for you!
TRACK MULTIPLE BABIES- Mulitple baby support for twins or siblings.
ENCYCLOPEDIA LANSINOH® 
After more than 30 years of supporting breastfeeding moms, Lansinoh® has a great collection of information to help you on your journey. Get access to all of it and the answers to your questions at your fingertips – even in the middle of the night.
We are here for you and are always looking for feedback. Please send any suggestions, ideas, or questions to app@lansinoh.com.

bluejetty:00180995:ios.description:
The "Abyss Tower" will take you on an adventure!
What awaits you there!?
Play an authentic hack-and-slash roguelike with simple left-right tap controls!
==========================
Introduction
==========================
This is an action rougelike game, where you explore automatically generated pixel dungeons and worlds. Enhance your equipment with the items you bring back after completing a dungeon.
◆Many actions available
Take a variety of actions such as jumping, wall-scaling, rolling, etc. by tapping on the left or right side of the screen. The character will run automatically in the tapped direction. 
◆Exploration mode: no change in the dungeon for a day
In normal exploration mode, the dungeon does not change throughout the day. The same stage can be played again even if you fail, allowing you to remembering the map layout. During the same day, all players will conquer the same stages, so you may be able to share information among other dungeon explorers.
◆Deep exploration mode: changes its dungeon with each play
You can enjoy more rogue-like play in deep exploration mode, where the layout of the dungeon changes with each play.
◆A variety of weapons such as swords, spears, staves, etc.
Players can use the materials they bring back from exploring the dungeons to strengthen the various weapons they equip.
You can also combine weapons of the same type to further enhance them.
◆Change your avatar by changing your equipment
When you wear various types of equipment, the avatar of the player character changes! You can also change the color and enjoy customizing it for each player.

bluejetty:00029632:ios.description:
The Most Powerful Hiking Planner & Navigation App for Confident Adventures. Plan, Map and Tracker with HiiKER.
HiiKER is the best digital toolkit for serious hikers and multi-day trekkers. Our biggest update yet, HiiKER 26, brings a new era of powerful planning and superior mapping to your fingertips.
• Get inspired by over 130,000 hiking trails
• View the world's best topographic maps.
• Plan detailed hiking routes with ease
• Discover millions of hiking focused POIs, places to rest, eat and see.
• Used by Mountain Rescue Teams across the world.
--------------
Navigate with Confidence
Quality Maps on Offer
High-Quality Topographic Maps: HiiKER features high-quality topographic maps from national and independent mapping agencies worldwide, including OS Mapping and Harvey Maps (UK), OSi and EastWest Mapping (IE), USGS and Purple Lizard (US), IGN (FR, ES, BE), Kompass (DE, AT) and more in Italy, Greece and Eastern Europe. All offline and in 3D!
Free 3D Previews: View any map in stunning 3D to see real-time terrain and elevation details for every peak and valley—available for free, unlike competitor apps.
Free Offline Maps: With HiiKER PRO+, download your favourite trails for reliable offline navigation in areas with limited or no cell service.
--------------
A New Standard in Hike Planning
The new HiiKER planner is purpose-built for complex, multi-day adventures.
Easy to use: Create a short weekend route in seconds, or meticulously plan each step of an epic multi-day hiking trip.
Segment Your Adventure: Easily split your planned route into multiple days and routes. Reorder, merge, and split sections with drag-and-drop flexibility, making long-distance trek planning accessible.
Complex Routing Made Simple: Mark segments as Alternative Routes, Spurs, or Transport Routes (which won't count toward hike stats) to handle all potential itinerary variations.
Flexible Path Drawing: Switch between snapping to walking paths, cycling paths, driving roads, or drawing straight lines for off-trail sections.
Add Highlights: Mark unmissable locations, points of interest, and rest-stops directly on the map to create a detailed day itinerary.
--------------
Reliable Tools for the Trail
GPX Files & Device Sync: Import your own GPX files or export any HiiKER trail to GPX for seamless syncing with devices like Garmin.
Safety Features: Use the Live Locator to share your real-time position with others, and get Off-Route Notifications if you stray from your plan.
--------------
Download HiiKER and start planning your next adventure today.
--------------
Contact
For support, email us at: customer-support@hiiker.co
Legal
Terms of Service: https://hiiker.app/terms-of-service
