bluejetty:00066299:ios.description:
** Apple Arcade Game of the Year Winner! **
Live the life of a Sasquatch and do regular everyday Sasquatch stuff like: 
- Sneak around campsites
- Disguise yourself in human clothing
- Eat food from unguarded coolers and picnic baskets 
- Play a quick 9 holes at the golf course
- Adopt a lost dog and take care of it
- Go fishing at the lake
- Cook sausages on an engine block
- Crush cars with a monster truck
- Get chased around by the park ranger
- Dig up buried treasure
- Take a driving test and get your driver’s license
- Shred some powder at the ski hill
- Work as a doctor and diagnose patients with laboratory tests, X-rays, and an electrocardiogram
- Buy, upgrade, and race vehicles at the racetrack
- Get a team of ducks to build upgrades for your house
- Rent an apartment in the nearby town
- Get certified to operate a forklift and unload cargo ships
- Work as an executive at a major corporation
- Get a camera and fill up a photo album with memories
- Work as a photographer at the local newspaper
- Watch television from the comfort of your own home
- Apply for a taxi license and drive people around
- Work as a security guard at the local port and file paperwork
- Have your disguises customized by a fashionable duck
- Play virtual arcade games like 'Parking Master' and 'Arcade Simulator' to win big prizes
- Take a ferry over to an island
- Get a surfboard and shred some waves to impress the locals
- Shop for furniture and have it shipped to your house via express delivery
- Buy a boat and catch some saltwater fish in the ocean
- Invest in a spaghetti-based business venture and revolutionize the industry
- Go waterskiing, or take someone else waterskiing
- Ride the bus, or drive people around as a bus driver for fun and profit
- Carve pumpkins, go trick-or-treating, and celebrate Halloween
- Compete in battle royale snowball fight events
- Obtain highly accredited diplomas from late night television infomercials
- Dig up dinosaur bones and make a T-Rex skeleton
- Go scuba diving with your dog and explore sunken ships and pirate treasure
- Accidentally irradiate patients while working at the hospital
- Work as a police officer and write speeding tickets and other traffic violations
- Explore the sewers and smell terrible afterwards
- Modify your vehicles with rims, tires, and customizable parts
- Race in motocross events and do 360 spins
- Tend to a virtual camp fire and try not to burn the forest down
- Buy a cell phone and take your calls on the road
- Work as a delivery driver for a shipping company

bluejetty:00035848:ios.description:
Wake up and smell the coffee because TapBlaze's newest simulation cooking game, Good Coffee, Great Coffee, is finally here! Prepare delicious drinks, experiment with new flavors, decorate your shop, and manage cafe costs to become the best barista in town!
Fulfill quirky customer orders with coffee drinks that look and taste delicious! Upgrade your shop with new decorations and equipment to increase your cafe profit! Make friends, rivals, and more when locals visit your shop! Listen to their stories and inspire the town with your coffee-making skills!
Download the game now to become the next coffee master! This cooking game is free to play, can be played offline, and is perfect for anyone who loves cozy games, cafe games, simulation games, and coffee! Grab your apron and start your journey as a barista now!
GAME HIGHLIGHTS
* Over 200 customers with unique coffee orders, stories, and personalities!
* Coffee drink recipes featuring a variety of ingredients and toppings.
* Creative and fun latte art drawing to up your coffee game!
* Customizable and collectible cozy coffee shop decorations!
* An immersive main story with coffee challenges and funny side stories!
* Charming scenery, relaxing BGM, and ASMR sounds to complement your coffee-making experience!
* Customizable and collectible cozy coffee shop decorations!
* Powerful cafe equipment upgrades for maximum cafe efficiency and proficiency!
* Featuring Coffee News Scoop (CNS), the first newscast about all things cafe-related.
FUN FACTS
* Good Coffee, Great Coffee was made by a team of coffee lovers who took barista classes to ensure they captured the relaxing and realistic feeling of making coffee in the game!
* Made by the team that brought you the simulation game, Good Pizza, Great Pizza!
This simple, cozy, and cute coffee cafe cooking game is free to play! Download now and start your barista journey today!

bluejetty:00031509:ios.summary: This is a creative game app that inspires children's creativity. In this app, children can quickly assemble various classic engineering trucks, such as excavators, forklifts, road rollers, cranes, bulldozers, drilling rigs, dump trucks, con
bluejetty:00031509:ios.description:
This is a creative game app that inspires children's creativity. In this app, children can quickly assemble various classic engineering trucks, such as excavators, forklifts, road rollers, cranes, bulldozers, drilling rigs, dump trucks, concrete mixers, loaders, and more, using tutorial templates. The app provides a wide range of engineering truck components, basic components, and stickers, allowing children to freely create engineering trucks with unique styles. Once the creation is complete, children can control the engineering trucks to perform actions such as excavation, loading, dumping, running, and crushing, completing various fun construction tasks and experiencing the infinite charm of operating engineering trucks.
Features:
1. 2 design modes: Template Mode and Free Building Mode.
2. Over 60 classic engineering truck templates available in Template Mode.
3. Provides 34 types of engineering truck components.
5. 12 different colors of basic parts and truck parts to choose from.
6. A wide selection of car wheels and stickers.
7. Over 100 interesting engineering construction tasks & levels.
8. Share your engineering trucks with other players and browse or download engineering trucks created by others online.
- About Labo Lado: 
We create apps that spark curiosity and foster creativity in children. 
We do not collect any personal information or include any third-party advertising. For more information, please see our Privacy Policy: https://www.labolado.com/apps-privacy-policy.html 
Join our Facebook Page: https://www.facebook.com/labo.lado.7 
Follow us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/labo_lado
Support: http://www.labolado.com
- We value your feedback 
Feel free to rate and review our app or feedback to our email: app@labolado.com. 
- Need Help 
Contact us 24/7 with any questions or comments: app@labolado.com
- Summary
STEM and STEAM (Science,Technology,Engineering,Arts and Mathematics) education app. In this game,children can create and control construction vehicles including excavators,bulldozers,concrete mixers,cranes,and forklifts. Operating these vehicles allows children to learn mechanics and physics while unleashing their creativity. The game builds problem-solving skills and sparks interest in engineering and architecture. It also cultivates spatial thinking,computational thinking,design capabilities,and prototype development.

bluejetty:00040294:ios.description:

・Easy to start for first players. Let’s challenge!

Very easy operation method!
・Search by tapping the screen.
・Change the viewpoint by tapping the button on the bottom of the screen.
・Double tap the item button, it will enlarged.
・Use an item by dragging it.
・While one item is displayed, select another item by either tapping or dragging it to combine them.

bluejetty:00138660:ios.description:
Interium is an AI interior design app that helps you reimagine your home decor and room interiors. Transform any space—your living room, bedroom, bathroom, or kitchen—into a stylish room with new furniture, wall colors, and flooring. Explore creative home design ideas, discover fresh decor inspiration, and visualize every detail before making a single change.
Planning a home makeover, refreshing your living room decor, or exploring new interior decorating trends? Snap a photo, choose a style, and watch your space transform—no designer needed.
【 WHAT YOU CAN DO 】
▶Interior Design
Wondering how your room would look in a different style? Upload a photo, choose from 15+ curated AI interior design styles—Modern, Japandi, Mid-Century, Scandinavian, Minimalist, and more—and get a photorealistic redesign in seconds. Want a specific look? Pick a color palette to match your taste. Want to start fresh? Enable Remove Current Furniture to clear the room first.
▶Rearrange Furniture
What if that sofa looked better by the window? Rearrange, swap, and try different furniture layouts instantly—without moving a thing.
▶Virtual Staging
Need to stage an empty property without the cost? Fill any room with curated home decor and furniture choices to help buyers see its potential—perfect for listings on Zillow, Redfin, or Realtor.com.
▶Design from Reference
Spotted a living room on Pinterest or Instagram you love? Upload any inspiration image and Interium will recreate that aesthetic in your own space.
▶Furniture Finder
Love a piece of furniture but have no idea where to buy it? Add an image or snap a photo and Interium will identify it instantly. Browse visually similar furniture from online furniture stores, compare prices across matching products, and purchase favorites.
▶Change Flooring & Paint Walls
Not sure about that paint color or new flooring? Test any wall color or wall paint on your actual room—no guessing, no regret.
▶Object Replace
Want to see how new furniture or decor would look before you buy? Make targeted changes with simple prompts—swap furniture, restyle cabinets, or try different decor accents.
▶Garden Design
Curious what your backyard or patio could become? Explore outdoor garden and landscape design templates—Mediterranean, Japanese Zen, Xeriscaping, and more.
▶Interior & Outdoor Decor
Want to deck out your home, inside and out, for the holidays? Add garlands, lights, and seasonal accents for Christmas, Halloween, and beyond—no decorator required.
【 WHO IT’S FOR 】
- Homeowners & renters who want to visualize a new look before spending a dollar
- Real estate agents who need fast, professional virtual staging for listings
- Interior designers looking for quick AI interior design concepts to present to clients
- DIY decorators & design inspiration hunters who want to recreate styles they discover online
【 FAQ 】
Q: How can I redesign my room with AI?
A: Take a photo, choose a style, and tap Generate. Interium creates a photorealistic redesign in seconds.
Q: How can I virtually stage a home for sale?
A: Upload a photo of an empty room, pick a style, and Interium fills it with furniture and decor instantly.
Q: Can I make small changes without redesigning the whole room?
A: Yes. Change wall colors, update flooring, rearrange furniture, or swap decor—without touching the rest of your room.
Q: Can I recreate a design style I saw online?
A: Upload any inspiration image and Interium will recreate that look in your own space.
Join over 10M+ rooms already transformed with AI home design. See what your home could become—and make it a space you’re proud to show off.
The app requires iOS 17.0 or later.
ACCESS TO INTERIUM
- You can subscribe to everything the app has to offer.
- Subscriptions are billed automatically based on the selected subscription plan.
By using the app, you agree to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:
https://aiby.mobi/ai_interior_ios/terms

bluejetty:00171535:ios.description:
Transform your cardio with guided Treadmill workouts. Live with energy, choose a workout plan that hits your goal. Suitable for all runners, all you need is a treadmill.
Get the workouts you need to meet your personal fitness target. Build strength, lose weight or improve your general health. New to running or the treadmill? Begin with our Starter Plan. Looking to lose weight? We have a weight loss hiit plan, perfect for you!
Train from just 2 days a week to improve your treadmill running with simple approachable routines. Everything is tracked to keep you motivated. Each plan is built to help your body adapt and improve while minimising risk of injury or burn out.
FEATURES
- Guided programs. Choose a plan based on your level and goal. If you run indoors on a treadmill, you can use all of the routines, from beginner plans to HIIT advanced workouts.
- Track your daily activity and make sure you keep on growing. Record your calories, heart rate and distance so you can watch your growth and running ability improve over time.
- Audio coach with guided cues and support to play your own music in the background.
- Log your workouts, with the ability to repeat your favorites. We'll record your progress so you can gradually improve and become a stronger runner. Your treadmill won't know what hit it!
- Supplement your workouts with recommended exercises. Warm up and cool down effectively and build full body strength with additional exercises.
- APPLE HEALTH INTEGRATION: Saves your workouts to Apple Health so you can track your progress along with other daily activities.

bluejetty:00176077:ios.description:
Baby Panda's Kids Games brings together all the favorite BabyBus games and animations, with adorable Kiki and Miumiu joining kids on a journey to explore the world!
It covers a wide range of themes, including town life, princess dress-up, and car driving! Through fun games, kids learn to create, explore, design, imagine, and apply their skills in real life!
OPEN WORLD GAMES
The town series games are coming one after another! Explore apartments, hospitals, daycares, bakeries, and countless other scenes! Kids can freely decorate their houses, create amazing characters, and customize skin tones, facial features, and expressions! With immersive simulation, they experience a diverse life as the sole protagonist in an open world!
GIRLS' DREAM GAMES
Explore various girls' games, princess games, coloring games, and other mini-games! Kids can become little princesses, roam the dreamy town, do makeup, dress up, and decorate castles for a fairy-tale life! They can also bake desserts in the bakery, run an ice cream cart, doodle with glow pens, and enjoy endless girl-time fun!
BOYS' ADVENTURE GAMES
Baby Panda's Kids Games is packed with exciting mini-games for adventurous boys! You can play as a brave police officer on thrilling rescue missions, sail the seas on a boating adventure, or explore the prehistoric world of dinosaurs. Enjoy fun-filled games that boost logic skills and enrich every moment during the growth!
LIFE SKILL GAMES
Kids can learn everyday life skills through fun simulations—from brushing their teeth and using the toilet on their own to tidying the house and caring for babies. The games also feature safety lessons, like earthquake drills, home safety tips, and proper car seat use, helping children learn to protect themselves!
In addition to Baby Panda games, more animated videos and popular songs are now available: Sheriff Labrador, Panda Rescue Team, Baby Shark, Twinkle Twinkle Little Star, and more. Open the app and start watching now!
FEATURES:
- Massive kids content: 11 themes and 180+ Baby Panda games;
- 1,000+ episodes of animations and nursery rhymes: Sheriff Labrador, Panda Rescue Team, Baby Shark, Twinkle Twinkle Little Star, and more are constantly updated;
- Supports offline play: Download multiple games at the same time to play offline anytime;
- Mini games: There are many lightweight games with small memory requirements;
- Regular updates: New games, animations, and songs every month;

bluejetty:00153641:ios.name: Uboat: Sea War
bluejetty:00153641:ios.summary: Command your U-boat and dive into the depths of naval warfare! Launch torpedoes, dodge enemy destroyers, and outmaneuver warships in intense underwater battles. Upgrade your U-boat, unlock powerful weapons, defend your fleet against various
bluejetty:00153641:ios.description:
Command your U-boat and dive into the depths of naval warfare! Launch torpedoes, dodge enemy destroyers, and outmaneuver warships in intense underwater battles. Upgrade your U-boat, unlock powerful weapons, defend your fleet against various uboat attacks and become the most feared captain beneath the waves. Are you ready to rule the ocean?
Take command in real-time submarine combat where every maneuver counts. Patrol the seas, track enemy fleets, and strike with precision to sink armadas before they find you. Engage in survival missions, tactical campaigns, and special challenges that will test your skills as a navy fighter. From icy arctic waters to deep abyssal canyons and sunken ruins, explore diverse battle zones and use the environment to gain tactical advantage.
Arm yourself with deadly torpedoes, sonar tools, and advanced upgrades to enhance your submarine. Each weapon system can be improved for different strategies, from stealth ambushes to all-out assaults. Manage your crew, repair damage under fire, and adapt to realistic underwater conditions where a single mistake could lead to disaster.
Experience the thrill of naval warfare in stunning detail. Realistic ship models, immersive underwater effects, and explosive torpedo impacts bring every encounter to life. Intuitive controls allow you to dive, evade, and fire with ease, but true mastery requires sharp reflexes and tactical decision-making.
Face off against waves of destroyers, aircraft carriers, and rival submarines. Defend your fleet in large-scale battles, climb through the navy ranks, and earn your reputation as an unstoppable commander. Collect resources from successful missions to unlock new submarines and special modules, pushing your war machine to its limits.
Whether you’re a casual commander or a veteran strategist, this uboat attack game delivers intense action and deep tactical gameplay. Dominate the sea, crush enemy fleets, and write your legacy as the ultimate U-boat captain.
Features:
-Dozens of enemy ships – hunt down destroyers, carriers, and rival submarines across global waters
-Dynamic battle environments – arctic wastelands, deep trenches and more
-Upgradeable submarines – enhance torpedoes, sonar, armor, and speed to fit your strategy
-Intuitive controls – simple navigation and precision firing
-Immersive visuals – detailed submarines and cinematic effects
-Survival and mission modes – test your endurance, complete tactical operations, and unlock rewards
-Rank progression – rise through the navy hierarchy and prove yourself as the ultimate captain

iCardio turns your heart rate into a powerful training tool. See your heart rate zones live as you work out, get instant feedback, and optimize every session to reach your goals faster — whether you’re training for endurance, weight loss, or general fitness.

bluejetty:00197309:android.description:
The WB Partners application has become Scan Acceptance. Only the tools for self-receipt of goods remained in the application - we moved everything else to the new “WB Partners” application.
Scan acceptance will help you independently accept goods and ship them to the warehouse faster. You collect goods in boxes, paste QR codes and scan them with your smartphone. At the warehouse, such deliveries are accepted in a separate queue and without any restrictions on limits.
Advantages:
— delivery can be created on a smartphone, without a computer or laptop
— you accept each product yourself and control the assembly process, reducing the amount of impersonality and shortages
— in the warehouse, goods will immediately go to layout and appear on the website faster
Peculiarities:
— suitable only for the “Marketplace” model
— preparation takes more time: you need to print QR codes of goods and boxes, stick stickers and scan them with a smartphone
— goods with a limited shelf life, large-sized and oversized goods cannot be supplied

bluejetty:00187584:ios.description:
QUICK AND EASY time entry and editing make time tracking painless
• Record time using timers, complete with support for Breaks and Pauses, including automatic breaks
• Track your pay, including Tips, Mileage, and flexible ± time and earnings adjustments
• Pick any time to start, stop, break or pause the timer (7 minutes ago, 10 minutes from now, whatever you need)
• Set job locations to get clock in and out reminders when you arrive or leave or fully automate your time tracking (geofencing)
• Manually enter time entries with minimal effort thanks to smart, adaptive defaults
• Enter comments of any length with your time entries and optionally include them in your exports
• Control timers, dictate comments, and apply tags using your Apple Watch
ADVANCED FEATURES and customization set HoursTracker above the rest
• Automatic daily and weekly overtime earnings calculations
• Built-in reports by Day, Week, and Month and support for most common pay period schedules
• Robust tagging and filtering allow you to build your own custom views
• Reminders when you've worked your target number of hours per day (even takes time rounding into account)
• Automatic time rounding: up, down, or to nearest (including 6 min)
• Easily copy an existing job or time entry to save time and effort
• Reminders you to clock in on your selected work days
• Today Widget for at a glance time and pay monitoring
• CSV and formatted text export via e-mail or the iOS Share Sheet
• Passcode lock (with Touch ID & Face ID support) helps keep your HoursTracker data private
• Cloud-based backup/restore with one re-usable backup slot included free (free account sign up is required)
• Web-based reporting access, including charts, graphs, desktop exports, and rolling backups available with optional subscription
• Customize your HoursTracker experience in the Preferences section under the More tab. Choose only one or many jobs clocked in at a time, opt-into prompts for comments, choose an elapsed time format (hours:minutes, or decimal hours), and more
"Free Edition" stores up to 3 jobs and 21 days of entries. For unlimited entries, subscribe to "Premium" (up to 5 jobs) or "Unlimited" (unlimited jobs). Or, erase older data and continue to use the "Free Edition" until you're ready to buy.
Visit our website at http://www.hourstrackerapp.com to learn more, and follow @HoursTracker on Twitter or facebook.com/HoursTracker to hear about upcoming features first.

Merge Wood Block Puzzle is the perfect puzzle game for you. Be the real hero of puzzle games by merging and discovering hundreds of number blocks!
You'll get to enjoy this amazing new puzzles game for free while improving your memory, concentration levels and reflexes at the same time, entertaining your brain for hours.

- Just drag and drop!
- Combine 2 of the same numbers to merge them into a bigger number
- Remove extra blocks by charging the booster gauge
- Try to remove multiple blocks at a time to get a higher score
- Keep merging numbers to get the highest number possible
- Challenge yourself with Endless Mode ~ Let’s merge to infinity!
- Design your own board with beautiful backgrounds and special merge effects
- Pause if you need to leave, and continue anytime with the auto-saving system

- Easy to play, challenging to master – Test your brainpower with the swipe of your finger

bluejetty:00171255:ios.summary:
• GPA made easy with Fourpoint! • 
Fourpoint makes it easy for to calculate the GPA of a single semesters, and the cumulative GPA of your educational career.
• As you add semesters and courses Fourpoint will provide you quick and accurate
bluejetty:00171255:ios.description:
• GPA made easy with Fourpoint! • 
Fourpoint makes it easy for to calculate the GPA of a single semesters, and the cumulative GPA of your educational career.
• As you add semesters and courses Fourpoint will provide you quick and accurate GPA results. 
• Supports multiple schools
Getting Started: 
Tap '+' in the upper-right corner to add a semester. Tap it again to add courses. 
Useful Bits: 
• You can designate a course as Pass/Fail 
• You can set a course to not count toward your GPA 
 •Courses that 'do not count' or are pass/fail will not count toward GPA calculation. Their hours will still be added to your totals (pending the pass/fail course was passed). 
• You can set the weight of grades for each school.
• You can set a custom-weight an a course-by-course basis
• Determine your major GPA! Courses can be included in your 'Major' in course settings. A secondary Major can be enabled in school settings!
• You can designate courses as in progress! As courses get completed they will affect your cumulative GPA
• You can add past GPA history with two numbers: Q-Points and Hours. These can typically be found on an unofficial transcript or calculated by hand. 
 • Enter the GPA History carefully to make sure you don't count the same class twice! The information in your history should not contain information for courses that you've added manually. 
This app is supported by Google Admob. 
If you would like to contact me to propose/discuss future features please contact me at fourpointapp@gmail.com . 
Feel free to contact me about other stuff too. Bugs, Issues, Conversation, etc. 
Thank you for the support and checking out my app!

bluejetty:00160994:ios.description:
Unleash the Excitement in Slam Clash!
Get ready for non-stop fun and high-energy action in Slam Clash! Travel through captivating worlds, collect an epic variety of digital caps, and dive into thrilling mini-games. It’s a nostalgic nod to the 90s cap craze—reimagined for the digital age!
Begin Your Ultimate Cap Quest
Venture through a series of themed zones, each filled with its own unique twists and challenges. From buzzing cityscapes to whimsical fantasy lands, there’s always a new surprise waiting. Let your trusty guide, Slammer Sam, lead the way through this wild and wonderful cap adventure!
Collect, Trade & Complete Your Set
Hunt down hundreds of cool, quirky, and rare caps—featuring exclusive designs, beloved characters, and limited-edition drops. Connect with friends and players from around the globe to trade, collect, and become the reigning Cap Champion!
Master the Flip & Slam!
Put your skills to the test with classic cap-flipping gameplay infused with a modern edge. Challenge opponents in high-stakes slams, perfect your technique, and climb the leaderboard. Earn coins and unlock powerful caps as you dominate every match!
Join the Global Cap Crew
Form teams, complete daily missions, and compete in exciting events. Share your progress, trade your best finds, and team up with others in the vibrant Slam Clash! community. The cap-flipping universe is more fun with friends!
With regular updates, time-limited events, and new cap collections always on the horizon, there’s never a dull moment. Explore fresh content, unlock new worlds, and keep the adventure alive!
Slam Clash! is free to play, with optional in-app purchases. A stable internet connection is required for full functionality.
Download now and start your cap-flipping journey today!

bluejetty:00021737:ios.summary: Record Collector is Britain’s longest-running rock and pop music monthly. Our motto is “Serious about music”, because we know our readers are totally passionate about what they listen to. You don’t have to be a vinyl freak to love Record Co
bluejetty:00021737:ios.description:
Record Collector is Britain’s longest-running rock and pop music monthly. Our motto is “Serious about music”, because we know our readers are totally passionate about what they listen to. You don’t have to be a vinyl freak to love Record Collector. We pride ourselves on bringing you the best features about music, with artist interviews, discographies and all the inside knowledge that only RC can deliver. And it’s not only rock’n’roll: we cover pop, soul, 80s, psychedelia, folk, rockabilly. If it’s good enough, it has a place in RC. The magazine boasts a formidable reviews department in which modern gems nestle alongside classic reissues; we sift the musical treasures from retro rubbish; we tell you what’s happening in the world of music auctions, and there’s all the news that any discerning music fan could want. 
----------------------------------------------
This is a free app download. Within the app users can purchase the current issue and back issues.
Subscriptions are also available within the application. A subscription will start from the latest regular issue at the time of purchase.
-The subscription will renew automatically unless cancelled more than 24 hours before the end of the current period. You will be charged for renewal within 24 hours of the end of the current period, for the same duration and at the current subscription rate for the product.
-You may turn off the auto-renewal of subscriptions through your Account Settings, however you are not able to cancel the current subscription during its active period.
-Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase and any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when a subscription to that publication is purchased.
-If a subscription offers a free trial, at the end of the trial period, you will be charged the full price of the subscription. You may cancel a subscription during its free trial period via the subscription settings on your iTunes account. This must be done 24 hours before the end of the subscription period to avoid being charged.
Users can register for/ login to a pocketmags account in-app. This will protect their issues in the case of a lost device and allow browsing of purchases on multiple platforms. Existing pocketmags users can retrieve their purchases by logging into their account.
We recommend loading the app for the first time in a wi-fi area so that all issue data is retrieved.
If your app will not load past the splash page after a first install or an update, please delete and reinstall the app from the App Store
Help and frequently asked questions can be accessed in-app and on pocketmags.
If you have any problems at all please do not hesitate to contact us: help@pocketmags.com
--------------------
You can find our privacy policy here:
http://www.pocketmags.com/privacy.aspx
You can find our terms and conditions here:
http://www.pocketmags.com/terms.aspx

bluejetty:00146216:ios.description:
OutLearn: Master Your Studies with Flashcards, LaTeX, and Spaced Repetition
OutLearn is the ultimate learning tool for students, by students. Whether you're preparing for exams or looking to retain knowledge long-term, OutLearn makes learning smarter, faster, and more effective.
Key Features:
LaTeX Support: Write complex math equations, formulas, and scientific notation directly in your flashcards with easy-to-use LaTeX integration. Perfect for math, science, and engineering students.
Spaced Repetition: Use the power of spaced repetition to enhance your memory retention. Our advanced algorithm helps you review cards just before you forget them, ensuring long-term retention.
Two Learning Modes:
Binge Learn: Cram for your exams when time is short.
Long-Term Learn: Use spaced repetition to build knowledge that lasts.
More Reasons to Love OutLearn:
Offline Learning: Study anywhere, anytime with the flashcard app offline feature.
Custom Flashcards: Add colors, images, and diagrams, and create flashcards using LaTeX for any subject, including maths cards.
Image Occlusion: Perfect for learning anatomy, diagrams, and more.
AI-Powered Flashcards: Get smarter with AI-powered flashcard recommendations to optimize your study sessions.
Printable Flashcards: Prefer paper? OutLearn lets you easily create and print your flashcards for on-the-go studying.
Share and Collaborate: Share your flashcard decks with classmates and friends, making collaborative learning easier.
Free Flashcard Learning: OutLearn is a free flashcard app, making it accessible for every student.
Whether you’re solving complex equations with LaTeX or retaining crucial information with spaced repetition, OutLearn gives you the tools to succeed in any subject. Perfect for students studying math, science, or any other discipline that requires deep understanding and retention.
Download OutLearn and transform the way you study!

listings.name: OutLearn: Flashcards & Study
listings.description:
OutLearn is the flashcard app made for students, by students. Make cards in seconds, study them the way that suits you, and remember them for good.

SMART SPACED REPETITION
OutLearn brings every card back right before you'd forget it, with FSRS, the same scheduling method Anki uses. After a few hundred reviews it personalizes itself to how you remember.

CREATE CARDS FAST
• Generate flashcards with AI from your notes
• Import your Anki decks, or text exports from other flashcard apps
• Paste or drag images straight into a card
• Built-in translator for language learning
• Text to speech to hear your cards

MADE FOR REAL SUBJECTS
• LaTeX for math, physics and chemistry
• Image occlusion for anatomy, maps and diagrams
• Cloze deletions and multiple choice cards
• Colors and formatting

STUDY YOUR WAY
• Binge Learn when the exam is tomorrow
• Long Term Learn with spaced repetition
• Exam Mode to test yourself, then retest only the cards you missed
• Search every card in every deck, and folders inside folders

WORKS EVERYWHERE
iPhone, iPad, Mac and the web, all synced. Works offline too. Home screen widgets, dark mode, printable flashcards and thousands of free decks shared by other students.

FAIR PRICING
OutLearn is free. Pro is a one-time purchase, never a subscription.

bluejetty:00184738:ios.name: Star Trek Timelines
bluejetty:00184738:ios.summary: Welcome to Starfleet, Captain! STAR TREK TIMELINES is the ultimate Star Trek™ sci-fi and role-playing mobile game with the battle on a spaceship in space. Conquer the galaxy with them! Set your phaser to stun and join Starfleet on an advent
bluejetty:00184738:ios.description:
Welcome to Starfleet, Captain! STAR TREK TIMELINES is the ultimate Star Trek™ sci-fi and role-playing mobile game with the battle on a spaceship in space. Conquer the galaxy with them! Set your phaser to stun and join Starfleet on an adventure through space to save the galaxy from a time anomaly. The STAR TREK TIMELINES brings together the heroes and villains of Star Trek history. Experience epic combat in this Star Trek™ strategy game! Are you ready to join this galaxy space war with your best starships?
The first mobile game to include ships and characters from the new series, Star Trek: Discovery. Get ready to explore the infinite universe, build your space station, construct your powerful fleet, and join alliances to occupy regions of space together in this PvP galaxy battles! Join a fleet, explore the unknown areas in space, and gather your friends to help you take control of the galaxy! Conquer the Galaxy! 
Galaxy starship allows you to travel through endless universes with many planets to conquer. As the commander of a starbase in the galaxy space, you will join powerful alliances, defeat your enemies, and build an epic fleet to protect your empire in the galaxy. Take command of your starship and save the galaxy in this classic space combat simulator game.
FEATURES of Star Trek Timelines - Space Wars & Galaxy Fleet Attack:
ASSEMBLE YOUR CREW with hundreds of characters from all the Star Trek worlds, including the Original Series, The Next Generation, Deep Space Nine, Voyager, Enterprise, Picard, and Discovery. Each character has their own unique combat skills and abilities. Play as your favorite character: Spock, Picard, Captain Kirk, Worf, Janeway, Burnham, and many more to choose from. Create your own epic team using the strongest Heroes and the Villains from Star Trek! Assemble the strongest crew and get ready to fight in this galaxy space wars game!
COMMAND ICONIC STARSHIPS FORCE, including U.S.S. Enterprise, Voyager, and Shenzhou, the Klingon Bird-of-Prey and Sarcophagus ships, or even the Borg Cube - the iconic spacecraft used by the Borg Collective, and many more. As the commander of an interstellar spaceship, you have to command the different starships to attack. You have the power to overcome your alien enemies! Then, build up the powerful starship and equip it to be ready for war!
JOIN A FLEET COMMAND to team up with your friends, compete together in weekend events, and collaboratively upgrade starbases for shared bonuses. Unlock unique spaceships and upgrade them with powerful weapons and construct the best fleet command to increase attack, defense, and evasion. Form a fleet with your starships and take them into battle.
DEFEAT YOUR ENEMIES in 3D starship battles with exciting PvE play, or in the PvP battle arena where you'll test your crew’s ability against the best Captains in the galaxy. Train your skills in strategy and combat to overcome the dangerous universe of Star Trek Timelines.
UPGRADE YOUR BATTLESHIPS and epic items to complete the different missions. Take your space fighter to the battlefield armed with an arsenal of weapons and use your flight agility to fly through lethal enemy territory in this stunning galaxy shooting game. Control your battleships and kill the space shooter during the wars. 
In STAR TREK TIMELINES, you will take on the role of a Captain, commanding your first starship. Build up your best crew of Star Trek characters in this online sci-fi and RPG legends game. Navigate through the galaxy by building and upgrading ships, engaging in intense space battles, and completing challenging missions. Join a fleet, discover the unknown, and assemble your friends to help you take control of the galaxy shooter war!

bluejetty:00145614:ios.description:
HTTP Traffic Capture is a lightweight HTTP & HTTPs packet capture tool for common users who have network analysis capabilities. 
Features:
1. Support HTTP and HTTPs traffic analysis
2. Support HTML, Javascript, CSS, picture (webp, jpeg, png) preview, and binary data viewing
3. Support for setting packet capture rules
4. Support historical packet capture records
5. Support filtering historical packet content
6. Support exporting the captured packet content
Instructions:
1. The software can support HTTP packet capture by default. If you need to capture and parse HTTPs traffic, you need to install a certificate
2. Click the start button, the system will create and connect to the vpn, and start the packet capture process; if you reject the vpn configuration, the packet capture cannot be performed
3. Click the orange task bar to view the current session, and click the session to view the session request and response
4. Click the request line and response line in the session to export the corresponding value
5. You can filter the content of a specific domain name through the filter button
6. You can export the session content through the export button
7. Click the stop button, a history record will be generated for subsequent viewing
8. If you need to clean up all data, you can go to the settings page and click the clear all data button
How the software works:
After opening the packet capture, the software will start a vpn and direct the vpn data packet to the local HTTP proxy server. Complete the analysis and storage of the data packet in the local proxy server. For HTTTPs data, you need to install and trust the certificate to successfully parse it.
Data security:
Since packet capture software involves user privacy data, privacy protection is the most important design consideration for software. To this end, we have made the following mechanism for this purpose:
1. The software's CA key and CA certificate are dynamically and randomly generated by the software and stored in the sandbox. No one can know the user's CA private key.
2. The certificate cannot be shared between different users.
3. After reinstalling the application, the history will cause the certificate to become invalid, and the user can manually delete the certificate in the settings.
4. The certificate is valid for one year. After the certificate expires, the user needs to regenerate it before it can be used.
5. The HTTP data captured by the software is only stored locally and will not be uploaded to any other place.
6. The user cannot modify the network request through the software to prevent some improper behavior.
System configuration instructions:
HTTP proxy server: 127.0.0.1:9080
Certificate description file name: Traffic Capture YYYY-MM-dd HH:mm, where YYYY-MM-dd HH:mm is the time when the certificate is generated
VPN description file name: "Traffic Capture"

Welcome to Timpy Kids Piano Music World, the perfect musical adventure designed to captivate and educate kids and toddlers with fun mini-games.
Did you know that playing musical instruments like the piano, xylophone, and flute can profoundly benefit children? Piano World offers a delightful world of melodies and fun, expertly blending entertainment with educational value to enrich your child's early learning experience.
We have curated fun musical games for Kids, including: 
VARIOUS INSTRUMENTS
PIANO BALLOON POPPING GAMES
ANIMAL PIANO & SOUNDS
EMOJI SOUNDS GAME
GLOW PIANO BEAT GAME
MUSICAL FEEDING GAME
DANCE WITH PIANO GAME 
& MORE GAMES 
PIANO WORLD HELPS STRENGTHEN FOUNDATIONAL LEARNING: These simple musical games for kids improve fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination, boost cognitive skills, and encourage creativity. It fosters emotional expression, builds confidence, and nurtures essential social skills.
VARIOUS INSTRUMENTS:
Through interactive games that teach musical concepts and instrument recognition, children can explore and play various instruments, such as the piano, xylophone, saxophone, flute, guitar, and more. Our app guides children on a joyful musical journey by allowing them to create their melodies and fostering self-confidence through artistic expression.
PIANO BALLOON POPPING GAMES:
Prepare for Piano Balloon Popping, where the piano becomes a magical balloon party! Tap it and pop! It's like having a mini celebration with each note you play. Get ready to giggle and play with Piano Balloon Popping!
ANIMAL PIANO & SOUNDS
Explore Animal Piano, where tapping keys creates a symphony of animal sounds. It's an exciting way for kids to learn and recognize animals through playful melodies.
EMOJI SOUNDS GAME
Discover Emoji Sound Fun Game! Tap emojis to unleash them with funny sounds. Enjoy the playful chaos as it bounces around, creating laughter-inducing echoes. It's an emoji-filled adventure of joy and laughter for little ones.
GLOW PIANO BEAT GAME
Join the Glow Piano Beat Game! Tap keys to see beats shimmer and bounce with colorful animations following the pitch of each note. It's a magical journey of music and light for young ones.
MUSICAL FEEDING GAME
Explore the Feeding Game! Tap tiles to guide the character upward with musical beats. It's a fun challenge that enhances hand-eye coordination and rhythmic understanding.
DANCE WITH PIANO GAME 
Get ready for endless fun and learning by dancing to Various Tunes with adorable characters in a Piano Game! Watch your little one giggle and groove, making every playtime a delightful adventure.
Piano World is your child's music studio. They can explore different instruments, sounds, and beats to create masterpieces. Encourage your child to let their creativity shine and discover the joy of making music.

bluejetty:00031277:ios.description:
Bubble Original is a delightful and highly addictive bubble shooter game that provides hours of entertainment and relaxation.
Get the online color-matching app and enjoy smooth and addicting gameplay. With so many exciting levels, powerful boosters, and awesome features, you simply won’t put it down. Bubble original will have you addicted from the very first bubbles you shoot down. Pop and break all the balls to move on to the next awesome level. Play and enjoy plenty of fun challenges and puzzles, and make sure to reach the target of each level, clear the board and collect coins. Play it when you want to relax and clear your mind with this pastime shooter game. 
HOW TO PLAY
- Match 3 or more bubbles of the same color to make them burst.
- Clear all the bubbles on the screen to progress to the next level.
- Try to earn 3 stars on each level by breaking bubbles continuously for bonus points.
- Enjoy the colorful and relaxing bubble-popping experience.
FUN FEATURES
- More than 9000 challenging levels
- Pop all bubbles & unlock special events
- No energy, no pressure and No Wifi Needed
So, warm up your fingers, take aim, and start popping bubbles to explore thousands of exciting levels and puzzles. Bubble original is a great game for players of all ages, offering hours of fun and brain-teasing challenges. Enjoy this casual shooter and relax while you blast bubbles either online or offline. Have a great time playing!
Sugguestion or any feedbacks? Leave a message at support@moonpear.net . Our Team aim to deliver a better game experience every day for our players.
Follow us on Facebook: Bubble Original

bluejetty:00027162:ios.description:
LED Light Controller & Remote is a powerful and intuitive mobile application designed to give you universal control over your RGB Smart Lights or Strips via WIFI & Bluetooth. Whether you're relaxing at home, hosting a party, or trying to create a specific ambiance, the LED Light Controller & Remote has everything you need to set the mood with ease.
LED Light Controller & Remote allows you to control your RGB Smart Bulbs with precision. You can adjust the brightness, color temperature, and color of your lights using the app's intuitive interface.
The app comes with a range of pre-set scenes that you can choose from, or you can create your own custom scenes. With the LED Light Controller & Remote, you can create a warm, cozy ambiance for a night in, a bright and energetic vibe for a party, or a calming atmosphere for a yoga session.
LED Light Controller & Remote app has an intuitive and user-friendly interface. The main screen of the app shows your connected RGB Smart lights, and you can select each bulb individually. The app has a color wheel that allows you to choose the exact color you want your bulbs to display, and you can also adjust the brightness and color temperature of your lights.

The best-selling LEGO Batman franchise returns in an out-of-this-world, action-packed adventure! Play as Batman and join forces with characters from the DC Comics universe as you blast off to outer space to stop the evil Brainiac from destroying Earth.

Adventure through an original story set in outer space and Lantern worlds that include Zamaron and Odym or visit familiar DC realms in the Hall of Justice, the Batcave, and the Justice League Watchtower.
EVEN MORE CHARACTERS
Collect fan favorite characters such as Batman Beyond, the Dark Knight, and Batman ’66 throughout the year with plenty more on the way (coming soon)!
DYNAMIC CONTROL STYLES

bluejetty:00030938:ios.description:
Heroes Awaken presents unique gameplay, combining idle RPG elements, raids and building a mighty castle, with the epic tactics of auto battler teamfight. Start your legendary adventure today!
GAME FEATURES
• Enjoy our game freely with FREE TO PLAY system. Own 5 heroes immediately after completing the tutorial.

• Collect and upgrade 70+ legendary heroes from different Races and Classes. Each hero has unique abilities and traits.

• Outplay and outlast your opponents by building an elite squad of epic heroes ready to conquer the world

bluejetty:00145413:ios.name: New Star™ GP
bluejetty:00145413:ios.summary: NEW STAR™ GP is the arcade racing game where every decision counts - on and off the track! You take control of your own motorsport team, guide your team’s technological development, plan your race strategy, take the wheel, and drive to vict
bluejetty:00145413:ios.description:
NEW STAR™ GP is the arcade racing game where every decision counts - on and off the track! You take control of your own motorsport team, guide your team’s technological development, plan your race strategy, take the wheel, and drive to victory! With a simple but deep gameplay experience and appealing retro visuals, NEW STAR™ GP puts you in the driving seat for every twist and turn as you manage and race your team through decades of racing, from the 1980s all the way to the present day!
STUNNING RETRO VISUALS
Beautifully rendered retro looks and a driving retro soundtrack that bring back fond memories of the iconic racing games of the 1990s.
CHOOSE YOUR RACE STRATEGY!
A pick-up-and-play arcade driving experience that has more depth than you think. While anyone can take the wheel and have success, those who want to truly master the game will want to make use of tyre choice and wear, component reliability, slipstreaming opponents, fuel load, and even pit strategy. Anything can happen in races, from catastrophic component failures and dynamic weather changes, to tyre blowouts and multi-car pileups.
START YOUR CAREER IN THE 80s
Compete in GPs, Elimination Races, Time Trials, Checkpoint Races, and one-on-one Rival Races. In between events, choose how to upgrade your car, or which staff perks to equip: from sponsored car components to faster pit stops. When you’ve won a season, progress to the next decade of racing and face a new set of opponents and challenges in a brand new car!
RACE ICONIC LOCATIONS AROUND THE WORLD!
Race a myriad of events across the decades at some of the most iconic racing locations around the world. Earn rewards for setting personal bests!

bluejetty:00145105:ios.name: Pinochle - Expert AI
bluejetty:00145105:ios.summary: Whether you’re a seasoned pro or learning Pinochle for the first time, Pinochle – Expert AI is a great way to play, learn, and master classic single deck or double deck Pinochle, a strategic trick-taking card game built on bidding, melding,
bluejetty:00145105:ios.description:
Whether you’re a seasoned pro or learning Pinochle for the first time, Pinochle – Expert AI is a great way to play, learn, and master classic single deck or double deck Pinochle, a strategic trick-taking card game built on bidding, melding, and strategy.
Choose from four-player partnership and three-player cutthroat Pinochle, with presets for both single deck and double deck play.
Learn smarter, play better, and master Pinochle with powerful AI opponents, in-depth analysis tools, and extensive customization options. Play anytime, even offline, with AI partners and opponents — enjoy your favorite rules in this Pinochle card game.
CHALLENGING AND ENJOYABLE FOR ALL
New to Pinochle?
Learn as you play with the NeuralPlay AI, which offers real-time suggestions to guide your moves. Build your skills hands-on, explore strategies, and improve your decision-making in a single-player experience that teaches you every step of the game.
Already an Expert?
Compete against six levels of advanced AI opponents, designed to challenge your skills, sharpen your strategy, and make every game competitive, rewarding, and exciting.
KEY FEATURES
Learn and Improve
• AI guidance: Receive real-time insights whenever your plays differ from the AI’s choices.
• Built-in card counter: Strengthen your counting and strategic decision-making.
• Trick-by-trick review: Analyze every move in detail to sharpen your gameplay.
• Replay hand: Review and replay a deal to practice and improve.
Convenience and Control
• Offline play: Enjoy the game anytime, even without an internet connection.
• Undo: Quickly correct mistakes and refine your strategy.
• Hints: Get helpful suggestions when you’re unsure of your next move.
• Claim remaining tricks: End the hand early when your cards are unbeatable.
• Skip hand: Move past hands you’d rather not play.
Progression and Customization
• Six AI levels: From beginner-friendly to expert-challenging.
• Detailed statistics: Track your performance and progress.
• Customization: Personalize the look with color themes and card decks.
RULE CUSTOMIZATIONS
Explore a wide variety of ways to play with customizable rule options, including:
• Players: Play individually in three-player cutthroat or with a partner in four-player Pinochle.
• Deck type: Single or double deck.
• Scoring style: Modern or classic scoring.
• Passing rules: Choose zero to five cards and sequential or simultaneous passing.
• Kitty: Play with no kitty or choose from game-specific kitty sizes.
• Opening bid: Set the minimum from 10–50 points.
• Bid increments: Choose bidding increments before and after 60, with optional larger increments after 100.
• Meld values: Customize meld scoring in detail.
• Meld bidding: Communicate meld strength with jump bids.
• Marriage requirement: Require a marriage in trump to bid.
• Minimum meld: Define the threshold to claim meld.
• Minimum trick Points: Set how many trick points are needed to save meld.
• Surrender: Enable surrender after bidding and set points awarded to opponents.
• Initial lead: Choose whether any suit or only trump can be led.
• Must beat rule: Decide if players must beat a card only in trump or in any suit.
• Card values: Adjust trick point values for each rank.
• Shooting the moon: Enable or disable and set its value.
• Tiebreaker rule: Decide the winner when multiple players or teams reach the winning score.
• Set limit: End the game after a player or team is set a chosen number of times.
• Game over condition: Finish by points or number of hands.
DOWNLOAD TODAY
Play, learn, and master Pinochle – Expert AI. Enjoy a single-player Pinochle experience designed for practice, strategy, or casual play. Whether you want to improve your skills or relax with an offline card game, play your way with smart AI opponents, customizable rules, and a fresh challenge every game.

bluejetty:00149015:ios.name: Home Block
bluejetty:00149015:ios.summary:
Welcome to Home Block, a fresh twist on the classic block puzzle game! Easy to pick up yet filled with depth, this game will challenge your strategy and creativity while offering endless relaxation and fun.
Game Features:
• Classic Puzzle
bluejetty:00149015:ios.description:
Welcome to Home Block, a fresh twist on the classic block puzzle game! Easy to pick up yet filled with depth, this game will challenge your strategy and creativity while offering endless relaxation and fun.
Game Features:
• Classic Puzzle Gameplay: Drag, drop, and clear blocks to score high. Simple to learn, but mastering it will test your skills!
• Two Exciting Modes: Level-based puzzles and endless challenges.
• Combo Mechanics: Clear multiple lines at once to earn bonus points and enjoy stunning animations.
• Offline Play: Enjoy the game anytime, anywhere—no internet needed.
Highlights:
• Thousands of Levels: Immerse yourself in meticulously designed puzzles with increasing difficulty.
• Diverse Elements: Explore a variety of level features that bring both fun and hidden challenges.
• Daily Challenges: Fresh puzzles and exclusive rewards await you every day.
• Leaderboards and Achievements: Compete with players worldwide and set new records.
How to Play:
1. Drag and drop blocks onto the 8x8 grid.
2. Clear rows or columns to score points and free up space.
3. Strategize carefully—blocks can’t be moved once placed!
4. The game ends when no more space is available on the board.
Tips for High Scores:
• Maximize your score by clearing multiple rows or columns simultaneously and keeping combos going.
• Plan ahead for multiple block placements rather than focusing on just one.
• Use power-ups wisely to tackle tricky grids.
Whether you’re a puzzle enthusiast or looking for a relaxing pastime, Home Block is your perfect match. Test your skills, set new records, and enjoy the ultimate puzzle-solving experience.
Download Home Block now and embark on your puzzle adventure!

bluejetty:00128029:ios.summary:
Universalis is a missal and a breviary, and more besides. It gives you the Liturgy of the Hours (Divine Office) and the Mass for every day; plus valuable additional material. 
Tens of thousands of people use Universalis daily. Come and joi
bluejetty:00128029:ios.description:
Universalis is a missal and a breviary, and more besides. It gives you the Liturgy of the Hours (Divine Office) and the Mass for every day; plus valuable additional material. 
Tens of thousands of people use Universalis daily. Come and join them!
• Single purchase: the app lasts for ever. It does not need a subscription to make it work.
• No Internet needed: everything you need is already built in.
• No cleverness needed: each day, Universalis works out exactly what you need to see.
• View any date: past, present and future.
• Use your own local calendar: USA, Canada, Singapore, Ireland, and every diocese in Australia, New Zealand and the UK.
• Easy to read and use: a choice of fonts; big or small type; dark or light theme; page-turning or scrolling.
• Optional add-on: spoken audio read by real human beings (this needs a subscription: see below).
• Latin if you want it: by itself or alongside the English.
• Help and support: tips and instructions are included; or press “Contact Us” to send us a message, and we will reply.
EXTRA MATERIAL
• The “About Today” page tells you what saints are being celebrated today, worldwide. It includes reflections, biographies and illustrations.
• “Mass Today” gives you the Order of Mass and today’s readings and prayers, all in one page. Bishops have been known to use it to say Mass from their iPads!
• “Spiritual Reading” gathers the patristic and hagiographic readings for all the saints and feasts of the day. 
• “The Rosary” has a verse of Scripture for every Hail Mary of every Mystery. Spoken audio is included.
• Daily Books takes selected spiritual classics and presents them in daily instalments to focus and enrich your prayer life.
• Commentaries on the day’s Mass readings from a leading biblical scholar.
And more – Home Screen widgets; liturgical events for your iOS calendar; daily email service; copy and paste into other apps; reminders and alarms; Mass readings on your Apple Watch.
LITURGY OF THE HOURS (Divine Office)
The complete official Liturgy of the Hours of the Catholic Church, as used worldwide. Morning (Lauds), daytime (Terce, Sext and None), evening (Vespers), night (Compline) and the deeply reflective Office of Readings. Do as many or as few of them as you like.
• The psalms and canticles match the official English and American books. Scripture readings – United States: RSV. Elsewhere: Jerusalem Bible (with RSV as an optional add-on).
READINGS AT MASS
The exact prayers and readings at Mass for each day.
• England, Wales, Scotland: the official ESV version. 
• United States: the official NAB version. 
• Elsewhere: Jerusalem Bible readings and Grail psalms, as used at Mass in most of the English-speaking world.
OPTIONAL ADD-ON AUDIO (in-app purchase required)
Just press the button and listen! If you want to see what you are hearing, the text is highlighted to follow the sound. After an initial download, no Internet is required. Works with CarPlay too.
• Spoken English Liturgy of the Hours: every Hour of every day of every year. Monthly or annual subscription.
• Spoken English Mass Readings: First and Second Reading and the Gospel. Jerusalem Bible translation only. Monthly or annual subscription.
(You can listen to a sample before subscribing. Following App Store rules, subscriptions renew automatically but you can cancel auto-renewal at any time.)
• Sung Latin Compline (Night Prayer): by the boys of the Schola Cantorum of the London Oratory School. Single purchase.
--
Privacy policy and terms of service: universalis.com/n-ios-privacy.htm

Discover the unparalleled power and versatility of Photo Editor PRO X2, the premier all-in-one photo editing app available on the App Store. Whether you're a professional photographer or just someone who loves to capture and enhance moments, our app offers everything you need to create stunning, high-quality photos. With an extensive array of features and tools, Photo Editor PRO X2 is designed to help you unleash your creativity and achieve professional-grade results with ease.
** Key Features:
1. Automatic Effects:
Enhance your photos effortlessly with our intelligent auto effects that adjust colors and tones based on the scene, ensuring perfect results every time.
2. Vintage Filters:
Apply beautiful retro filters with just one touch. Our collection of vintage filters adds a nostalgic touch to your photos, making them look timeless and unique.
3. Intuitive User Interface:
Navigate through our app effortlessly with a user-friendly interface designed for both beginners and experts. Editing your photos has never been easier.
4. Adjustable Brightness, Contrast, and Saturation:
Fine-tune your images with precise control over brightness, contrast, and saturation. Adjust these parameters with simple finger swipes to achieve the desired look.
5. Tone Curve Adjustments:
Take full control of your photo's lighting with advanced tone curve adjustments. Make subtle or dramatic changes to highlights, shadows, and midtones for perfect balance.
6. Blur and Focus Tools:
Add depth and focus to your images with our blur and focus tools. Simulate a professional camera's depth of field and create striking compositions.
7. Rotate and Flip:
Easily rotate your photos or flip them horizontally and vertically to achieve the perfect angle and composition.
8. Customizable Crop:
Crop your photos to any size or aspect ratio you desire. Whether it's for social media or printing, you can customize your image dimensions effortlessly.
9. Extensive Sticker Library:
Personalize your photos with our extensive library of stickers. From fun and playful to elegant and artistic, we have stickers for every occasion.
10. Text Overlay:
Add text to your photos using a variety of fonts and styles. Customize the text color, size, and position to perfectly complement your image.
11. High-Quality Camera Filters:
Capture photos with high-quality camera filters that enhance your images in real-time. Choose from a wide range of filters to suit any mood or setting.
** Why Choose Photo Editor PRO X2? **
1. Professional Results:
Achieve professional-grade photo edits with ease, thanks to our comprehensive suite of tools and features.
2. User-Friendly Experience:
Designed for users of all skill levels, Photo Editor PRO X2 offers an intuitive and seamless editing experience.
3. Regular Updates:
We are constantly improving our app with regular updates, adding new features, filters, and tools to keep your photo editing experience fresh and exciting.
4. Community and Support:
Join a community of passionate photographers and get inspired by their creations. Our dedicated support team is always here to help you with any questions or issues.
5. Creativity Unleashed:
Unleash your creativity with endless possibilities. From simple touch-ups to intricate edits, Photo Editor PRO X2 empowers you to bring your vision to life.
Download Photo Editor PRO X2 today and start transforming your photos into stunning works of art. Experience the ultimate in photo editing technology and see why over 278,000 users worldwide have chosen Photo Editor PRO X2 as their go-to app for all their photo editing needs.

bluejetty:00173532:ios.name: Kingdom Two Crowns+
bluejetty:00173532:ios.summary: A shroud of mystery envelops these uncharted medieval lands where ancient monuments, relics and mythical creatures await. Echoes of bygone eras speak of past greatness and in Kingdom Two Crowns+, part of the award-winning franchise Kingdom,
bluejetty:00173532:ios.description:
A shroud of mystery envelops these uncharted medieval lands where ancient monuments, relics and mythical creatures await. Echoes of bygone eras speak of past greatness and in Kingdom Two Crowns+, part of the award-winning franchise Kingdom, you embark on an adventure as the Monarch. In this side-scrolling journey atop your steed, you recruit loyal subjects, build your Kingdom and protect your crown from the Greed, monstrous creatures looking to steal your Kingdom's treasures. 
BUILD
Lay the foundation of a mighty Kingdom with towering walls, protecting towers while cultivating prosperity through building farms and recruiting villagers. In Kingdom Two Crowns+ expanding and growing your Kingdom grants access to new units and technologies. 
EXPLORE
Venture into the unknown beyond the protection of your borders, through secluded forests and ancient ruins to seek treasures and hidden knowledge to aid your quest. Who knows what legendary artifacts or mythological beings you will find. 
DEFEND
As the night falls, shadows come to life and the monstrous Greed assault your kingdom. Rally your troops, muster your courage, and steel yourself, for each night will demand ever-growing feats of tactical mastermind. Deploy archers, knights, siege weapons, and even newfound Monarch abilities and artifacts to hold against the waves of Greed. 
CONQUER
As the Monarch, lead assaults against the source of the Greed to secure your islands. Send your groups of soldiers to clash with the enemy. A word of caution: make sure your troops are prepared and sufficient in numbers, as the Greed will not go down without a fight. 
UNCHARTED ISLES
Kingdom Two Crowns+ is an evolving experience that includes several free content updates:
• Shogun: Journey to lands inspired by the architecture and culture of feudal Japan. Play as the mighty Shogun or Onna-bugeisha, enlist the ninja, lead your soldiers to battle atop the mythological Kirin, and form new strategies as you brave the Greed hiding in thick bamboo forests. 
• Dead Lands: Enter the dark lands of Kingdom. Play as unique Monarchs, including the Shardbinder Miriam, with powerful traits from the gothic horror action-RPG Bloodstained. 
• Challenge Islands: Representing the greatest challenge ever seen for hardened veteran monarchs. Take on five challenges with different rules and objectives. Can you survive long enough to claim the gold crown? 
• Norse Lands: Set in a domain inspired by Norse Viking culture 1000 C.E, the Norse Lands DLC is a full new campaign that expands the world of Kingdom Two Crowns+ with a unique setting to build, defend, explore, and conquer.
• Call of Olympus: Explore islands of ancient legends and mythos, seek the favors of the gods to challenge and defend against Greed of epic scales in this major expansion. 
Your adventure is only the beginning. Oh Monarch, stay vigilant for dark nights are still to come, protect your crown!

Bodybuilding Workouts
More than 100 complete training programs with short videos to follow at home or at the gym.
We offer complete workouts with educational content for beginners and experienced athletes alike for the following goals:
- Hypertrophy / Muscle mass gain
- Definition / Fatloss
- Muscle strengthening
- Recovery
- Maintenance
- Force
Find series for levels
- Beginners (who has never trained)
- Intermediaries (who trains without regularity)
- Advanced (regular practitioners)
- Experts (athletes)
Program Class
- Gym Workouts: these are workouts that require machines.
- Home Workouts: complete programs using only dumbbells, barbells, free weights in general, resistance bands and even programs without accessories.
- Strengthening Programs: these are specific workouts to strengthen a deficient muscle segment. For example: knees, rotator cuff, lower back and forearms.
- Legendary Series: original training programs from bodybuilding and fitness legends such as Arnold, Dorian, Franco Columbu, Frank Zane and many others that we add over time.
- Special Series: specific bodybuilding and functional programs for sports such as cycling, wrestling, running, TAF (PM Physical Aptitude Test) and special conditions such as pregnancy and post-operative silicone.
We are always open to program suggestions. You are part of this team.
Contact us: suporte@supertreinosapp.com.br
Application Functions
- Training schedule
- History
- Favorites
- Timer
- Notepad
- Post workout photo sharing (optional)
More than 600 exercises and educational content available in the Library.
All bodybuilding programs contain explanatory videos, videos of the exercises, detailed descriptions of the sets and training methods, number of repetitions, intervals and you can even make your notes within each exercise: load used, important notes, etc.
Nutrition Function
- Food consultation
- Macro count
- Organization of 3 menus
App in Languages: Portuguese, English and Spanish.

Make feeding your baby, toddler and family easier with Annabel Karmel's multi award-winning recipe app. From first tastes and baby-led weaning to family meals, you'll find expert 
guidance, practical tools and over 1,500 nutritious recipes all in one place.
Millions of families rely on Annabel's recipes and advice to raise healthy, happy babies. With over 35 years of baby and children’s food expertise, Annabel’s app is the leading resource for making mealtimes simple - and tasty.
Start your 7-day FREE TRIAL today!
OVER 1500 SIMPLE RECIPES
It’s easy to search for, filter and save over 1500 delicious, nutritious recipes for every age and stage. You’ll NEVER be stuck for mealtime inspiration again. Plus, enjoy a fresh batch of recipes from Annabel’s kitchen every week. 
100+ FIRST FOODS 
This is your ultimate guide to safely introducing 100+ first foods to your baby. Learn how to safely prepare each food at every age and stage, whether you are spoon feeding or 
baby-led weaning. You'll also find allergy advice, preparation tips, and recipe inspiration all in one place.
FIRST FOODS TRACKER
Keep track of foods your little one has tried and loved, celebrate feeding milestones and build confidence as you introduce more variety. You can also log allergic reactions and create a helpful record to share with healthcare professionals if needed.
ADVICE HUB
Got questions? Visit our new Advice Hub, where Annabel shares expert answers to common feeding concerns, from milk feeds and first tastes to teething and baby-led weaning.
RECIPE COLLECTIONS
Save and store your favorite recipes into personalized collections to make planning, shopping and cooking for your family easy.
THUMBS UP? 
Mark recipes as ‘It’s a hit!’ or ‘Try again’ to help you keep track of your little one’s favorites, and those you might need to give another go. It can take lots of tries for babies and tots to accept new flavors!
MEAL PLANNERS 
Plan your family’s mealtimes with custom Meal Planners, so you’ll always have an answer when they ask, ‘what’s for dinner?’!
https://www.annabelkarmel.com/terms-conditions/

bluejetty:00096753:ios.name: Pregnancy Safe Food & Tracker
bluejetty:00096753:ios.summary: PregnancySafe is a pregnancy tracker and safety checker for food, skincare, medicine, and everyday products. Follow your week, see baby growth, log symptoms, and scan products for clear pregnancy safety guidance without digging through long
bluejetty:00096753:ios.description:
PregnancySafe is a pregnancy tracker and safety checker for food, skincare, medicine, and everyday products. Follow your week, see baby growth, log symptoms, and scan products for clear pregnancy safety guidance without digging through long articles, forums, or confusing ingredient lists.
** FEATURES **
PREGNANCY TRACKER
Follow your pregnancy week by week with a due-date based timeline, baby growth updates, and a simple view of where you are today.
DAILY SYMPTOM CHECK-INS
Log what you are feeling in a few taps. PregnancySafe gives warm, plain English reassurance for your symptoms based on your pregnancy week, with clear notes on when to contact your provider.
BABY GROWTH & WEEKLY RECAPS
See baby size and growth context for your current week. Build a simple pregnancy log over time and unlock your personal Pregnancy Wrapped recap from your symptoms, scans, and milestones.
INSTANT SAFETY CHECKS
Scan a barcode or search by name. Get a clear pregnancy safety result in seconds, so you can decide and move on.
INGREDIENT & NUTRITION NOTES
See why something was rated. We highlight relevant ingredients, nutrition considerations, and pregnancy context in plain English, no medical jargon.
SAFER SWAPS
If an item lands in “Caution” or “Avoid,” you’ll get straightforward recommendations for safer alternatives.
WE COVER JUST ABOUT EVERYTHING
- grocery food
- skincare and cosmetics
- vitamins and supplements
- medicine and common OTC items
- fast food and restaurants
- beverages
- everyday products
- pregnancy symptoms and weekly tracking
- and more
** HOW IT WORKS **
Enter your due date to personalize your pregnancy week, baby growth, and symptom guidance.
Log symptoms when you want reassurance about what you’re feeling.
Scan a barcode or search a product, generic item, fast food, or restaurant.
We identify ingredients and categories, then use pregnancy research and sources to provide safety ratings, context, and recommendations when helpful.
** PREGNANCYSAFE PLUS **
Unlock unlimited access to the app with PregnancySafe Plus including unlimited scans and searches, product scores shown in search, a personal pregnancy and symptom tracker, and more. Manage your app subscription in iOS settings and cancel anytime.
** CUSTOMER CARE **
We read every message and use your feedback to improve. If you spot something we should review, reach out in the app and we’ll get back to you.
** IMPORTANT **
PregnancySafe provides educational information and does not replace professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult your healthcare provider with questions about your health, symptoms, medications, diet, nutrition, or product use during pregnancy.
SUPPORT
Questions or feedback? Email shane@pregnancysafeapp.com.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://pregnancysafe.pages.dev/privacy

bluejetty:00013712:ios.description:
Please note, this is the legacy version. An all new version of the Starting Strength App is on the store, search "Starting Strength Official"
The Starting Strength Method is the fastest, most efficient and straightforward way to increase total body strength for complete beginners.
======
Here's some reviews from our users
5/5
"What do you get when you combine the best method to get stronger with detailed instructional videos, thorough explanations AND an actual day to day program? THIS APP! Finally! Perfect for both beginners and experienced lifters and worth much more than the price I paid for. Thank you Starting Strength!
5/5
"I've tried 2-3 other apps. I've kept paper logs. Nothing has been easier to use than this app. I couldn't figure out why I couldn't enter my warm up sets...its because you don't need to! You enter your work set weight and it tells you exactly what to load on the warmup-ups..."
5/5
"Wonderful, straight-forward way to keep DOING THE PROGRAM. A simple and clear way to apply the SS principles and track your work.”
5/5
"Like others, I was on the fence about buying this app to help kickstart my starting strength program. This app deserves it's high average rating, and you should pull the trigger if you are reading this.”
5/5
"I tried a few free apps before buying this app, this one is well worth the money. Best app out there for barbell training"
======
Mark Rippetoe's "Starting Strength" has sold over 500,000 copies worldwide and considered the most productive method in existence for anyone beginning a strength training program.
"The best book ever written on strength training" - Jim Wendler, champion powerlifter.
++++++++++
Features:
- Complete, easy-to-follow instructions for performing the basic barbell exercises: the squat, press, deadlift, bench press and power clean.
- Walks you through the famous Starting Strength Novice Program -- shows you how to start, what weight to add and when to add extra exercises. 
- Enough programs to get you through the first year of training including accessory exercises of chinups and back extensions.
- Designed for use at the gym with quick access to multiple angle videos and photo instructions of each exercise. 
- Lift instructions and diagrams from the Starting Strength Book by Mark Rippetoe. 
- Interactive logging tools journal your strength progression.
- Warmup and workset calculator shows you exactly how many plates to put on each side of the bar. 
- Workset Rest Timer, customisable for each exercise. 
- Customise your progression for each exercise.
- Add and save additional notes for each workout, and access previous notes easily.
- Never lose your training data again! Cloud Sync backs up your training log data and restores it across multiple devices. 
- Download training log data as CSV (requires account)
- Helpful hints and tutorials help you learn and progress safely.
- How to program the basic exercises into the most effective program for long-term progress.
- Metric (kgs) or Imperials (lbs), and change at any time. 
Have any comments, questions or suggestions? Please email us at hello@shabu.co
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.iubenda.com/privacy-policy/7754358

No equipment? Not a fan of the gym? Want to lose weight or build muscle easily from home? OnFit is perfect for you.
OnFit is your personal virtual fitness coach, guiding you on a journey to a healthier you.
With a vast exercise library and professional plans, OnFit is tailored for all fitness levels. Whether you’re new to fitness or a workout enthusiast, you’ll get personalized recommendations based on your goals, lifestyle, and preferences. Looking to slim down, build muscle, or simply stay fit? Join our 28-day custom fitness challenge and achieve your goals. Our workouts include belly toning, glute lifting, full-body sculpting, and stretch-and-relax sessions tailored especially for women. With easy-to-follow, beginner-friendly courses, you’ll find fitness fun and rewarding.
Start anytime, anywhere with OnFit, and make exercise a breeze.
Home Workouts, no equipment needed, beginners see results fast!

• Personal Coach: Get a customized plan for faster results.

• Stretch Exercises: Reduce stress and ease lower back pain.
• No Equipment: Easy home workouts to kickstart your fitness journey.
• Beginner-Friendly: Accessible, fun workouts for all.
• Progress Tracker: Track daily achievements and see your growth.
Join thousands who’ve transformed their fitness journey into something to smile about with OnFit!
