bluejetty:00078227:ios.description:
Modanın yeni adresi Trendyolmilla'ya hoş geldin! Yıllardır tanıdığın, sevdiğin, her anında yanında olan Trendyolmilla ürünleri şimdi kendi özel uygulamasında! Son moda parçalar, özel koleksiyonlar, sürekli yenilenen tasarımlar ve çok daha fazlası seni bekliyor.
Son Trendleri Keşfet
Sürekli yenilenen tasarımlar, son trendlere göre şekillenen koleksiyonlar Trendyolmilla uygulamasında seni bekliyor! Göz alıcı kombinler için gardrobunda görmek isteyeceğin, pantolondan kabana, tişörtten iç giyime tüm parçalar bir arada!
Trend İş Birlikleri ve Koleksiyonlar
Dünyaca ünlü markalar ve çok özel tasarımcılarla iş birlikleriyle ortaya çıkan özgün koleksiyonları kaçırma! Her sezon yepyeni koleksiyonlarla, "üstündekine bayıldım" cümlesini çok sık duymaya hazır ol!
Favorile, İstediğinde Al
Beğendiğin ürünleri, hediye fikirlerini, kararsız kaldığın parçaları favorilerine ekle, istediğin zaman geri dön ve kararını ver, siparişini tamamla! Alışveriş keyfin kesintisiz sürsün.
Hızlı Teslimat & Kolay İade
Sen de siparişini verdikten sonra geleceği anı iple çekenlerdensen, beklemeye gelemeyenlerdensen, Trendyolmilla ürünleri hızla kapına gelsin! Hızlı Teslimat ve Kolay İade süreçleriyle, giyim alışverişinin tadını çıkar.
Kullanıcı Yorumlarıyla Güvenilir Alışveriş
Rengi fotoğraftaki gibi mi? Kalıbı bol mu, dar mı? Aklına takılanlar için binlerce gerçek kullanıcının fotoğraflı yorumları da Trendyolmilla uygulamasında. Satın almadan önce yorumları oku, ürünün kalıpları, kumaşı ve diğer detayları hakkında gerçek deneyimlerden gelen bilgilere sahip ol.
Farklı yaş, cinsiyet, tarz ve beden tiplerine özel markalar
Farklı yaşlar ve tarzlar için oluşturulmuş özel markalar Trendyolmilla, Trendyol Man, Trendyol Curve, Trendyol Modest ve Edit by Trendyol ile tam istediğin parçaları Trendyolmilla uygulamasında kolayca bulursun.

bluejetty:00139817:ios.description:
Worried about wasting money on early English education? Tired of daily battles over primary school tutoring?
iHuman English is back with a major upgrade! Not only does it feature original BBC animations and Oxford leveled reading, it now fully integrates the Liamiao English primary school systematic English course! Complete coverage for ages 3–12, just 15 minutes a day — from confidently speaking your first words to acing school exams with ease. One app does it all!
Why do 60 million families choose iHuman for English learning?
• Peace of mind: From language sense development at age 3 all the way to primary school graduation at 12 — no more constantly switching apps.
• Time-saving: No more pointless drilling! Smart identification of weak spots — practice exactly what's needed, boosting efficiency by 50%.
• Effort-free: The hilarious Liamiao IP companions + gamified error correction — kids chase after learning on their own, no more parental nagging!
【Ages 3–6 · Joyful Language Sense Development】
Master listening, speaking, reading and writing
• BBC's world-class animations: Carefully selected original BBC animations loved worldwide, weaving language knowledge into fun scenarios to build native-level language sense.
• Original Oxford leveled reading: 300+ authentic Oxford picture books with in-depth reading, a scientifically designed step-by-step progression that guides children naturally from "listening while looking at pictures" to "independent reading."
• AI 3D Speaking City practice: Immersive conversations in 3D everyday settings like supermarkets and restaurants, with real foreign teachers + AI real-time pronunciation correction — say goodbye to "mute English" and speak boldly and authentically.
【Ages 6–12 · Precise Score Boosting for Primary English】
Liamiao English Primary Systematic Course"We're not a question-bank porter, nor an animation player — we're the ultimate tool for boosting school grades!"
• Learn in sync with Two-Meow, master it instantly: Aligned with public school textbooks and the new curriculum standards! Top-student cat Da X + drama-queen cat Xiao X hilariously break down every knowledge point, turning dry grammar into catchy rhymes that get "etched into your DNA" — preview and review without rework.
• Top-student precision practice, targeting only weak areas: Generates a four-color learning map — gray/red/yellow/green at a glance! The system focuses firepower on your red and yellow weak points while automatically skipping the green areas you've mastered — say goodbye to blind drilling for good!
• Triple-error correction, efficient consolidation: Smart error review pushed based on the Ebbinghaus forgetting curve. Our original "original question + variant" tiered correction — you must answer correctly 3 times in a row before an error is truly sealed away. No fake understanding, no lucky guesses!

bluejetty:00170628:ios.description:
Looking for an easier way to grocery shop, save money and manage your weekly grocery list? The Fry's app makes grocery shopping simple with Delivery, Pickup and In-store options, digital coupons, weekly ads and personalized savings.
Download the Fry's grocery app to shop groceries online and find the best deals all in one place.
Shop Groceries Your Way
 • Order groceries with Pickup (where available) or Delivery
 • Scan a recipe to quickly find ingredients and add them to your cart
 • Shop thousands of additional grocery and household items
Save More on Groceries
 • Browse weekly ads and sales
 • Clip digital coupons and apply them at checkout
 • Discover personalized deals, bonus rewards and Cash Back offers
 • Track and redeem fuel points for gas savings
Fast, Convenient Checkout
 • Use Kroger Pay for fast checkout in-store
 • Add your V.I.P. Card Card to Apple Wallet
 • View purchase history and quickly reorder favorite items
Helpful Everyday Tools
 • Refill and track Fry's Pharmacy prescriptions
 • Use the store locator to find the nearest Fry's store or fuel center
Improving Your Experience
To provide and personalize our offerings, make recommendations, detect and prevent fraud, and improve our services, we use tools that collect and record your data, which may include your searches for and purchases of health and wellness products. We also may share non-sensitive data with third parties, such as advertising and analytics vendors, social networks, technology providers, and research providers. By continuing to use our websites and apps and shop our store, this means you consent to these practices and accept our Terms (https://www.frysfood.com/i/terms/website-and-app) and our Privacy Policy (https://www.frysfood.com/i/privacy-policy).
To use the Fry's app, you need a Fry's digital account. You can create a digital account and link your Fry's Rewards ID through the app. Don't have a Rewards ID? You'll get one when you create your digital account and enroll in Fry's Rewards Program. You must be 18 to register for an account or join our rewards program (to obtain a Rewards ID). Terms apply: https://www.frysfood.com/i/terms/website-and-app.

The Basketball Live app by Sportsmate is the only way to stay up to date on everything basketball. After a strong debut in 2016, Basketball Live
bluejetty:00016836:ios.description:
With over 10 million downloads across the Sportsmate LIVE apps you know you’re in good hands.
The Basketball Live app by Sportsmate is the only way to stay up to date on everything basketball. After a strong debut in 2016, Basketball Live has continued to innovate while still putting the fans first, bringing you everything that you need to be the most in-the-know basketball fan possible.
Built by basketball fans, for basketball fans, combining up-to-the-second live scores and stats from global competitions with the most in-depth statistical database, as well as exclusive analysis and the latest breaking news and video highlights. 
Whether it’s a mid-season battle between conference leaders, a franchise on a double digit winning streak or the Finals, we’ve got you covered. Don’t just follow your team, join them!
FOLLOW LIVE 
Access live coverage of every match
Live scores for each match 
Play-by-play match commentary 
Detailed match stats, player stats and team line-ups 
Player specific stat sheets 
TRACK YOUR FAVOURITE TEAM AND PLAYERS 
Follow the progress of your club and your favourite players throughout the season. 
Follow every thing to do with your club in the dedicated Team News tab 
Watch all your team’s highlights after their match
Stay up to date with the latest club news and team tweets
Keep an eye on your favourite players and their injury status
GET THE STATS 
Need the perfect basketball trivia answer? Don’t worry we have you covered here too with a detailed database of team and individual player stats. 
Up to date club and player stat rankings 
Leaderboards for individual stats and KPIs 
Individual player profiles and career stats 
Compare players head to head 
STAY UP TO DATE 
BasketbalL Live by Sportsmate also brings you the breaking basketball news along with exclusive match previews (and tips) as well as analysis from Sportsmate’s team of commentators from around the country. 
A thorough overview of the day’s play from around the country via the Schedule tab 
Access news and updates about club teams 
Watch and listen to videos and podcast series on demand 
Personalise alerts so you never miss any of the action, basketball scores or latest news 
DOWNLOAD NOW 
Basketball Live by Sportsmate is available FREE for all basketball enthusiasts around the world. Don’t miss a minute, download now and start tracking live football scores today! 
NEW FEATURES COMING SOON 
We’re constantly releasing updates and improving our apps so we’d love to hear from you how we could make the Basketball Live app even better. Please send all feedback to support@sportsmatemobile.com, tweet us at @Sportsmate or use the feedback form inside your app’s Settings. 
ABOUT THE DEVELOPERS 
Founded in 2009 and based in Melbourne, Australia, Sportsmate Mobile is an Independent Sports Media company which creates and distributes mobile applications focused on delivering lightning fast sport scores and stats to sports fans all over the world. 
With over 10 million global downloads, we are Australia's number one sports app network. Our growing suite of apps is built by a dedicated team of sports mad app developers, designers and content creators who are passionate about delivering content sports fans crave.

bluejetty:00073049:ios.name: Robot Car Transform Wars Game
bluejetty:00073049:ios.summary: Step into a world of chaos and destruction in Mech Survival - the ultimate robot survival game! With robot games, robot war, and robot simulator all combined into one epic adventure, Mech Survival is a must-play game for anyone looking for
bluejetty:00073049:ios.description:
Step into a world of chaos and destruction in Mech Survival - the ultimate robot survival game! With robot games, robot war, and robot simulator all combined into one epic adventure, Mech Survival is a must-play game for anyone looking for intense combat action and strategic survival challenges.
In this post-apocalyptic world, resources are scarce and danger lurks around every corner. As you explore the ruins of civilization, you'll face off against deadly enemies like dragons, zombies, and other robots. Mech robot fights are a key part of the game, as you battle for survival against other mechs and terrifying beasts.
But you're not alone in this battle for survival. With a variety of models to choose from, including bike robots, car robots, and lion robots, you can team up with other survivors to form alliances and take on the challenges together. Whether you're fighting side by side or battling it out in solo mech robot fights, Mech Survival is the ultimate test of your combat skills.
And it's not just about fighting. In this survival game, strategic decisions are just as important as combat skills. Will you choose to ally with other survivors, or fight for your own survival at all costs? The choices you make will have a significant impact on your fate in this post-apocalyptic world.
But the dangers don't stop there. As you make your way through the ruins of civilization, you'll encounter zombie survival challenges that will put your skills to the test. This shooting game is all about TPS shooting, and you'll need to be quick on your feet, using your wits and combat skills to stay alive. Mech Survival is the ultimate combination of robot simulator and survival game, with intense battles and tough decisions that will keep you engaged for hours on end.
With stunning graphics and immersive gameplay, you'll feel like you're right in the middle of the action. Mech robot fights, bike robots, car robots, lion robots, and even dragon robots - this game has it all. You'll need to scavenge for resources to upgrade your mech, choosing from a variety of models to suit your play style.
So what are you waiting for? Mech Survival is the ultimate robot game, with robot games, robot war, and robot simulator all rolled into one. Download now and prepare for the ultimate battle against dragons, zombies, and other deadly enemies. The future of humanity is in your hands - can you survive and emerge victorious?

bluejetty:00131900:ios.description:
Important Disclaimer: The functional features of the Golf Handicap Tracker were not prepared, approved, or licensed by USGA or R&A, and the Golf Handicap Tracker app is neither sponsored nor endorsed by USGA or R&A. This app does NOT provide an official USGA or R&A handicap index. USGA is a registered trademark of the U.S. Golf Association, which is the exclusive owner and licensor of its trademarks and service marks.
No ads. No sign-up. This simple, intuitive app makes it easy to find your handicap today.
Accurate & Reliable – We’re confident in our handicap calculations.
1. Calculate your handicap using the latest handicap rules.
2. Combine 9-hole scores seamlessly.
3. Access thousands of golf courses with official rating and slope data.
4. Calculate your course handicap and maximum hole score (net double bogey).
5. Easily back up and restore your scores from our server.
6. Enter course rating and slope manually if needed.
7. Track and view your handicap history over time.
8. Print or share your personal handicap card.
9. Follow friends to see their scores and handicap updates.
10. Get push notifications when your friends post scores.
11. Includes Soft Cap and Hard Cap to prevent extreme handicap increases.
Note: Since hole-by-hole input isn’t required, please enter your maxed-out score (per net double bogey) rather than the gross score for the round.
Terms of the in-app purchases:
Golf Handicap Annual Membership with advanced handicap tracking features can be purchased from Apple App Store. Payment for in-app upgrades will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your iTunes Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, at the original subscription amount. Subscriptions may be managed by you and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your iTunes Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication. Privacy Policy and Terms of Use are located at: http://www.infotalkcorporation.com/privacypolicy.html

bluejetty:00160712:ios.name: Hyperion Remote
bluejetty:00160712:ios.summary:
Control your lights connected to Hyperion with your iPhone and Apple Watch. Set colors and beautiful light effects easily with Hyperion Remote. Works with every light that is controllable via your Hyperion server.
Features
• Use the intuit
bluejetty:00160712:ios.description:
Control your lights connected to Hyperion with your iPhone and Apple Watch. Set colors and beautiful light effects easily with Hyperion Remote. Works with every light that is controllable via your Hyperion server.
Features
• Use the intuitive color wheel to set your favorite colors
• Control beautiful light effects with ease
• Use the time saving and handy widget
• Adjust color transformations through this app
• Save your favorite colors for quick usage
• Start your effects with your settings
• Hyperion detects your servers automatically
• Add multiple Hyperion servers
• Illuminate your room using your Apple Watch
• Use images to color your lights
Light Effects
Hyperion comes with plenty of preinstalled effects which can be used with Hyperion Remote. These include colorful mood blobs, strobe, rainbow swirl, and others. Additionally, you can customize all effects and create new ones with this app.
Quick Access Widget
Use the today widget or Apple Watch app to change the light in your room in seconds without opening the app. Gain quick access to your last-used color or effect and clear the light with ease.
Vibrant Images
Use stunning images to light your room with beautiful gradients and rich colors. You can even use images from your library for maximum creativity.
Hyperion Server
Hyperion Remote works with Hyperion and Hyperion.NG installed on a Raspberry Pi, Arduino, Windows, Mac, or Linux and various devices like Lightberry, AdaLight, Lightpack, Paintpack, Atmolight, AmbiLED, and many more. The app supports all lights Hyperion works with. Connect the app to the same network (Wi-Fi) Hyperion is on and Hyperion Remote finds it automatically.
Hyperion Remote offers a Premium Mode as a subscription. If you choose to purchase the Premium Mode to gain access to various additional features, payment will be charged to your iTunes account, and your account will be charged for renewal 24 hours before the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the iTunes Store after purchase. By purchasing the Premium Mode any unused portion of the free trial period will be forfeited. The current price for the Premium Mode is $4.99 per year and may vary from country to country.
Terms of Use: https://hyperionremote.com/terms

bluejetty:00130902:ios.description:
Have you applied for the Driver's license test? To get the driving permit you need to pass the driver's license test G1 test in Ontario, Canada.
With this application, you can study for the G1 driving test in 2026 with the official study guide manual MTO Driver's Handbook and similar to the actual test questions. Learn about Ontario’s traffic laws, signs and symbols, penalty system, and driving essentials with 200+ practice questions.
With this application, you will progress faster than any other traditional method, as you will be able to take the G1 mock test for Ontario, Canada anywhere and anytime you want.
This app is a study guide to prepare for the G1 driver's license test. People find it very easy to prepare for the test using this app.
With this app, you can test your knowledge by practicing topics-wise. The G1 Driving Theory test question bank is divided into 2 categories. This free version contains the following categories:
- Road Signs
- Rules of the Road
Application features:
- It simulates the G1 Driving Theory Test required to obtain a Driving Licence in Ontario, Canada.
- More than 200 questions to practice.
- Realistic: Like the real G1 test, our practice tests are based on the official test.
- Detailed explanations: When you make a mistake, the app instantly notifies you if your answer is wrong and why. Understand and remember every wrong answer.
- New questions every time: To keep you focused, we assign questions and answers randomly every time the practice test begins.
- Bookmark questions to refer it later.
- Play a Question Challenge to get your high score. It's a fun way to learn.
Who should choose the G1 driver's licence practice test 2026?
- If you want to prepare and practice from a large set of questions that can be asked in the test.
- keep the progress of your study.
- Want to get a permit for a driver's license in Ontario, Canada.
- Have already applied for the driver's license test to get the permit.
Terms of Use: https://pminfotech1234.blogspot.com/p/end-user-license-agreement-eula_30.html

bluejetty:00022802:ios.name: FitnessKit: PT Client Coach
bluejetty:00022802:ios.summary: FitnessKit is the operating system for personal trainers. An on-device AI drafts every client touchpoint — check-in replies, progress reports, form cues, the next step for each person on your roster — and you approve them in one queue. That
bluejetty:00022802:ios.description:
FitnessKit is the operating system for personal trainers. An on-device AI drafts every client touchpoint — check-in replies, progress reports, form cues, the next step for each person on your roster — and you approve them in one queue. That's hours back every week, and the capacity to coach more clients without working more hours. Every client you bring on gets a premium training app of their own, free.
PRIVATE, ON-DEVICE AI
Every draft, insight and readiness score is generated on device using Apple's Foundation Models. It works offline, and your clients' training data never leaves the phone to be processed.
THE APPROVAL QUEUE
• One place to sign off everything your AI drafted, instead of chasing it across a dozen screens
• Drafted check-in replies you can edit inline before they send
• Monthly progress reports written for each client, ready for your co-sign
• Form cues pinned to the exact rep that needs them
• A proposed next step for every client who needs one
• Flows earn autopilot only after you've approved their drafts untouched — the AI graduates, you don't gamble
• Teach it your Coach Voice so the drafts already sound like you
YOUR ROSTER, AT A GLANCE
• Every client in one list, filtered by who's at risk or needs attention first
• Engagement and adherence per client, so nobody quietly drifts away
• Per-client AI readiness from recent training, sleep and recovery
• Real-time compliance charts across every active program
• A notification the moment a client finishes an assigned session, with full stats
PROGRAMS BUILT ONCE, ASSIGNED IN SECONDS
• Build multi-week programs with per-day workouts and progression rules
• Keep templates in your library and fork a working copy per client
• Assign straight into a client's schedule, or customise the start date and add a note
• Already have programs elsewhere? Paste them in and the AI rebuilds them week by week
AUTOMATE THE BUSYWORK
• Automation flows: a trigger, then a sequence of steps that run themselves
• Recurring check-ins that go out on your cadence and come back structured
• Onboarding that runs itself the moment a new client connects
SESSIONS THAT SCHEDULE THEMSELVES
• Publish your availability and let clients book the slots that suit them
• A week view of everything booked, with cancellations and no-shows tracked
• Two-way calendar sync so your sessions live alongside the rest of your day
WHAT YOUR CLIENTS GET
• Their assigned programs and workouts, ready to train
• Log every set with reps, weight, duration and RPE as they go
• Set types, rest timers and live progress through every session
• Home Screen widgets and a Live Activity showing the set and rest timer on the Lock Screen
• 1:1 chat with you — answers, form cues and check-ins in one thread
• Record a lift and get a form score with the cues that matter
• A monthly progress report they can actually share
A HUGE EXERCISE LIBRARY
• Hundreds of exercises with video demonstrations and step-by-step instructions
• Filter by muscle group, equipment and exercise type
• Add custom exercises with the metadata that matters
• Per-exercise progress charts to watch strength climb over time
• HealthKit integration for heart rate and calories, and post workouts back to HealthKit
WHO IT'S FOR
Personal trainers coaching clients remotely, gyms running a floor of trainers, and anyone who wants their coaching to scale further than their calendar does.
Download FitnessKit and start coaching today.
We're always improving and would love your feedback: fitnesskit.com.au@gmail.com

bluejetty:00162671:ios.description:
Foodbok makes food tracking simple. Snap a photo, scan a barcode, or log meals in seconds. Foodbok is built on nutrition science and uses AI to help you eat better — without stress. With Foodbok, you can lose weight, build muscle, or maintain balance at your own pace — without strict diets or yo-yo effects. 
Instead of restrictions, Foodbok focuses on awareness and balance. It helps you understand cravings, weight plateaus, and energy changes, so you can build healthier habits that last. 
How Foodbok works: 
1. Track calories 
Snap a photo, log meals manually, or scan a barcode. Get food analysis in seconds — without guessing. 
2. Follow your personalized daily plan 
We calculate your calorie needs based on your goals and habits, helping you stay on track every day. 
3. Get smart recommendations 
Understand what your body needs and make better choices with guidance tailored to you — like a personal nutrition coach. 
Foodbok — all-in-one app: 
• AI meal photo scanner, barcode scanner, and manual food logging 
• Personalized daily calorie and nutrition recommendations 
• Food database covering 97% of everyday foods 
• In-depth macro and micronutrient analysis 
(46 nutrients, including vitamins and minerals) 
• Tracking for water intake, vitamins and medications, and physical activity — with reminders 
• Body measurements tracker: weight, waist, and more 
• Create and save your own recipes 
• 100+ easy-to-prepare recipes 
• Full sync with Apple Health and Apple Watch 
• Ad-free experience with no distractions 
• All your health data — in one place 
Availability:
Foodbok offers essential features for free. 
Start with a 7-day free trial to explore all features without limits — snap photos of your meals, receive personalized guidance, and make progress toward your goals more effectively. 
If Foodbok feels right for you, unlock the full PRO experience with a 3-, 6-, or 12-month subscription. 
We want to become the best app for you, so we’d love to hear your feedback: support@foodbok.com

bluejetty:00038097:ios.summary: As Canada’s first meal kit delivery service, Chefs Plate is a great way to plan your weekly recipe and meal prep, cook a quick, affordable dinner that you’ll love to eat. Join Canadians from across the country that have discovered this mone
bluejetty:00038097:ios.description:
As Canada’s first meal kit delivery service, Chefs Plate is a great way to plan your weekly recipe and meal prep, cook a quick, affordable dinner that you’ll love to eat. Join Canadians from across the country that have discovered this money and time-saving recipe and meal planner.
With Chefs Plate, choose from 23 delicious recipes each week and get them delivered. Your grocery delivery will come with step-by-step instructions and pre-measured ingredients you need for your meal prep and to cook quick and tasty meals. Use our app as a weekly meal planner and explore the wide range of recipes you can be cooking and add to your diet plan. From 15 Minute meals to Balanced and vegetarian options, there are delicious meal prep options everyone will love to cook, eat, and love.
Download the meal planner app for FREE today!
HOW DOES IT WORK?
-Get started by choosing a meal plan and the number of meals you want included in your weekly food delivery. Then select the recipes that suit your meal plan like vegan and vegetarian recipes and more meal prep options for you to cook, eat, and enjoy.
-Skip a trip to the grocery store. Use the meal planner and pick a delivery date that works best for you. Your grocery delivery will be sent right to you and include step-by-step recipes and all the fresh pre-portioned ingredients you need for cooking your weekly meal prep.
-Get cooking with your food delivery and make a recipe that will be ready to eat in 15 to 30 minutes. Find new cooking hacks and your new favourite recipe that you’ll love to eat.
WHY CHEFS PLATE?
Chefs Plate helps you save time, effort, waste, and money on your weekly meal prep. We know how time-consuming putting together a meal plan, grocery shopping, and meal prep can be. After a long day, you don’t want to make a last-minute grocery run or worry about cooking dinner and what to eat. Thanks to your food delivery, Chefs Plate takes the stress out of meal planning and cooking. In just 15 to 30 minutes, you can cook a tasty meal with your grocery delivery that fits your diet plan and is ready to eat and rave about with loved ones.
Here’s how our meal planner makes cooking a recipe easy:
-Every week, our team of incredible chefs put together a menu of 23 delicious recipes using fresh produce that are easy to cook. From comfort food faves to unique vegan and vegetarian recipes, there’s a recipe for everyone to love and eat in your meal plan delivery.
-Stressed out from finding a recipe that you want to eat with your diet plan and cooking in general? Need a new favourite recipe to cook? The meal planner has you covered! Our team creates a wide array of recipes that fit your diet plan and feature cooking hacks that will help you conquer the kitchen. And say goodbye to grocery shopping. Your grocery and meal plan delivery comes with pre-measured ingredients, so no food goes to waste.
-Choose a day that works best for you and we'll organize your meal plan and have it sent straight to your door. Our insulated boxes are designed to keep your food cool and fresh, so you don't need to be home at the time of your grocery delivery. Plus, track your grocery delivery on your meal planner app until it reaches your door.
-With our recipes and meal planner you won’t need fancy equipment or techniques. Our mission is to provide you with a meal plan that will help you cook smarter, not harder.
WHAT YOU’LL FIND ON THE MEAL PLANNER APP?
-Cooking hacks for meal prep, along with step-by-step guides to help you devise a diet plan and meal plan, prep your food delivery and recipe, and cook your meals. 
-When you finish preparing your recipe, you can sync the nutritional info with your Health app using HealthKit to track your nutritional intake.
-Use your account to choose your weekly meals for your next meal prep and food delivery. Easily change your subscription settings for your meal plan and change or skip your delivery date. Plus, track the status of your meal plan delivery.

bluejetty:00161480:ios.description:
Struggling to get your kids to help round the house? Chorly makes doing the housework a family affair!
Set them chores, they get rewards, you get a tidy home.
How does Chorly work?
- Easy Planning: A few taps and you’re organized.
- Kids Earn Rewards: Chores become exciting!
- Family Teamwork: Everyone has to pull their weight.
- Set Goals: Encourage kids to stick with better habits.
- Less Stress and Arguments: Give your family reminders without having to nag.
Chorly isn’t just about keeping your home tidy - it's about teaching responsibility, better habits, and the value of hard work.
Kids love it because it makes chores feel like a game. They earn stars for doing their bit, and the more they help around the house, the bigger the prize. 
The weekly view is like having a chore chart right on your phone. It makes it easier for parents to structure your week, and keep an eye on what’s happening and when. 
And when kids complete chores, they can add pictures for proof, so you can see if they live up to your standards!
You set kids goals and say what they get in return. From pushing back bedtime, to giftcards from their favorite stores, or even a trip away, get ready for kids that actually WANT to help out.
Designed by busy parents, for busy parents.
Ready to say goodbye to a messy home?
Subscription pricing and terms:
- Chorly offers auto-renewing monthly and yearly subscriptions at $9/month or $49/year.
Make the most of our 7-day free trial to see how Chorly can help make your home tidier while teaching your kids valuable life skills.
After the 7-day free trial, to keep using Chorly you need a paid subscription.
There is no free version of the app beyond the trial period.
With the subscription, you ensure that your family maintains access to a fun, engaging, and rewarding way of managing household chores.
The indicated prices in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
What's included in the paid subscription?
- Unlimited Chores and Tasks
- Unlimited Goals
- Unlimited Family Members
- Leaderboard for added competition
Payment will be charged to the credit card connected to your Account when you confirm the initial subscription purchase.
Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period.
Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be identified.

bluejetty:00056297:android.description:
Love home renovations? Looking for a house makeover game where you can explore home design challenges with fun match 3 puzzles? In My Home Makeover, help clients redecor, customize and decorate their stunning dream homes. Become a house designer and house builder as you explore endless possibilities in home design makeover.
Play match 3 puzzle games and earn coins to renovate, redecor and remodel rooms for your clients. Unlock exciting chapters with creatively design home stories along the way! What are you waiting for? Build, renovate, flip, fix & decorate beautiful house projects in My Home Makeover.
Game Features:
• Recreate Homes: Design home from ordinary spaces into luxurious bedrooms from a wide variety of house design. Whether it’s a complete renovation or a quick redecor, your interior design will breathe new life into every home you touch.
• Pick Your Style: Express your creative style from a wide range of furniture, colors, and decorations. Build your own house design with limitless possibilities.
• Exciting Puzzle Games: Test your skills with match-3 challenges as you work through each level. Earn coins and unlock new interior design elements to bring your dream home to life. The more puzzles you solve, the more you can enhance your house design and make your spaces even more beautiful.
• Tackle Challenges: Every client comes with their own redecor vision and specific house design challenges. Use your creativity to meet their needs, whether it’s the makeover of a spacious living room or designing a stylish bathroom. Build a dream house that reflects their style, all while enjoying the freedom of a game offline experience.
• Explore Projects: Dive into a variety of interior makeover projects, ranging from cozy bedrooms to a stylish kitchen & elegant bathroom. Each house makeover & redecor presents a new adventure, giving you the chance to work on different areas of decor and renovation.
• Unlock Rewards: Design home layouts for your clients and unlock bonuses & powerups for your stunning creations. These rewards will help you enhance your interior design (of your room) and give you more resources to work with for future redecor and house makeover projects, making each new match-3 puzzle challenge even more rewarding.
• Express Yourself: Unleash your creativity and let your imagination run wild with end

Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) with Advance
- Running low on cash? Use our Buy Now, Pay Later feature to shop a wide range of products from Gerald’s Cornerstore, whether it's everyday essentials or personal items. A better alternative to traditional Buy Now Pay Later apps, it allows you to make important purchases without the burden of upfront costs.

bluejetty:00030151:ios.description:
Hi there, we're Weatherzone. The local weather app helping you plan your daily life, travels, and outdoor adventures. Here's a quick Summer 2026 Outlook from our resident Meteorologist, and check out our app features below: 
“A strengthening El Niño will influence weather across the United States this summer, with large parts of the country also entering the season in drought. The Northeast and interior Southwest could see above average precipitation, bringing potential storms and flood risk. Meanwhile, below average precipitation in the Pacific Northwest could enhance drought. It’s looking to be an active fire season for parts of the West and South, particularly the Pacific Northwest where abnormally warm and dry conditions will exacerbate the drought. 
Be sure to check your local weather forecasts and warnings to plan ahead, stay safe, and make the most of your summer.” 
FREE WEATHER APP FEATURES 
◆ Local Weather Observations: See the current weather conditions for your location, including temperature, feels like temperature, rain, wind, humidity, dew point, and UV index. 
◆ Radar Map: Visually track where rain and wind are moving in your area with the real-time radar map. You can customize the free layers including rain observations. 
◆ Hourly Graphs: Before you head out the door, swipe through the hourly graphs for temperature, chance of rain, rainfall amounts, and wind. 
◆ Daily Forecast: Plan your day to day with a simple breakdown of the weather during next 10 days, including temperature, chance of rain, rain amount, wind, UV index, plus sunrise and sunset times. 
◆ Synoptic Outlooks: See the broader weather patterns shaping your local weather conditions for the next 7 days, including cold fronts, low pressure systems, and rain bands. 
◆ 14-Day Calendars: Plan ahead using the 14-day Temperature and Rainfall forecasts. Great for road trips, outdoor adventures, and international travel. 
◆ Warnings: Stay safe and informed with official severe weather alerts and warnings for your area. 
◆ Widgets [new]: Try the new lock screen widgets, helping you prepare for whatever the weather brings with an instant snapshot of your weather conditions, without unlocking your phone. Our home screen widgets also have a fresh look and feel - you can customize the weather data to what matters to you most.
OTHER FREE APP FEATURES 
◆ Wind Streamlines: Follow the wind direction across the U.S. with animated streamlines on the radar. 
◆ 14-Day Moon Calendar: Track the moon phases along with moon rise and moon set times. 
WEATHERZONE AD-FREE ACCOUNT [ANNUAL SUBSCRIPTION]
Enjoy an ad-free experience on the Weatherzone app. Simply sign up for an ad-free account - only $3.99 USD per year. 
WEATHERZONE PRO ACCOUNT [MONTHLY SUBSCRIPTION]
For $3.99 USD per month, enjoy the ad-free experience, plus the following exclusive app features: 
◆ See individual lightning strikes on the Radar Map 
◆ Get hourly breakdowns for wind gusts and cloud coverage in Hourly Graphs 
Please note: Weatherzone is expanding globally and while our app provides local forecasts for all places around the world, some specific features may not be available in all regions yet - but sit tight! 
Privacy Policy: https://www.weatherzone.com/privacy-policy 
Terms of Use: https://www.weatherzone.com/terms 
Need help with the app or your account? Simply send through your enquiries, feedback, and suggestions to us at help@weatherzone.com

bluejetty:00088617:ios.description:
AlbertaRELM is the official hunting and fishing licence management App for the Government of Alberta. Store all your AlbertaRELM hunting and fishing licences here for convenient licence management.
Features:
● Manage and carry all your hunting and fishing licences on your mobile device
● Present your licence details to law enforcement for verification in the field
● Plus, more new features are on the way! Such as integration of harvest and effort reporting directly in the App.
Important information:
● The only acceptable form of electronic licence is through the AlbertaRELM App and hunters must be able to produce the electronic app or paper licence when requested by an Officer during field compliance checks.
● For licences that require tags please remember that the associated tag forms part of the licence and must be physically produced when requested.
● Alberta’s Hunting and Sportfishing Regulations prohibit the carrying of someone else’s licence.

【小螺号】趣味百科知识：汇集自然科普、安全常识、百科知识、生活习惯、财商知识等动画视频，提高宝宝对世界的多方位认知。

The humanforce Classic app is being retired and replaced in 2025 by the new Humanforce Work app. The new app is now live and available to download on this page. Log in credentials are the same as in the Humanforce Classic app. 
Humanforce Work is our newly enhanced mobile experience, covering all of your manager and employee roster and shift-driven needs.
The Humanforce Work app enables employees / end-users to:
• See your schedule including rosters, blackouts periods, leave and public holidays
• Clock in and out, view your timesheets and payslips
• Manage leave and availability
• Bid on and accept Shift Offers
• View and manage Notifications
• View Notice boards
• Update personal employment details 
Work enables employers / Admins and managers to:
• Authorise timesheets
• Approve leave
• Manage attendance
• Offer shifts
· Share important notifications
In addition to the smart new features above, Humanforce Work provides enhanced performance, a beautifully redesigned user interface (UI), improved roster management and the ultimate place to stay on top of your work schedule. Before using Humanforce Work, please check with the Humanforce Administrator at your company whether this is the app they prefer you to use. 
About Humanforce
Humanforce is the best-in-one platform for frontline and flexible workforces, offering a truly employee centred, intelligent and compliant human capital management (HCM) suite - without compromise. Founded in 2002, Humanforce has a 2300+ customer base and over half a million users worldwide. Today, we have offices across Australia, New Zealand, and the UK.
Our vision is to make work easier and life better by focusing on the needs and fulfillment of frontline workers, and the efficiency and optimisation of businesses.

bluejetty:00072252:ios.description:
Pass your 2026 UK Driving Theory Test first time! DVSA-licensed with all the latest official revision questions, hazard perception clips, unlimited timed mock exams, and exclusive 3D Scenario Simulations.
Trusted by thousands of learner drivers. Covers car, motorcycle, LGV, HGV, PCV & ADI theory tests — everything in one app.
700+ DVSA questions | All hazard perception video clips | Realistic mock exams | Highway Code & road signs | Smart progress tracking | Works offline
Our app is the ultimate study companion for anyone looking to pass their driving theory test with flying colors. It includes all the latest revision questions and answers, along with our unique "Scenario Simulations" — 3D quiz scenarios with different road situations where you need to answer questions, further enhancing your learning experience.
With our app, you'll have access to everything you need to prepare for your test, including driving theory practice questions, explanations, mock tests, and the innovative Scenario Simulations. Our app also includes hazard perception video clips, specifically designed to test your ability to spot hazards as they develop on the road. Our cheat detection feature ensures that you're truly learning and improving your skills, not just passing your driving theory test.
We believe that both hazard perception practice and scenario simulation are crucial for passing the driving theory test and becoming a safe driver. That's why we've included a wide range of hazard perception clips and 3D quiz scenarios in our app, to give you the best chance of success. Our app's built-in analysis tools allow you to track your progress and identify areas where you need more practice.
In addition to hazard perception practice and scenario simulations, our app also includes a comprehensive Highway Code section, with all UK road signs for reference. We understand that studying the Highway Code can be overwhelming, which is why we've made it easy for you to focus on the specific sections you need to study. Our app's interface allows you to easily search for and navigate to specific sections.
We also understand that the rules and regulations of the road can change over time, and it is important for our users to stay up to date with the latest version of the Highway Code. When a new version of the Highway Code is released, our app will send a notification to all users to inform them of the update. bluejetty:00139518:ios.description:
Get ready for an action-packed PvP shooter that takes armored warfare to the next level - MWT: Tank Battles!
Immerse yourself in intense tank battles featuring the most advanced war machines including air defense systems, multiple launch rocket systems, self-propelled artillery, various types of drones, fighters, helicopters & more. Experience the modern combined arms battles in the most spectacular way.
Try dozens of Cold War era & modern machines, as well as the most recent prototypes, all the way up to the Armata and AbramsX tanks. Each update will bring even more models and types of military hardware that is on every military fan’s lips.
Get in the tank, player, and get ready for the action!
Engage in Epic PvP Tank Battles:
In MWT: Tank Battles, take the helm of heavily armored tanks and engage in thrilling PvP games. Command your tank company and prove your skills in fast-paced, high-stakes armored warfare. Dominate the battlefield and become the ultimate warfront champion!
Advanced Air Combat:
Take to the skies flying legendary war machines such as the AH 64E Apache helicopter and the F-35B fighter jet. Enjoy detailed flight mechanics, realistic takeoffs and landings. Customize your aircraft to suit your fighting style, choosing from a variety of weapons and technical upgrades that can turn the tide of battle. Experience the thrill of piloting some of the most iconic aircraft in modern warfare!
Unleash Artillery Strikes:
Experience the true power of modern warfare with advanced artillery systems. Employ precision strikes from a distance, raining destruction upon your enemies. Command the battlefield with strategic artillery strikes!
Masterful Drone Warfare:
Drones play a crucial role in shaping the outcome of battles. Utilize drones to scout enemy positions, mark targets for artillery strikes, and gain a tactical advantage. Take control of drones to deliver quick and deadly strikes to your foes, leaving them in awe.
Customize and Upgrade Your War Machines:
Choose from a diverse selection of modern tanks, each with unique strengths and capabilities. Customize your war machines with powerful weapons and equipment to suit your playstyle. Upgrade your tanks to unlock advanced features and gain a competitive edge on the battlefield.
Realistic Graphics and Physics:
Experience the thrill of modern tank warfare with stunning graphics and realistic physics. Immerse yourself in battle arenas, highly detailed tank models, and awe-inspiring visual effects.
Join Forces and Conquer Together:
Form alliances with like-minded players to dominate the warfront as a formidable force. Collaborate in battles, coordinate drone strikes and artillery attacks, and outmaneuver your enemies.
Prepare for the most thrilling tank battles of your life! Command your tanks, aircraft, drones, and artillery, dominate the PvP battles, and establish your dominance on the warfront. 
Download MWT: Tank Battles now and lead your army to victory!
This new game is developed by the Artstorm studio, the renowned creators of Modern Warships naval action simulation game, and redefines the ground vehicle warfare genre.

bluejetty:00081089:ios.name: Timelapse by ReeLapse
bluejetty:00081089:ios.summary:
PROFESSIONAL TIME-LAPSE. COMPLETE CONTROL.
ReeLapse is a professional time-lapse and hyperlapse camera for iPhone, created for photographers and filmmakers who want complete control over capture, image quality, and post-production. Record
bluejetty:00081089:ios.description:
PROFESSIONAL TIME-LAPSE. COMPLETE CONTROL.
ReeLapse is a professional time-lapse and hyperlapse camera for iPhone, created for photographers and filmmakers who want complete control over capture, image quality, and post-production. Record finished videos in MAX or 4K, or switch to the new RAW mode to preserve every frame as an individual DNG file.
— RAW TIME-LAPSE —
RAW mode captures complete DNG image sequences and saves them to the ReeLapse folder in the Files app. Bypass the standard processed image stream and unlock maximum flexibility to recover highlights, refine exposure and white balance, apply precise color grades, or edit any frame as a standalone photograph.
Transfer your sequence to Mac or PC and build your final time-lapse in apps such as Lightroom, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or LRTimelapse. RAW capture also opens the door to advanced day-to-night and night-to-day “Holy Grail” workflows.
— THREE CAPTURE MODES —
• MAX: Capture the full width and height of the sensor for detailed 4:3 open-gate output and greater freedom to reframe in post.
• 4K: Create ready-to-share 3840 × 2160 video in a cinematic 16:9 aspect ratio.
• RAW: Capture individual DNG frames for maximum image quality and post-production control.
— PRECISION WITHOUT THE GUESSWORK —
The intelligent Time-Lapse Dashboard calculates capture duration and final video length in real time. Choose up to 6000 frames, set intervals from 0.5 to 60 seconds, and see exactly how every adjustment affects your result before recording.
Select output frame rates up to 60 fps, choose Apple ProRes or HEVC on compatible devices, and fine-tune the bit rate for the ideal balance between quality and file size. Optional backups can also save a duplicate video or the individual JPEG frames.
— FULL MANUAL CONTROL —
Lock or manually adjust ISO, shutter speed, focus, and white balance to prevent distracting exposure jumps, focus changes, and color shifts. Use tap-to-focus, manual focus, focus peaking, a live histogram, and zebra stripes to check every detail before you start.
Prefer simplicity? Leave any control untouched and ReeLapse keeps it in Auto.
— GPU-POWERED SLOW SHUTTER —
Create fluid Motion Blur for clouds, traffic, crowds, and moving scenes, or build striking Light Trails from cars, city lights, and stars. ReeLapse’s custom frame-stacking algorithms run entirely on your iPhone’s GPU, with a live preview that lets you see and refine the effect during capture.
— APPLE WATCH REMOTE —
Start and control your time-lapse remotely from your wrist, helping you avoid disturbing a carefully framed shot.
ReeLapse 2.1 features a refined interface with Liquid Glass styling, fully optimized for iOS 26.
Transform the ordinary into the extraordinary. Turn the passage of time into art with ReeLapse.
*RAW mode creates DNG sequences for external post-production and does not render a finished video in-app. Slow Shutter effects are available in MAX and 4K modes, not RAW. On iPhone SE, only full-resolution capture is supported. On older iPhone models, Slow Shutter modes may increase memory usage.

bluejetty:00040014:ios.name: Egg Shooter Dynomite
bluejetty:00040014:ios.summary: Egg Shooter Dynomite - a classic egg shooter game closely associated with many's childhood memories, thanks to its simple yet incredibly entertaining gameplay that effectively relieves stress. And the mobile version of this bubble shooter g
bluejetty:00040014:ios.description:
Egg Shooter Dynomite - a classic egg shooter game closely associated with many's childhood memories, thanks to its simple yet incredibly entertaining gameplay that effectively relieves stress. And the mobile version of this bubble shooter game is available now! If you're looking for a game that is easy to play but still challenging and addictive, then Dynomite is the perfect choice for you.
This light and non-demanding bubble shooter game does not require any special skills or strategies. Dynomite’s gameplay is quite straightforward: as a bubble shooter and egg shooter, you simply need to shoot at least 3 eggs or bubbles of the same color to make them explode within a certain time limit. This bubble pop game is gentle and doesn't require any special skills or strategies. In this dino egg shoot game, you just need to be a bit skillful and quick-handed to make as many eggs or bubbles as possible explode, earn the highest score possible, and avoid being crushed by falling eggs or bubbles!
At times, when special eggs or bubbles will appear on the screen, and if you can make them explode, you'll receive attractive rewards such as doubled points, fireworks, and more. As an egg shooter or bubble shooter, you can also receive dino egg shoot bombs to explode many eggs or bubbles at once. With its colorful graphics, catchy sound effects, and addictive gameplay, Dynomite is a game that will keep you coming back for more.
So, enjoy some relaxing moments with this fun and exciting bubble pop game - Egg Shooter Dynomite!
Terms of use: https://hayhay.one/eterms.html
Privacy Policy: https://hayhay.one/epolicy.html

bluejetty:00041416:ios.name: Muslim: Ramadan 2026, Quran
bluejetty:00041416:ios.summary: Muslim: Quran, Athan & Qibla is your comprehensive Islamic companion, designed to support your daily spiritual journey. With essential features like accurate prayer time reminders, Quran reading and listening, Azkar collection, and Qibla di
bluejetty:00041416:ios.description:
Muslim: Quran, Athan & Qibla is your comprehensive Islamic companion, designed to support your daily spiritual journey. With essential features like accurate prayer time reminders, Quran reading and listening, Azkar collection, and Qibla direction, it helps strengthen your faith and manage your daily worship seamlessly.
Key Features:
- Accurate Prayer Times: Never miss a prayer again! Get precise notifications for all Salah times (Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha) based on your location, with a choice of athan sounds. Adjust the calculation method, Asr time (Standard or Hanafi), and Hijri date to match your community.
- Azkar & Duas: Immerse yourself in spiritual invocations with a curated collection of Azkar and Duas, perfect for morning, evening, and every moment in between. Strengthen your connection with Allah through heartfelt invocations, and bookmark your favorites to return to them anytime.
- Tasbih Counter: Elevate your Dhikr practice with the built-in Tasbih Counter. This feature includes an electronic tasbih and prayer bead counter to help you track your count while reciting your prayer or Dua.
- Qibla Direction: Find the Qibla direction accurately, no matter where you are. The integrated Qibla compass ensures precise alignment for your prayers, and a map shows the direction from your location to the Kaaba.
- Quran Access: Read, listen to, and reflect on the Holy Quran directly within the app. The clear and user-friendly interface allows for easy navigation between chapters and verses, with recitations, translations in many languages, and favorite verses to support your daily recitation goals.
- Prayer Reminders: Never miss a prayer with customizable reminders that fit your routine. Whether it's a gentle nudge for Fajr or a midday reminder for Dhuhr, you'll stay connected to your worship schedule.
Muslim: Quran, Athan & Qibla is designed to be your trusted spiritual companion, integrating faith seamlessly into your daily routine. Whether you're managing prayer times, reflecting on Quranic verses, or seeking solace in Azkar and Duas, this app supports your spiritual growth and devotion.
Free with Ads:
The app is free to download, and all features are free to use. The free version contains ads. Ads are personalized only if you allow tracking, and you can change this anytime in Settings > Privacy & Security > Tracking.
Muslim Premium:
Subscribe to Muslim Premium to remove all ads from the app. It is available as weekly, monthly, and yearly auto-renewable subscriptions, and prices are shown in the app before purchase.
- Payment will be charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Your subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- You can manage and cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings after purchase.
Privacy Policy: https://magic-studio.netlify.app/policy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Download now and experience the convenience, guidance, and fulfillment of having a complete Islamic companion right at your fingertips. Stay connected to your faith, no matter where life takes you.

bluejetty:00187842:ios.description:
Dialpad gives teams a single place to stay connected with a business communication platform that supports every kind of conversation. Whether sales or support, 1:1 or group meeting, Dialpad offers a solution that makes it easier to make smart calls both in and outside your business.
Features that Matter:
*A Single Platform*
Calls, contacts, and messages—all your business communications right in the palm of your hand.
*Switch Between Devices*
Take calls on the go and switch between your laptop or deskphone to your iOS device in one tap.
*Automatic Note-Taking*
With Voice Intelligence™, calls are automatically transcribed and surfaced to you once you hang up, so you’re never second-guessing what was said.
*Rich Contact Profiles*
Contact profiles should include more than just a name and number. With Dialpad, access shared emails or upcoming events plus details from your CRM.
*Coach From Anywhere*
Monitor and coach calls from a single interface, even when you’re nowhere near a desk, with listen-in features.

bluejetty:00040143:ios.description:
Welcome to PhotoCaption AI – where your photos speak a thousand words in multiple languages!
Do you often find yourself struggling to come up with the perfect caption for your social media posts? Whether it's Instagram, X, Facebook, LinkedIn or even Tinder, InstaCaption AI is here to revolutionize your posting experience. Our app, powered by the cutting-edge GPT-4 Vision technology from OpenAI, effortlessly crafts captions that capture the essence of your images and resonate with your audience.
Features:
1. AI-Driven Captions: Upload a photo, and the GPT-4 Vision AI will analyze it to generate captions that perfectly suits the image.
2. Customizable Tone: Choose between a humorous or standard tone to match your style or mood.
3. Multi-Language Support: Reach a global audience with captions available in up to 14 different languages.
4. Social Media Integration: Tailor your captions for specific platforms – be it the brevity of Twitter, the visual appeal of Instagram, or the personal touch for Facebook and Tinder.
5. User-Friendly Interface: A sleek and intuitive interface ensures a seamless experience from start to finish.
6. Share: Easily share them directly from the app and copy to the clipboard.
Why Choose PhotoCaption AI?
- Save Time: No more spending hours brainstorming the perfect caption.
- Increase Engagement: Captivating captions can boost your post's visibility and engagement.
- Showcase Creativity: Stand out with unique, AI-enhanced captions.
- Cross-Cultural Reach: Communicate with a diverse audience in their language.
Who is it for?
- Social Media Enthusiasts: Bring your photo stories to life.
- Influencers & Marketers: Engage your audience more effectively.
- Global Citizens: Connect with friends and followers worldwide.
- Anyone who loves sharing photos: Make every post memorable.
Ready to elevate your social media game? Download PhotoCaption AI now and start turning your photos into engaging stories!

bluejetty:00151216:ios.description:
Stick it. Slide it. Swap it. 
TilePix are beautiful 8”x8” photo tiles that just snap to the wall. Our magical magnetic mounting system gives you a professional looking memory wall every time. Effortlessly hang, rearrange and reposition your TilePix, without ever peeling them off the wall. Unlike nails or foam tape that damage walls and loses its stickiness, our amazing Stick&Slide™ hanging system uses a removable magnetic wall pad that holds the frame securely to the wall while enabling unlimited adjustments. Want a change of scenery? For the first time ever, you can easily swap out and mix up the TilePix memory walls around your home.
We use the highest quality inks and papers to preserve your memories. And TilePix are built to last. You can feel the quality. Our frames are sustainably made with more than 50% recycled material and 100% pride right here in the USA. 
Ordering your TilePix couldn’t be easier…and you can even pick them up same day! Just download the iOS app and select the layout you want…or make your own. You can choose your photos from your iPhone library or social media. It’s easy to apply filters and we even offer two different matte colors, if you want one. You can pickup smaller TilePix orders at your local Walgreens or we’ll FedEx larger orders to you for free.
Your memories and experiences are important to you, which makes them important to us. We know you’re going to love the beauty, creativity and flexibility of TilePix! We guarantee it. If you’re not happy for any reason, we’re giving back your money.

bluejetty:00123322:ios.summary: The Woolworths app is an all-in-one online shopping and money app for your iPhone or iPad in South Africa. Buy groceries online, order fresh food and ready-made meals, shop fashion and essentials, and manage your money, payments and rewards
bluejetty:00123322:ios.description:
The Woolworths app is an all-in-one online shopping and money app for your iPhone or iPad in South Africa. Buy groceries online, order fresh food and ready-made meals, shop fashion and essentials, and manage your money, payments and rewards in one easy app.
What is the Woolworths app?
• The Woolworths app is a shopping and money app that lets you:
• Buy groceries online and get delivery to your door
• Order ready-made meals and fresh food fast
• Shop clothing, beauty, homeware and essentials
• Manage payments, credit and rewards in one place
Perfect for everyday use on your iPhone or iPad
• Use the Woolies app when you want to:
• Buy groceries online without the queues
• Get same-day grocery delivery or food delivery
• Shop ready-made meals with no prep
• Buy premium fresh produce and essentials
• Earn rewards and manage your money easily
Online shopping and grocery delivery made simple
Browse, search and shop across food, fashion, beauty, homeware and electronics in one easy shopping app.
Choose a shopping delivery option that best suits your day:
• Standard Delivery: Select a date and time that works for you
• Click and Collect shopping pick-up: Order online and collect your shopping from the nearest Woolies store
• Dash Delivery: Get fresh groceries and meals delivered same day
Everything you need in one shopping app
• Shop across categories with Woolworths Exceptional Quality™:
• Food: Fresh groceries, pantry staples and ready-made meals
• Fashion: Women’s, men’s and kids’ clothing, shoes and accessories
• Beauty products: Skincare, makeup, fragrances and trusted brands
• Tech products: Phones, smart devices, gaming and accessories
• Homeware: Furniture, decor and everyday essentials
Shop smarter with other helpful features
• Scan a product in-store: Scan items to view details instantly
• Find products in-store: Check stock before you visit
• Shopping lists: Plan your grocery shopping with ease
• Store locator: Find stores, trading hours and directions near you
Stay inspired
Get updates on exclusive offers, promotions and rewards. Discover recipes, fashion trends and home inspiration in one place.
Earn rewards with MyDifference
• Enjoy rewards designed around how you shop:
• Personalised vouchers for in-store and online shopping
• Play and Win games with prizes, cashback and vouchers
• Cashback is loaded directly to your app
• Tailored promotions based on your shopping habits
• Monthly goals that unlock extra rewards
• Track your savings, rewards and transactions
• The more you shop, the more you earn.
Woolworths Financial Services – your money app
• The Woolworths app also works as a money app, helping you manage payments, credit and financial services securely.
• Credit Cards: Shop and earn rewards every time you spend
• Store Cards: One card for all your Woolies shopping
• Personal Loans: Access funds when you need them*
• Insurance: Travel, pet and balance protection cover
*Our personal loans:
Maximum loan amount to borrow: R150 000
Minimum repayment term: 12 months
Maximum repayment term: 60 months
Maximum Annual Percentage Rate (APR): 21%
The APR is based on the maximum rate according to the National Credit Act (NCA).
A representative example:
Loan amount borrowed: R75 000
Repayment term: 12 months
APR: 21%
Once-off initiation fee: R1207.50
Monthly service fee: R69
Monthly repayment: R7164.97
Total cost of the loan: R85 979.64
Manage your account
• View balances, statements and make secure payments
• Use a Virtual Store Card for easy shopping
• Freeze, block or replace lost cards instantly
• Apply for a store card, credit card, loan or limit increase
Why download the Woolworths app?
• Online shopping, grocery delivery and meals
• Money management and rewards
• Fast delivery and flexible collection options
• Easy, secure checkout
• Trusted Woolworths Exceptional Quality™
Download the Woolworths app on your iPhone or iPad to shop groceries online, manage your money and enjoy rewards, all in one app.

bluejetty:00170442:ios.name: Popsicle Stack
bluejetty:00170442:ios.summary: You scream, I scream, we all scream for ice cream! Popsicle Stack brings you a beautiful popsicle building experience mixed with an ultra smooth runner game that's both easy to learn and fun to play! Create massive stacks of popsicles and s
bluejetty:00170442:ios.description:
You scream, I scream, we all scream for ice cream! Popsicle Stack brings you a beautiful popsicle building experience mixed with an ultra smooth runner game that's both easy to learn and fun to play! Create massive stacks of popsicles and sell them to your eager customers to earn mountains of cash. Explore the vast array of different fillings and toppings, create any popsicle flavor you can imagine: chocolate vanilla strawberry, rainbow and sprinkles, fruit pop, chocolate dip, the possibilities are endless! Which flavors will make you the most money? That's for you to find out.
Start with your popsicle cup, the cup shapes the popsicle. What kind of shape will you choose? Collect and stack as many cups as you can (this takes skills!). Next choose your popsicle filling, maneuver your cups into a ice cream pouring station and fill them with your choice of ice cream flavors! Now it's time to freeze your pops and put them on a popsicle sticks, remove the cup and now you have a queue of frozen popsicles! Onto the toppings, dip your popsicles into a pool of melted chocolate then roll them under a shower of sprinkles. Mix and match toppings to expand the variety of flavors you serve. Time to sell your popsicles to the hungry kids and bring in that money! The crazier the popsicle build, the more it sells for, so go wild!
Gameplay Features:
3D popsicle stacking game, how many can you stack?
Fluid runner game with a variety of obstacles and treasures.
Learn how to make your own popsicles!
Customize your chef, dozens of cosmetic upgrades to choose from.
100's of levels to explore, and more on the way!
A perfect game to sit down and relax with.

bluejetty:00023456:ios.summary:

[ Make Family Trees Without Having to Create an Account ]
This is an app that allows you to make family trees wi
bluejetty:00023456:ios.description:
This is a new app of the smartphone generation to create a family tree.
It features interactive display using digital devices.
[ Make Family Trees Without Having to Create an Account ]
This is an app that allows you to make family trees without having to create an account. There are no paid services within the app either.
[ Form Relationships Easily ]
You can easily add parents, children, and spouses just by tapping. Family trees can be created intuitively. The display order of siblings can also be easily changed through drag and drop.
[ Streamline Complex Family Trees ]
The display changes automatically so that the person selected appears in the center. You can make complex family trees look simple and easy to understand.
[ Make Multiple Family Trees ]
As you can create multiple sets of data, you can make historical family trees, in addition to your own, and do various things.
[ FAQ ]
[Q]Is there a PC version?
[A]There is no PC version.
[Q]Is it possible to merge multiple family trees later?
[A]There is no function to combine multiple family trees yet.
[Q]Can I transfer data to another smartphone? Is data backup possible?
[A]There is an import / export function. See the help page for details.
We confirmed the operation on Google Drive, email, and Dropbox.
We have received reports that we cannot send and receive on Facebook, WhatsApp, and LINE.
[Q]I want to display maternal and paternal ancestors at the same time.
[A]If the maternal ancestors and paternal ancestors are displayed at the same time, it is difficult to display them while maintaining the order of the siblings.
[Q]Can you print?
[A]You cannot print directly from the app.Images can be output using the capture function. Please print the created image with another application.
[Q]Is PDF format file output possible?
[A]PDF output is not yet.
[Q]Is it compatible with GEDCOM format files?
[A]GEDCOM format files are not supported.
[Q]Can I use it offline?
[A]Since the data is stored on the smartphone (tablet) side, it can be used even in an offline environment.
[Q]Is it possible to set up same-sex couples?
[A]The initial state is opposite sex, but it is possible to change to the same sex after registration.
[Q]I want to add a child without showing spouse.
[A]At present, children can only connect between couples. Please add a temporary spouse.
[Q]Is there a paid ad-free version?
[A]I have not yet considered paid apps. Free version only.
[Q]Can I publish images created on the app on the Web?
[A]Please use it freely.

bluejetty:00018062:ios.name: Kuveyt Türk Mobil
bluejetty:00018062:ios.summary: We renewed the design of the Kuveyt Türk Mobile. While making this renovation, we relied on up-to-date technology and design trends; and also benefitted from you and all of our valuable customers’ experience. We aimed at making your banking
bluejetty:00018062:ios.description:
We renewed the design of the Kuveyt Türk Mobile. While making this renovation, we relied on up-to-date technology and design trends; and also benefitted from you and all of our valuable customers’ experience. We aimed at making your banking transactions fast, safe and easy. We will be able to bring you more visual and personalized experiences with the new design. Providing us with your feedback about Kuveyt Türk Mobile will help us present you with latest trends and innovations.
With Kuveyt Türk Mobile, you can easily do your banking transactions without any charge.
• Money transfers • Different types of payments related to bill payments and others • Currency and precious metal buying and selling • Credit card transactions • Money deposit and withdrawal with QR code • Viewing account related transactions and activity • Directions to the nearest Kuveyt Turk • Viewing exchange rates • Currency and precious metal related calculations • Viewing IBAN information • Viewing BES • Managing notification settings • Calculating financing according to profit ratio • Making card payments through Kuveyt Türk Mobile with CebimPOS • Investment account related transactions and many more transactions can be made easily and quickly for both individual and corporate customers. In addition to the above, our corporate customers can view, approve or cancel transactions each according to their corporate user authorization type.
LOGIN WITH A SINGLE PIN
In order to use Kuveyt Türk Mobile, all you have to do is set your password. Once you have verified your device with the security steps, Kuveyt Türk Mobile recognizes you and allows you to log in quickly with a single PIN you specify.
FIRST PASSWORD
Can be obtained by calling the Kuveyt Turk Call Center at 444 0 123 or through the Instant Password menu on the Internet Branch. Our corporate customers need to contact their branches to obtain their passwords for the first time.
VERIFICATION
You will need to verify your device when logging in for the first time to Kuveyt Türk Mobile. The verification must be done by connecting to the Internet via your GSM number that is registered at our bank (If not done with your registered GSM number, you will be asked to approve your device through the Call Center). After verifying a device you can give approval for using the Kuveyt Türk Mobile on other devices as well.
DETAILED INFORMATION ABOUT KUVEYT TÜRK MOBILE AND INFO ABOUT REQUESTED PERMISSIONS
You can use the ""Application Support"" button.

apple-macos:6739005862.name: SkyMarks
apple-macos:6739005862.description:
SkyMarks is the Bluesky bookmarks app for your iPhone, iPad and Mac.
Bluesky is the biggest thing happening in social media in 2025. It seems like everyone is jumping on board, with over 31 million users as of February.
When you jump in, though, you may find some things that you miss from your old social networks, like the ability to bookmark a post. It’s a common thing to want to save a post to come back to later. Maybe you want to think a while before responding. Maybe the post has a useful link in it that you want to come back to. Or maybe you just really like the post and want to keep it around.
Until Bluesky decides to implement bookmarking itself, SkyMarks can be your Bluesky bookmark manager.
To bookmark a post from your browser, just tap the share button (the button with the arrow pointing out of a box) and then select SkyMarks from the list of available options. Once you’ve bookmarked a post, it will be available in SkyMarks whenever you need it.
SkyMarks synchs its bookmarks across all your devices that use the same Apple ID. So if you bookmark a post while you’re waiting in line at the grocery store, you’ll find it on your iPad when you’re reading in your living room or your Mac when you’re working at your desk.
SkyMarks has robust features to find bookmarked posts. You can search by post text, author name, author handle or even your own notes. You can even search the text in images attached to posts you’ve bookmarked!
You can also tag bookmarks and view bookmarks by tag, so you can use SkyMarks for multiple projects and still get to the bookmarks you need when you need them.
SkyMarks is free to use and has no in-app purchases. It’s just here to make the transition to Bluesky a little easier for you. If you find a bug or want a feature, please provide feedback.
SkyMarks will hopefully one day be open-source. There are a few issues that need to be figured out before its code is released to the public though.
